fdroid:com.antonok.warpclock.name: Warpclock
fdroid:com.antonok.warpclock.summary: Quick shortcut for setting alarms based on your preferred amount of sleep.
fdroid:com.antonok.warpclock.description:
Warpclock provides a quick shortcut for setting alarms based on your preferred amount of sleep. No more mental math before bed - after a single button press, your head can hit the pillow and you will warp forwards in time with minimal interruption.
 How to use 
When you open Warpclock for the first time, you should configure your preferred amount of sleep using the in-app controls. There are buttons to increase and decrease the amount by 1 hour, 10 minutes, and 1 minute. You only need to set this once.
There is also a button labeled "Set alarm" inside the app. Pressing this button will create a new one-shot alarm in your default alarm clock app, configured to wake you up after your personalized amount of time has passed. The alarm will automatically delete itself from your alarm app once it has triggered, keeping your list of saved alarms clean.
Once the alarm is created, you'll get two toast notifications. The first notification is from Warpclock, displaying the time that the new alarm should go off. The second notification comes from the system alarm clock, confirming that it was created sucessfully and displaying how far in the future the alarm will occur.
The app also exposes a widget that you can add to your homescreen for even faster access.
In the default launcher, just long-press on your homescreen background and drag the "Warpclock" widget to a location on your homescreen, and drag the edges to resize as desired. Tapping on the widget text will create a new alarm just as if you'd pressed the "Set alarm" button in the app. You'll get the same two toast notifications as well.
The alarm is created in your default alarm clock app, so you should use that to configure the default alarm sound and vibration settings. Once an alarm is created, if the trigger time needs to be adjusted, that should also be done in the default alarm clock app.
 Current limitations 
This app currently does not handle Daylight Savings Time changes, it simply adds the configured amount and rolls over at 24 hours. You'll need to manually fix a couple of alarms per year if you live in a region that still changes the time back and forth.

fdroid:de.hohnepeople.keepadb.name: KeepADB
fdroid:de.hohnepeople.keepadb.summary: Keep Wireless Debugging active and toggle it from a tile or widget
fdroid:de.hohnepeople.keepadb.description:
KeepADB helps keep Android Wireless Debugging available across device restarts, Wi-Fi reconnects, access-point changes, and idle periods.
Toggle Wireless Debugging from the main screen, a Quick Settings tile, or a home-screen widget. An optional foreground service monitors the connection and attempts recovery when Android disables it. Android may ask for approval to enable Wireless Debugging on Wi-Fi. Approve only expected prompts on a private network you trust. Select “Always allow on this network” if you want Android to allow Wireless Debugging automatically when your device reconnects to that network. KeepADB cannot grant this Android approval itself; its optional trusted-network restriction is separate and only controls where automatic recovery may run. If Android does not confirm an automatic enable, KeepADB backs off instead of retrying rapidly.
Features:
* Quick Settings tile, home-screen widget, and main app controls
* Optional Keep-Alive service across restarts and network changes
* Endpoint discovery through Android NSD/mDNS (_adb-tls-connect._tcp); timing depends on network conditions
* Optional HTTP(S) webhook, disabled by default, for verified Wifi-ADB endpoints
* Configurable status notification, endpoint display, and privacy mode to hide addresses in the app
* Network Wi-Fi and access-point tools, plus an optional trusted-network restriction
* 19 interface languages and right-to-left layout support
* No advertising, analytics, tracking, or third-party runtime libraries
On fresh installs, trusted-network filtering is off, so Keep-Alive may use any connected Wi-Fi network. Enabling the restriction requires Android location access to identify networks. KeepADB's Keep-Alive service is set up so that identity stays readable in the background too, as long as it was started while the app was open; recovery can still pause if the permission is missing or approximate, or location is off. A service instance that has only ever been started in the background (e.g. after a restart or an app update) keeps the identity masked until the app is opened again, unless you also grant Location "Allow all the time" on KeepADB's Android permission page — an optional step offered as a dismissible setup card on the main screen while trusted-network mode is on. KeepADB cannot grant this for you and, as with all location access here, only uses it to identify the Wi-Fi network; it does not read or store your location.
When USB debugging is connected, KeepADB can show a USB notification and associate it with an editable host profile stored on the device. It can optionally offer or perform a USB-to-Wifi-ADB handover. USB profile data is not sent through the current webhook contract.
KeepADB does not require root. Android protects Wireless Debugging with the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission, so initial setup requires granting it once from a trusted computer with ADB:
adb shell pm grant de.hohnepeople.keepadb android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
Wireless Debugging exposes an authenticated development service on the connected network. Use Keep-Alive on networks you trust, turn Wireless Debugging off on public hotspots, and reject unexpected Android approval or pairing prompts.

fdroid:fr.sudotiz.duper.name: Duper
fdroid:fr.sudotiz.duper.description:
Lost your phone? Send it "duper".
Why "Duper"? It's French verlan (backwards slang) for "perdu" — meaning "lost". Reverse the syllables: du-per. The app that finds what's lost, named after being lost.
Duper lets you remotely control your Android phone using SMS commands. It has no account, server, tracking SDK, or internet permission. Secrets, settings, command history, and location data stay on the device and are excluded from Android backups and device transfers.
Send "duper ring" to make your phone ring with the flashlight blinking. Useful when you've lost your phone nearby. Device and Do Not Disturb policies may limit alerts.
Send "duper locate" to receive GPS coordinates by SMS at regular intervals. Useful in an emergency or when you lend your phone to someone.
Features:
• Ring with flash, bypasses silent mode
• GPS location tracking via SMS
• Both modes stop when the phone is unlocked
• Configurable command prefix, optional Ring password, Locate secret, duration, and interval
• Custom ringtone support
• Works entirely offline over SMS
• No account, no cloud, no tracking
The Camera permission is used only to control the device torch during a ring alert. Duper does not capture photos or video. The Vibration permission is used only for ring alerts.
Location uses location permissions, including background location when the app is closed. The optional ADB-only WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission lets Duper attempt to enable Android location services when they are off; it is not needed when location services are already enabled.
Ring and Locate are disabled by default. Ring can use an optional password and optional SMS confirmation; Locate requires its own secret and sends SMS responses. The app requests only the permissions needed when you enable each mode.
For privacy, remote commands run only while the phone is locked and stop when it is unlocked.
Note: On Android 13+, you may need to allow restricted settings once in the app settings before granting permissions.
Open source under GPL-3.0.

BookScanner has been rebuilt. Everything you scanned is still here. On first launch BookScanner brings your earlier scan history across by itself — nothing to export, nothing to restore, nothing to tap. The old library file is read and left exactly where it is, so the version you already had is untouched. Books that came over are marked "From your earlier scan history" in History, and the filter sheet will show you just those. You can run the import again from Settings whenever you like.
Your ATOS levels, AR quiz numbers, AR points, word counts, interest levels and Lexile measures come across exactly as BookScanner had them.
GET READING LEVELS FROM SIRI OR SHORTCUTS
Ask Siri on iPhone or iPad without opening the app, or use the Shortcuts app. Say "Look up a reading level in BookScanner", then give Siri the ISBN or the title. Siri answers with the book's levels and which of them are estimated, and a book you look up by its ISBN is saved to your History, like a scan. Ask Siri to show your recent books or find your books by reading level. On iPhone models with the Action button, set it to Scan a Book to open the scanner. On Mac, the same actions can be added to a new shortcut in the Shortcuts app.
NOTHING ADDITIONAL TO BUY
Lexile measures, DRA, Fountas & Pinnell / Guided Reading Levels and grade equivalents are included for every owner. BookScanner has no in-app purchases and no subscriptions.
FIVE READING LEVELS, AND WHERE EACH ONE CAME FROM
- AR (Accelerated Reader) / ATOS — looked up, never estimated
- Lexile measures — looked up, never estimated
- Guided Reading Level (GRL) / F&P — looked up from Scholastic when Scholastic has it; otherwise BookScanner estimates it and marks it ≈
- DRA (Developmental Reading Assessment) — marked ≈ when BookScanner estimates it
- Grade level equivalent — marked ≈ when BookScanner estimates it
Above P, BookScanner doesn't estimate a Guided Reading Level: where Scholastic has no level for a longer chapter book, BookScanner shows none rather than a letter it can't stand behind.
NO BARCODE? FIND IT ANOTHER WAY
When a barcode won't scan, or it isn't the book's ISBN, type the book's title instead. On iPhone and iPad models whose camera can read text, BookScanner can also read the title from the cover or spine for you to check before it searches, or read the ISBN printed on the book.
WORKS ON MAC, TOO
BookScanner runs on the Mac as well as on iPhone and iPad, on the same purchase. Scan with the webcam at your desk. Your history is kept in your own private iCloud database and syncs to your other devices.
UNITED STATES AND UNITED KINGDOM
Choose your AR BookFinder region in Settings.
IMPORT AND EXPORT
- Export your library to CSV — sixteen columns, including where each level came from
- Import a CSV, including a file exported from the earlier BookScanner
- Export to PDF for printing, and share a single book or your whole library
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Recently scanned books and one-tap scanning, right on your Home Screen.
Used by teachers since 2012.
Rave Reviews:
"My kids and I love this app. It's very helpful and convenient."
Get Started Today:
Download BookScanner now to simplify your reading comprehension tasks and stay organized!

 step by step.
 Interactive tutorials guide you from beginner to advanced
 Write and edit code with a built-in code editor
 Debug your programs with real-time inspection tools
 Test your creations on a virtual game console
 Learn about computer history while coding
 Perfect for hobbyists, students, and anyone curious about how computers really work under the
 hood!

flathub:io.github.hihebark.QuranReader.name: Quran Reader
flathub:io.github.hihebark.QuranReader.summary: Read and browse the Holy Quran
flathub:io.github.hihebark.QuranReader.description:
Quran Reader is a native GNOME application for reading the Holy Quran.
 It offers two reading modes: a faithful Mushaf rendering using
 ligature-based SVG pages, and a text mode with Arabic and English
 (Sahih International) side by side.
 Mushaf mode — authentic page-by-page rendering (604 pages, Mushaf Qatar)
 Text mode — ayah-by-ayah view with Arabic and English translation
 Bilingual sidebar — surah list in Arabic or English with live search
 RTL-aware layout — sidebar moves to the right in Arabic mode
 Keyboard navigation — arrow keys and Page Up/Down in Mushaf mode
 Copy ayahs — right-click to copy Arabic, English, or verse reference

flathub:io.github.idevecore.Valuta.name: Valuta
flathub:io.github.idevecore.Valuta.description: Valuta is a simple and fast conversion tool, ideal for those who need to convert between different currencies repeatedly. Use it while traveling, budgeting, or anytime else you need to quickly convert between two currencies.

flathub:io.github.lethal_guitar.RigelEng.name: RigelEngine
flathub:io.github.lethal_guitar.RigelEng.summary: A modern re-implementation of the classic DOS game Duke Nukem II
flathub:io.github.lethal_guitar.RigelEng.description:
RigelEngine is a re-implementation of the game Duke Nukem II, originally
 released by Apogee Software in 1993 for MS-DOS. It works as a drop-in
 replacement for the original executable: It reads the game's data files and
 plays just like the original, but runs natively on modern operating systems.
 On top of that, it offers various modern enhancements like higher frame rate,
 better game controller support, a wide-screen mode, quick saving etc.
 In order to run RigelEngine, the game data from the original game is required.
 Both the shareware version and the registered version work.
 You can grab the shareware version from archive.org:
 https://archive.org/download/msdos_DUKE2_shareware/DUKE2.zip

flathub:io.github.megakode.Wallrus.name: Wallrus
flathub:io.github.megakode.Wallrus.description:
Wallrus lets you create colorful abstract wallpapers.
 Start with one of several preset patterns and add effects like distortion, lighting, and noise.
 Pick a gradient from hundreds of bundled palettes or create your own, then export
 or set directly as your desktop wallpaper.

flathub:io.github.seadve.Mousai.name: Mousai
flathub:io.github.seadve.Mousai.description:
Discover songs you are aching to know with an easy-to-use interface.
 Mousai is a simple application that can recognize songs similar to Shazam. Just click the listen button, and then wait a few seconds. It will magically return the title and artist of that song!
 Note: This uses the API of audd.io, so it is necessary to log in to their site to get more trials.
 Why you will love Mousai?
 🎵 Identify songs within seconds or save for later when offline
 🎙️ Recognize from desktop audio or your microphone
 🎸 Build a repertoire of recognized songs
 🎼 Quickly preview the song within the interface
 🌐 Browse and listen the song from different providers
 📱 Easy-to-use user interface

flathub:io.github.toCase.Birchflow.name: Birchflow
flathub:io.github.toCase.Birchflow.description:
BirchFlow is a document management application designed to help you organize and track your contracts, counterparties, and related documents.
 With BirchFlow, you can:
 Group documents by linking them to specific contracts
 Track deadlines and financial obligations
 Archive documents once collaboration is complete
 BirchFlow is an invaluable tool for entrepreneurs, accountants, legal professionals, administrators—anyone who works with contracts and supporting files.

flathub:net.krafting.Playlifin.name: Playlifin
flathub:net.krafting.Playlifin.description:
A tool to convert a Youtube Music playlist to a Jellyfin playlists. You MUST have downloaded the playlist and put them on your Jellyfin before running this app.
 This program get all the song titles in your Youtube Playlist and try its best to find the same song on Jellyfin and add it in the new playlist.
 This is useful when you sort music by albums, genre or artists but still want to have your playlist after importing your music to Jellyfin.
 Recommended format to download a playlist with yt-dlp: /usr/bin/yt-dlp -x --audio-format mp3 --prefer-ffmpeg -o '%(title)s.%(ext)s' --embed-thumbnail (YoutubeURL)
 It uses the yt-dlp backend for fetching Youtube informations and the Jellyfin API for the Jellyfin informations.

flathub:org.cvfosammmm.Lemma.name: Lemma
flathub:org.cvfosammmm.Lemma.description:
Take notes with beautiful typography.
 Features include:
 Super-fast Page Management: Create pages by linking to them (just like in a wiki).
 Easy Math Entry: Edit mathematical expressions directly in the main text editor.
 Programming Support: Run Python scripts from within your documents and display the
 results.
 Convenient Import / Export: Add files and images with drag and drop or copy and
 paste, import/export Markdown files.
 And much much more: To-Do Lists, View Backlinks, Sidebars with Buttons for Emojis
 and Special Symbols, Bookmark Pages with Convenient Shortcuts, Full-Text Search, Editable Toolbars
 and Keyboard Shortcuts, ...

flathub:org.flathub.flatpak-external-dat.name: Flatpak External Data Checker

flathub:org.kde.ktrip.name: KTrip
flathub:org.kde.ktrip.description:
KTrip helps you navigate in public transport. It allows you to find journeys between specified
 locations, departures for a specific station and shows real-time delay and disruption information.

flathub:org.kekikakademi.eFatura.name: eFatura
flathub:org.kekikakademi.eFatura.summary: E-Invoice Usage Inquiry from Tax or TR Identity Number
flathub:org.kekikakademi.eFatura.description:
eFatura checks whether a given Tax Number or Turkish Identity Number
 (TC Kimlik No) is registered for e-invoice usage, by querying Turkey's
 official e-invoice inquiry system operated by the Revenue
 Administration (Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı).
 It is available as a native GTK4/Libadwaita desktop application, a
 command-line tool, and a Python library, so you can check a result the
 way that fits your workflow.

flathub:org.nongnu.lingot.name: Lingot
flathub:org.nongnu.lingot.description:
LINGOT is a musical instrument tuner. It's accurate, easy to use, and highly configurable. Originally
 conceived to tune electric guitars, it can now be used to tune other instruments.
 It looks like an analogue tuner, with a gauge indicating the relative shift to a certain note,
 determined automatically as the closest note to the estimated frequency.
 It's free software. LINGOT is distributed under the GPL license.
 It's really quick and accurate, perfect for real-time microtonal tuning.
 Easy to use. Just plug in your instrument and run it.
 LINGOT is a universal tuner. It can tune many musical instruments, you only need to provide
 the temperaments.
 Highly configurable via GUI. It’s possible to change any parameter while the program is running,
 without editing any file.

flathub:page.codeberg.elly_code.inscript.name: Inscriptions
flathub:page.codeberg.elly_code.inscript.description:
A fast, pretty, and ready translation app using DeepL free and paid API
 Some points of note:
 Nimble: Paste your DeepL api key (Whichever the plan), and here you go!
 Thoughtful: Just what you need, out of your way and a click away
 Comprehensive: No scary angry dialogs - If something goes wrong, explain nicely
 Lean: Limiting resource usage and internet communications to the minimum
 Supported languages: All those available via DeepL API!
 If you like this app please do not hesitate to donate to encourage its development!
 Libretranslate support is considered, but a heavy time and energy investment, so may or may not happen.

AUCTeX supports many different TeX macro packages, including AMS-TeX, LaTeX, Texinfo and basic support for ConTeXt. Documentation can be found under /usr/share/doc, e.g. the reference card (tex-ref.pdf) and the FAQ. The AUCTeX manual is available in Emacs info (C-h i d m AUCTeX RET). On the AUCTeX home page, we provide manuals in various formats. AUCTeX includes preview-latex support which makes LaTeX a tightly integrated component of your editing workflow by visualizing selected source chunks (such as single formulas or graphics) directly as images in the source buffer. fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2zjs.name: foo2zjs
fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2zjs.summary: Linux printer driver for ZjStream protocol
fedora-packages:foo2zjs/foo2zjs.description: foo2zjs is an open source printer driver for printers that use the Zenographics ZjStream wire protocol for their print data, such as the Minolta/QMS magicolor 2300 DL or Konica Minolta magicolor 2430 DL or HP LaserJet 1020 or HP LaserJet Pro P1102 or HP LaserJet Pro P1102w or HP LaserJet Pro CP1025nw. These printers are often erroneously referred to as winprinters or GDI printers. However, Microsoft GDI only mandates the API between an application and the printer driver, not the protocol on the wire between the printer driver and the printer. In fact, ZjStream printers are raster printers which happen to use a very efficient wire protocol which was developed by Zenographics and licensed by most major printer manufacturers for at least some of their product lines. ZjStream is just one of many wire protocols that are in use today, such as Postscript, PCL, Epson, etc.

fedora-packages:ga/ga-openmpi-static.description: The Global Arrays (GA) toolkit provides an efficient and portable "shared-memory" programming interface for distributed-memory computers. Each process in a MIMD parallel program can asynchronously access logical blocks of physically distributed dense multi- dimensional arrays, without need for explicit cooperation by other processes. Unlike other shared-memory environments, the GA model exposes to the programmer the non-uniform memory access (NUMA) characteristics of the high performance computers and acknowledges that access to a remote portion of the shared data is slower than to the local portion. The locality information for the shared data is available, and a direct access to the local portions of shared data is provided. - Static Libraries against OpenMPI.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-liealgdb/gap-pkg.name: gap-pkg-liealgdb

In the mathematics literature many classifications of Lie algebras of various types have been published (refer to the bibliography of the manual for a few examples). However, working with these classifications from paper is not always easy. This package aims at making a few classifications of small dimensional Lie algebras that have appeared in recent years more accessible. For each classification that is contained in the package, functions are provided that construct Lie algebras from that classification inside GAP. This allows the user to obtain easy access to the often rather complicated data contained in a classification, and to directly interface the Lie algebras to the functionality for Lie algebras which is already contained in GAP.

fedora-packages:ghc9.12/ghc9.12.description: GHC is a state-of-the-art, open source, compiler and interactive environment for the functional language Haskell. Highlights: - GHC supports the entire Haskell 2010 language plus a wide variety of extensions. - GHC has particularly good support for concurrency and parallelism, including support for Software Transactional Memory (STM). - GHC generates fast code, particularly for concurrent programs. Take a look at GHC's performance on The Computer Language Benchmarks Game. - GHC works on several platforms including Windows, Mac, Linux, most varieties of Unix, and several different processor architectures. - GHC has extensive optimisation capabilities, including inter-module optimisation. - GHC compiles Haskell code either directly to native code or using LLVM as a back-end. GHC can also generate C code as an intermediate target for porting to new platforms. The interactive environment compiles Haskell to bytecode, and supports execution of mixed bytecode/compiled programs. - Profiling is supported, both by time/allocation and various kinds of heap profiling. - GHC comes with several libraries, and thousands more are available on Hackage.

 Keep common tools within reach. Clear the current page’s cookies and storage, and export or import your configuration as JSON.
Compare user roles, test access controls, or keep client sessions separate without juggling browser profiles .

firefox-addons:306880.name: Kee - Password Manager
firefox-addons:306880.summary:
Save time, sign in easily to websites and avoid the hassle of forgotten password resets.
Protect yourself and people you know from the nightmare of your accounts being hacked.
firefox-addons:306880.description:
Secure and automatic sign in to all your favourite websites
 Protect your personal and financial data by letting Kee create and remember high security passwords for you
 Your passwords stay under your control, protected by the most popular and thoroughly tested open source secure password storage system
 Open source with no adverts
 No payment required 
Kee offers an easy and cheap password management solution via the Kee Vault service. This is available for a free trial period with no credit card required. If you decide that's not for you, the add-on can instead work with the free KeePass Password Safe 2 software and we offer step by step instructions for how to install and configure that to work on your Windows machine (and it can also be made to work on Mac and Linux with a bit more effort, with multiple guides existing to help in that endeavour)
 Who we are 
Kee has been the most highly rated Mozilla Firefox password management extension for nearly 10 years! The extension used to be called KeeFox and we have recently changed our icon to coincide with the announcement of the Kee Vault password manager service.
You can look forward to even more improvements this year and join the discussion on the community forum to let us know what features you'd most like to see developed next.
 Having trouble? 
If you would like to try Kee and it is not working for you, please use the help resources at https://forum.kee.pm/t/help-and-support/24 since requests for support within review comments will remain un-noticed for a year or longer.
You should pay particular attention to the full detailed installation instructions , getting started tutorial and any advice at the top of that page.
 Permissions 
Kee needs a variety of permissions to deliver it's functionality to you. We maintain a page on our website that details these permissions and why we require them .
 The built-in Firefox password manager will no longer prompt you to save passwords after you install this add-on. Any existing data will not be affected but you are strongly advised to delete any stored passwords from your Firefox password store in order to increase the security of your personal data and to avoid possible confusion in future.

firefox-addons:861775.name: PasswordMaker Pro
firefox-addons:861775.summary: Flexible password generator using a cryptographic hash algorithm of your choice - Fully Compatible with PasswordMaker.org
firefox-addons:861775.description:
Update rollup from v0.8.8.3 to v1.0.4- 2025-04-05
 Extension now requires at least Firefox v115.0! migration away from localStorage requires storage.session API referenced here: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Mozilla/Add-ons/WebExtensions/API/storage/session 
 Added timestamp to profiles by @spartanroc
 Added ability to sort profiles by modification time by @spartanroc
 Allow descriptions to be more than one line by @spartanroc
 Added option to show last profile modification on options page
 Added drag and drop of profiles to options page for issue #157 (drag & drop is disabled if alphanumeric or timestamp sort is enabled)
 Improve username and password filling
 Detect username field when sites separate username page and password page
 Add SHA-512 integrity check for sjcl.js so users know it's unmodified
 Browser agnostic now instead of Chrome specific
 Fixed and optimized regex profile matching
 Added section for sync information
 Added ability to set zoom level of popup
 Sync support should be fixed v2
 Source compatible with Firefox, Chrome, Edge and Opera
 Removed jQuery dependency!
 Added a description/notes field that was used in the original PasswordMaker
 Profile search function looks at profile name, site list, use this text, username and description
 Migrated from synchronous localStorage to asynchronous chrome.storage.(local|session) continuation of manifest v3 migration
 Changed default keyboard shortcut to Alt+X
 Migration to manifest v3 and use Clipboard API which removed 'clipboardRead' and 'clipboardWrite' from permissions
This is a browser extension that works for Chrome, Firefox, and other Chromium based browsers which is a flexible password generation tool that creates unique, secure passwords that are very easy for you to generate but no one else. Your passwords are never stored anywhere, anytime, so there's no database to be hacked, lost, or stolen; unlike the many popular password managers available.
To use, click the golden ring and provide PasswordMaker with at least two pieces of information:
1) A "master password" -- that one, single password you like 
2) The URL of the website requiring a password
3) Customize per website password generation settings (optional)
PasswordMaker will then generate a unique password using a one-way hash algorithm of your choosing to generate a unique password for every website which is both extremely configurable and user friendly.
This technique has been widely used since 2003 and is 100% compatible with the other versions of PasswordMaker for other devices and computers which you can find at https://www.passwordmaker.org/ for more information. So, if you switch to a different platform, you can still easily generate all your passwords, for all your sites as long as you can remember your master password and password profile setting for the site.
Since I have inherited this project I have added many new and useful features such as strength meters, username form filling, removed all dangerous extension permissions, HiDPI display scaling, added PBKDF2 & AES encryption where needed, and many other visual, usability and performance enhancements. :)
It is advisable to always keep a back-up of your current profile data!
If there are any suggestions, feedback or issues please report a new issue https://github.com/passwordmaker/chrome-passwordmaker/issues or start a new discussion https://github.com/passwordmaker/chrome-passwordmaker/discussions on GitHub.

bluejetty:00174351:ios.description:
Take control of your money — one day at a time.
Today’s Budget gives you a simpler, calmer way to manage your spending.
Instead of complicated budgets, endless categories, and cluttered dashboards, it helps you focus on one clear number: how much you can safely spend today.
Built around intentional manual tracking, Today’s Budget keeps you aware of your spending as it happens. Log what you spend, see the impact immediately, and build better money habits day by day.
It’s a more thoughtful way to budget: focused, flexible, and designed for real life.
[ Why Today’s Budget feels different ]
One number — right when you need it:
Add your income, bills, and savings goals, and the app calculates your available spending for today.
Manual tracking that builds awareness:
Logging expenses yourself helps you stay mindful and in control, without the friction of a complicated system.
Flexible by nature:
Spend less today, and you’ll have more tomorrow. Spend more, and the app adjusts. Clear, honest, and guilt-free.
Save steadily over time:
Create savings jars for future plans, bigger purchases, or your emergency fund.
Focused design:
No feature overload. No distracting dashboards. Just what matters most.
Private by design:
No ads. No tracking. No bank linking. Your data stays on your device and in iCloud.
Made to fit everyday life:
With widgets, Apple Watch support, shared wallets, CSV export, and multiple wallets, Today’s Budget works the way you do.
[ A great fit for people who want ]
• a simpler alternative to traditional budgeting apps
• a more mindful, hands-on approach to spending
• an ADHD-friendly way to stay aware of money
• privacy without compromise
[ Features ]
• Daily budget calculator
• Shared wallets
• Expense tracking
• Recurring income and bills
• Savings goals
• Emergency fund tracking
• Various Widgets and Apple Watch support
• Insights and charts
• CSV export
• iCloud sync
• No ads, no bank linking, no tracking
Start fresh, stay aware, and make budgeting feel beautifully simple.

bluejetty:00041104:ios.name: Whist Game لعبة الويست
bluejetty:00041104:ios.summary: الويست هي لعبة ورق قديمة مليئة بالمتعة والندية والشغف محكومة بقوانين وقواعد متقنة، تعد لعبة الويست من أقدم وأشهر ألعاب الورق في العالم ومنها اقتبست أغلب ألعاب الورق المنتشرة حاليا", حيث أنها بدات في القرن الثامن عشر لتجد مكانها في المناسبات
bluejetty:00041104:ios.description:
الويست هي لعبة ورق قديمة مليئة بالمتعة والندية والشغف محكومة بقوانين وقواعد متقنة، تعد لعبة الويست من أقدم وأشهر ألعاب الورق في العالم ومنها اقتبست أغلب ألعاب الورق المنتشرة حاليا", حيث أنها بدات في القرن الثامن عشر لتجد مكانها في المناسبات الاجتماعية والتحدي المباشر بين أربع لاعبين يمثل كل أثنين فريق واحد, تعد لعبة الويست اللعبة الأكثر احترافية بين أوراق اللعب الحالية بسبب القوانين الصارمة في اللعبة مما يزيد التحدي بين اللاعبين والمتعة مع كل فوز يحققه الفريق.
• أنماط اللعب:
١. اللعب الجماعي online 
٢. طاولة خاصة؛ حيث يقوم اللاعب بإنشاء طاولته الخاصة و دعوة الأصدقاء للعب عن طريق الرابط أوالكود الكتابي للإنضمام للعب
٣. اللعب مع الكمبيوتر Offline 
• يوجد خيارين للعب في اللعب الجماعي والطاولة الخاصة:
١. +/- 25 (الفريق الحاصل على +25 يعتبر الفائز, والفريق الحاصل على -25 يعد الخاسر(أيهما أولا)
٢. خمس شوتات, وهي 5 جولات للعب بانتهائها يعتبر الحاصل على أكبر عدد نقاط هو الفريق الفائز, وقد تنتهي اللعبة قبل انتهاء الأشواط في حال حصل أحد الفريقين على +25 أو -25.
• نمط اللعب مع الكمبيوتر يوجد به خيارين للعب:
١. خمس شوتات (بنفس الأنماط السابقة) 
٢. شوتة واحدة يفوز بها صاحب النقاط الأكثر
• مزايا اللعبة:
- تتيح لك لعبة الويست التنافس الحقيقي بين اللاعبين واكتساب نقاط الخبرة والكوينز بعد كل فوز والتي تزيد كلما فاز اللعب بمرات أكثر 
- التنافس مع لاعبين حقيقيين على مدار الساعة 
- سهولة التسجيل عن طريق فيسبوك, غوغل وابل للحفاظ على نقاط الخبرة والكوينز
- مشاركة الانجازات في اللعبة مع الأصدقاء عن طريق وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي
- دعم فني للاعبين على مدار الساعة عبر الإيميل الرسمي للعبة ووسائل التواصل الاجتماعي
- لا يوجد إعلانات مزعجة للاعبين, للتمتع بتجربة لعب لاتنسى
- تتمز لعبة الويست بسهولة الاستخدام وبساطة تجربة اللعب مما يسهل على اللاعب التأقلم على اللعبة بشكل أسرع
- قائمة أساتذة الويست, وهي قائمة بأعلى اللاعبين حصولا على النقاط خلال الأسبوع, الشهر والترتيب العام للاعبين
- يوجد تعبيرات كتابية وصوتية خاصة باللعبة لزيادة الإثارة والحماس باللعبة مع إمكانية الشات الكتابي في نمط الطاولة الخاصة
EULA
https://plesk.whistgame.link/en/terms

bluejetty:00015508:ios.description:
My Pretend Airport - Kids Travel Town Sensory Game lets you pretend play in an Airport & Travel Town setting!
Grab your luggage, and head over to the Main Terminal where you can shop for gifts, grab snacks, drinks & coffee before your flight!
Play in the Airplane Cabin & explore all the cubbies, nooks & crannies inside!
Place your luggage on the scanner, and see if any items get picked up by the X-Ray machine!
Drag & drop kids, pilots, & other fun characters, and place them into the scenes like a pretend dollhouse.

bluejetty:00166054:ios.description:
FoxStoria is a read-along app for kids. Listen to narrated stories with highlighted words, read aloud to Mr. Fox with Reading Buddy, or record a story in your voice. Make bedtime a moment to share.
READ, LISTEN AND EXPLORE
• Illustrated stories. Explore picture books and children's tales with music and sound effects.
• Read aloud. Listen to available narration and follow the story at your own pace. Word highlighting is available for supported story languages.
• Reading Buddy. Practice reading English stories aloud with speech recognition, prompts and progress feedback. Availability varies by story.
• Record your voice. Record yourself reading a favorite story so your child can hear your voice at bedtime or when you are apart.
• Story Robot. Turn an idea into a personalized illustrated story. Choose a theme and create a new adventure together.
• Coloring and activities. Take a creative break with coloring pages, games and activities inspired by stories.
• A world to explore. Find stories and activities on the interactive map with Mr. Fox as your guide.
FOR FAMILY STORYTIME
Choose a bedtime story, take turns reading a page or record a tale for later. Stories have different reading levels, so you can find a starting point that suits your child.
The app interface is available in English, Russian and Arabic. Story translations, narration and reading features vary by book and language. Arabic narration is available for selected stories; Arabic speech-based reading coaching is not currently available.
DESIGNED WITH PARENTS IN MIND
• No advertising.
• Parental gates protect purchases, external links, sharing and parent email settings.
• Parents can explore reading activity and set reading goals with their child.
Access to the full library and some features may require a paid FoxStoria Premium subscription. In-app coin purchases are also available for creating additional stories with Story Robot.
Choose a story and make it your own: read it together, listen, or record it in the voice your child knows best.
Terms of Service: https://foxstoria.com/terms-of-service/?ui_lang=en
Privacy Policy: https://foxstoria.com/privacy-policy/?ui_lang=en

bluejetty:00129540:ios.description:
Dual Messenger Web is a simple and efficient tool that allows you to manage multiple chat accounts on a single device using secure web-based access. With an easy QR code scanning process, you can connect and mirror your chat sessions across devices and stay connected anytime.
The app is designed to provide a smooth and reliable experience for users who want to access multiple accounts or use the same account on different devices. All you need to do is scan the QR code and your session will be instantly connected.
Key Features
Multi Account Access
Use multiple chat accounts on one device or access the same account across multiple devices using web-based login.
QR Code Scanner
Quickly scan and connect your chat sessions. The scanner also supports multiple formats including text, URLs, contacts, and more.
Direct Chat
Send messages to any number without saving it to your contacts. This makes communication faster and more convenient.
Stylish Text and Status
Create unique and creative text styles, quotes, and status messages that can be shared across different platforms.
Image to Text
Extract text from images instantly using advanced recognition and reuse it wherever needed.
Message Scheduler
Schedule messages to be sent at your preferred time and manage your communication more effectively.
Secure and Easy to Use
The app provides a simple interface with fast performance. No data is stored on external servers and all sessions are handled securely.
Disclaimer

Ready to get started? Download to start clipping, saving, and doing more with the new Family Dollar app!

bluejetty:00085427:ios.description:
LINES is the nightlife app built by the community, for the community. People already out are dropping live video updates showing line lengths, crowd vibes, and how busy spots really are.
In London and want to know which club is popping? In Sydney, Melbourne, or Brisbane and looking for the best events tonight? The app of Bondi Lines, Melbourne Lines, London Lines & Brisbane Lines? LINES puts the whole scene in your pocket. 
You don’t just watch the night unfold. You can be part of it before you even arrive. Every major event has its own live chat, so you can ask questions, share updates, and see what people are saying in real time. Wondering how long the line is, what the vibe is like, or if it’s worth heading over now? Just ask the crowd already there.
Here’s what you’ll get:
• Live videos from inside venues across London, Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and more
• Real-time updates on lines outside clubs, bars, and festivals
• A heatmap that shows you where the city is buzzing
• Event chats to connect with other people going to the same party
• Crowd forecasts so you know the best time to show up
• A feed of upcoming gigs, raves, and parties near you
• Ticket links that get you straight in
• Exclusive perks like free entry or free drinks at select spots
• Filters to find your scene: genre, price, age group, or area
• Follow venues, promoters, and artists you love
Whether you’re into clubs, raves, bars, festivals, or live music, Lines makes it easy to figure out where to head next — powered by live updates from the people already there.
Now live in:
United Kingdom
• London Lines nightlife & events
Australia
• Sydney Lines nightlife & events

• Brisbane Lines nightlife & events

• Gold Coast Lines nightlife & events

London Lines, Bondi Lines, Sydney Lines, Melbourne Lines, Brisbane Lines — wherever the night takes you, Lines shows you what’s happening in real time.

Cash Wild is a thrilling game that combines two all-time favorites into one exciting experience: the strategic challenge of classic Solitaire and the non-stop excitement of slot machines! Imagine playing a relaxing game of Solitaire, clearing cards with skill and strategy, and then heading straight into the spinning reels of a slot machine for an adrenaline-pumping jackpot moment. That’s the magic of Cash Wild. With every move, every spin, and every win, you’ll feel the thrill of chasing big rewards – all while playing at your own pace, anytime and anywhere.
Why You’ll Love Cash Wild
Innovative Gameplay Fusion
Switch seamlessly between Solitaire and Slots. Play hands of Solitaire to unlock spins, then use your spins to hit jackpots and special bonuses!
Win Real Rewards – Totally Free

Daily Challenges & Exciting Events

Relax or Compete – It’s Your Choice
Whether you prefer a relaxing Solitaire session or the heart-pounding rush of Slots, Cash Wild lets you play however you like.
Play Anytime, Anywhere

How It Works
Play Solitaire Rounds – Clear decks and earn cups as you master challenging levels.
Unlock Spins – Every successful round earns spins for the slot machine.
Spin for Rewards – Use your spins to win coins, jackpots, and even real prizes.
Keep Progressing – The more you play, the more opportunities you unlock to climb leaderboards and claim rewards.
This unique loop keeps gameplay exciting and gives you multiple ways to play, whether you love thoughtful strategy or fast-paced action.
Key Features
- Classic Solitaire gameplay with smooth, modern design
- Dynamic slots experience with multiple reels and bonus rounds
- Generous daily rewards to keep you spinning

- Fair Play Guarantee

- No purchases necessary to win rewards
All prizes are free to claim and are based on gameplay performance, not on chance or spending.
Join the Fun Today
Are you ready to experience the perfect mix of Solitaire mastery and Slots excitement?
Download Cash Wild now to spin, play, and win big – all for free!
Play a few hands, spin the reels, and feel the rush of victory. Your next big win could be just a spin away!

bluejetty:00076612:ios.description:
NEKO GOLF puts the feel of realistic golf play at your fingertips!
Hone your skills and challenge the world's strongest players, or take it easy and enjoy a relaxing round while talking with friends!
Tour vast courses with players from around the world!
You can choose the display language in the app from English,繁体字,简体字,한국어,日本語.
＜NEKO GOLF Features＞
◆The thrill of real golf on your mobile device! ◆
Recreates the experience of being on the green（＾＾）
Getting nervous and hitting a duff...(your finger slipped)
A delayed slice of the club...(you swiped too slowly)
Your foot slips and throws off your slice...(A hard-to-hit shot)
You've never experienced a game of golf like this!
◆Unique interface captures the feeling of a real golf shot◆
Super simple controls: just slide & flick!
But technique is important if you want to hit an accurate shot!
◆Enjoy thrilling gameplay with opponents from around the world◆
You can play against users from all over the world in a "Golf Tour", where you can stack up wins to elevate your rank!
◆2 Play Modes◆
"Enjoy Mode" - play a casual game of golf!
"Battle Mode" - compete for the best score!
"Enjoy Mode"
Enjoy a casual game of golf without worrying about who wins.
The better your score, the more Tour Points you'll get!
"Battle Mode"
Compete for the best score against your opponent.
The winner will receive more Tour Points than you would in "Enjoy Mode",
but the losing player won't get any points.
◆Enhanced communication◆
Players can easily communicate with each other through stickers and voice chat!
Enjoy a game of golf while talking with your friends!
※Players must be 13 or older to use voice chat
◆Collecting and Enhancing Clubs◆
NEKO GOLF features many types of golf clubs with various characteristics!
Rapidly expand your strategic range by collecting and enhancing your clubs!
◆Popular characters from the Shironeko Series take to the green as pro golfers!◆
Debuting as 3D model avatars for the first time!
Character voices by the magnificent cast of "Shironeko Project"!
【Cast】
Hero Golfer (CV: Yuki Kaji)
Charlotte (CV: Maaya Uchida)
Oscurol (CV: Ai Kayano)
Liam (CV: Yuuichiro Umehara)
Yukimura (CV: Noriaki Sugiyama)
Airis (CV: Yui Horie)
Chako (CV: Runa Onodera)
◆Character Customization◆
When it comes to playing golf, fashion comes first!
Enjoy playing golf with your own custom look using clothing and accessories tailored to each character!
▼ You'll love NEKO GOLF if you:▼
・Are curious about golf games
・Love sports games
・Love competitive games
・Are familiar with Shironeko Project
・Are familiar with Shironeko Tennis
・Are looking for a game that can be played to its full potential
・Have been searching for free games to play

・Are searching for a fun strategy game
・Want to play a game oriented toward players' skills
・Want to play with users from around the world
・Are interested in e-sports
・Are searching for a game that features cute characters
・Want to freely customize your characters
・Want to play games with voice chat

iOS 13 3GB or greater

bluejetty:00128234:ios.description:
A fierce ghost is coming! The corridor is in great danger.Everyone could be hunted. The only way to survive is to hide in the room behind the door.
Maybe you're wondering what the hell is this? This is a tower defense and escape game.
Do you want to challenge yourself? Want to release your stress? Whatever you want, I can help you get it, as long as you lie down on a bed.
Back to the topic, this is a horror-style tower defense and escape game.
In the game, players need to escape the pursuit of ghosts and find a suitable dormitory to survive in.
Build and upgrade turrets and fend off evil spirits.
In the game, players can only build facilities on the empty floor in the room. After the empty floor is clicked on, the building menu will pop up.
In the game, players need to selectively build facilities according to their own economic status, so as to expand their advantages step by step.
If the player defeats the ghost, you won the game, and if the player is eliminated by the ghost, you lost the game.
Our Facebook fanpage: https://www.facebook.com/haunteddorm/
Words from the developer
Hunted Dorm is now online! I'm glad to be here to talk to you players. We're working on the next version, and we'll give priority to the online multiplayer mode, so you'll be able to experience the fun of fighting with others soon. More interesting buildings and modes of play will also be unlocked.
If you have any good ideas and suggestions, please leave them in the comments section!

bluejetty:00017739:ios.summary:

Use your existing Coast360 Online banking login to get st
bluejetty:00017739:ios.description:
From everyday account management to mobile check deposits, the Coast360 Mobile App helps you take care of your everyday finances from your favorite mobile device anytime, anywhere. 
Use your existing Coast360 Online banking login to get started or, if you’re a first time user, create your login credentials right from the mobile banking app.
Use Coast360 Mobile to: 
• Securely check account balances, recent activity and transaction history
• Deposit checks quickly and view images of cleared checks
• Transfer money between accounts, including your accounts at other financial institutions
• Pay monthly bills and set up new payees
• Locate Coast360 ATMs and member centers
Additional Features include:
• Fingerprint & Facial Authentication – log in with the touch of a finger or facial recognition
• Instant Balance – view your balance instantly prior to logging in
• Travel Notifications – notify us of upcoming travel plans to ensure uninterrupted access during your next trip
• Card Control – enjoy all the features of Card Control through Coast360 Mobile
Requirements
Coast360 Mobile Banking works with devices using iOS 13+
Transfer Limits
• Checking accounts: There are no limits on the number of transfers you can make in a calendar month.
• Savings accounts: You can make up to six total transfers to another account or a third party in a calendar month per federal regulations. 
Security
Coast360 Mobile uses Transport Layer Security (TLS) encryption to communicate securely through all mobile service providers. Security measures block unauthorized access and protect your data, no matter how you access your accounts.
Permissions
• Location permissions are needed to determine your location in order to find ATMs.
• Camera permissions are needed to deposit checks.
Disclosures 
Using Coast360 Mobile constitutes acceptance and/or reaffirmation of Coast360’s Privacy Policy and Online Terms and Conditions. Message and data rates may apply with your mobile carrier.
Deposit limits and other restrictions apply. Coast360 mobile deposit service is subject to eligibility. Some features are available for eligible members and accounts only. All deposits are subject to the Coast360’s Funds Availability Policy. Refer to Coast360’s Account Agreement and Disclosures for more information. Please retain your check for 90 days before destroying.
Contact Us
www.coast360fcu.com
(671) 477-8736 
Toll-free from U.S. 1-866-217-4858

You’re a creator, pouring your heart into your craft, sharing your stories, your art, your voice with the world. But sometimes, the path feels scattered – where do you find the right connections & opportunities?
What if growing as a creator didn’t have to be complicated? Collective Artists Network’s flagship super-app for the creator economy: Big Bang Social (BBS) is not just an app; it’s a space built keeping creators in mind.
Whether you’re just getting started or already making waves as an influencer, Big Bang Social (BBS) is here to simplify the chaos. It’s where you can connect with brands that truly get your vibe, offer tools to grow your audience and even discover new ways to make money doing what you love.
Our latest Auto Payout feature is here to tackle something many creators struggle with—delayed payments. Now, you don’t have to chase payments or worry about when they’ll come through. With instant payments, it’s one less thing for you to stress about, so you can focus on what really matters—your content and growth.
Here’s what you can do on Big Bang Social: 
Unmatched Collaboration Opportunities
You’ve been putting in the work, building your brand, and now it’s time to level up with the right collaborations. Big Bang Social (BBS) opens the doors to awesome opportunities with top brands like AJIO, Myntra, H&M, and Amazon & more. 
No matter your niche—fashion, beauty, tech, lifestyle, or beyond—our influencer marketing platform connects you with brands that match your vibe.
Exclusive Creator Tools 
Each of our tools is designed keeping creators in mind, and helps you plan content, boost engagement and unlock new ways to monetize your influence. Our creator tools are completely free to use.
- The Daily: Your go-to calendar to stay updated with upcoming quirky & trendy dates to stay ahead of the curve and never miss any topical day.
- QR Code Generator: Create and share QR codes for your content, links, and location in a few clicks.
- Linkit: Our link management tool helps you organize and share all your important links in one place. Create a customizable landing page for your socials, websites, affiliate links, videos, and more—perfect for your link-in-bio!
- Creator Score: The score helps you track your growth and measure your success as a creator. It compiles data on your content performance, audience engagement, and overall influence.
- Affiliate Store: Create custom affiliate links, promote them through your content, and earn commissions every time your followers make a purchase.
For Creators, By Creators: Your Community Awaits
Every creator has a story, but the journey often feels lonely. That’s where our communities come in; a space where creators connect, learn, & grow together.
Join networks of like-minded creators who understand your challenges and share your ambitions. Exchange ideas, discover new perspectives, and build meaningful collaborations that push you forward.
Step into exclusive events crafted just for creators. From workshops to meetups, each experience is designed to inspire, educate, and help you create your best work.
Learn directly from industry experts through masterclasses that tackle everything from storytelling to landing brand partnerships, equipping you with the tools to level up.
This is more than a platform- it’s your creative circle, your support system, and your launchpad to greater influence. Ready to grow with a community that gets you?

- Download the BBS app
- Sign up using your mobile number 
- Verify your Instagram in just one click & you’re ready to go

Join our WhatsApp Channel:

● A Photography Oasis
Step into a world where creativity meets clarity. Showcase your photography in high resolution and let every detail shine as you intended. With 500px, your work gets the space and attention it deserves—without distractions.
● Bring Your Stories to Life with Video
Photography doesn’t have to stand still. Upload and share high-resolution videos alongside your photos, all from the same 500px profile and gallery. Connect with the community through likes, comments, and shares, and tell more complete visual stories through both photo and motion.
● Your AI Creative Co-Pilot
Make every upload easier with AI-powered tools built for photographers. Get automatically generated titles, descriptions, keywords, and tags based on your images, then edit them to make them your own. Spend less time writing and more time creating.
● Learn from Every Shot
Get instant, constructive feedback with AI Photo Critique. Receive insights into composition, exposure, color, technical quality, and artistic elements, along with actionable suggestions to help you improve. Combine AI-powered feedback with perspectives from photographers around the world and keep growing with every shot.
● Turn Passion Into Profit
Transform your creativity into opportunity through Getty Images licensing. Get your photography discovered for commercial use and turn your best work into a source of income.
● Get Seen from Day One
Make an impact from your very first upload. Share your work with a global community of photographers, receive feedback, build connections, and grow your audience among people who appreciate photography.
● Challenge Yourself with Photo Battles
Put your photography to the test with 500px Quests: Photo Battles. Go head-to-head with other photographers around a specific theme, let the community decide the winner, and earn prizes, badges, and recognition along the way. Turn creative challenges into opportunities to grow, compete, and be seen.
● Take Your Photography Further with Premium
Unlock more of your photography journey with a 500px Premium subscription. Enjoy unlimited uploads, detailed statistics, offline viewing, and other premium features designed to help you create, share, and grow.

bluejetty:00135579:ios.description:
Welcome to Dragon island, a fantasy island where many adventures keep happening.
Adventures on islands with dragons! Grow alpha dragons and explore islands harboring fun and mysteries.
Collect the resources on islands, grow your dragons, and discover new dragon islands.
Find the hidden sagas of dragon islands and explore the islands with full of secret quests - you will have great fun continuously disovering new content.
Discover the story of the Hidden Dragon Island, the island where the quests are hidden, and feel the joy of discovering new content.
DRAGON ISLAND FEATUERS 
Raising a dragon: The fun of discovering and growing alpha dragons!
Collect various resources on Dragon Island, hatch & evolve baby dragons until they transform into powerful alpha dragons.
Experience the joy of helping tiny and cute hatchlings grow into huge dragons. 
Explore the fantastic Dragon Island: Explore new world, acquire and utilize new resources
Get the resources in the island and uprade your island.
Harvest sweet dragon fruit and raise your dragon!
The more dragon-loving pig barbecues and fish you make to earn eggs, the more you can meet the upgraded islands.
Enjoy the upgrade: Become the best dragon trainer! 
Become a dragon mania of dragon island.
You can upgrade your character and worker dragons to grow them efficiently and create more powerful dragons.
Easy and stress-free game
Easy playing is possible with just a light swipe with one finger.
Anyone can enjoy the game with cute dragons without any trouble or stress.
Play anytime, anywhere with no time limit.
Collecting my own pets: Upgrade to Dragon Mania!
You can build a collection of pet dragons that you have raised.
Collected pet dragons will help resource production be easier by helping the work around the island, increasing the speed of production, and etc.
Enjoy the fun, achievement, strategic play of building a pet collection.
Become Dragon Mania with Dragon Island!

Step into the enchanting world of Design Dream Room, a simulation game where you can curate your perfect living space. Whether it's a cozy bedroom, a chic living room, or an elegant dining room, the game offers a diverse range of rooms to unleash your interior design prowess. Transform each space into a personalized haven, where your creativity knows no bounds.

- Multi-Room Design: Explore and design various rooms, including bedrooms, living rooms, dining areas, and more, each offering a unique canvas for your creativity.
- Furniture Galore: Access an extensive array of furniture options tailored to each room type, allowing you to express your design flair with diverse themes and styles.
- Customization Variety: Experiment with a plethora of accessories, decor items, and color schemes, ensuring that each room is a reflection of your distinct taste.
- Immersive Room Experiences: Enjoy a fully immersive design experience, with detailed room settings that bring your virtual spaces to life.

Ontdek onze beste artikelen, te herkennen aan het Premium label. Log in en lees tot 3 gratis Premium artikelen per maand. Je kunt een abonnement nemen via het aanbod in de app of via de website (https://www.ad.nl/abonnementen)

Heb je via de App Store een gratis proefabonnement genomen, en wil je dit omzetten naar een betaald abonnement? Dat kan met je iTunes account en Apple ID. Het eventuele resterende deel van de gratis proefperiode komt te vervallen.

Dit kan op je iPad of iPhone via Instellingen > iTunes en App Store > Apple ID > Toon Apple ID > Beheer abonnementen. Let op: reeds betaalde bedragen worden niet terugbetaald.
Aanbiedingen voor abonnementen zijn alleen geldig voor nieuwe abonnees.
Enkele apparaten worden niet ondersteund door de AD app. Heb je problemen met het downloaden van de app? Lees dan verder bij ‘additional information’.

How do we send signals?
- Our algorithms monitor OPRA options
bluejetty:00174535:ios.description:
FLOW Trades app alerts you with real time options & stocks signals through push notifications. These include buy and sell recommendations based on market trend and option flows.
How do we send signals?
- Our algorithms monitor OPRA options flows of hundreds of symbols and alert our analysts with recommended flows.
- Our analysts evaluate the flows, market trend and do technical analysis before sending out an alert to the app.
Each BUY alert include the Entry, Next Target and Stop Loss. After a target or stop loss has reached, the app sends another real time alert.
Use the search button to find the live quote and interactive chart for any symbol. The stock detail page also provides all the statistics of the symbol and earnings info.
Any kind of trading involves a lot of risk. Please check our terms and disclaimer in the App.
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
Paid subscription is required to access all the signals. Free version will have limited number of signals.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store.
Terms of Use:
https://www.vividsignals.net/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy:
https://www.vividsignals.net/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00149437:ios.description:
DESCRIPTION:
On-Demand, Outdoor Home Services
PLOWZ & MOWZ offers the on-demand, contract-free seasonal services homeowners need to spruce up their property year-round. Join our fleet of five-star contractors who take care of almost anything between your driveway and your door. Getting more work has never been faster, easier, or more efficient. We have worked to expand the residential market for landscapers by increasing their route density, enhancing cash flow, and eliminating bad debt and marketing costs. You now have your own customer service & marketing team right in your pocket!
SERVICES: 
-Lawn Mowing
-Snow Removal
-Yard Cleanup
-Fertilization
-Aeration & Overseeding
-Pruning & Trimming
-Gutter Cleaning
-Driveway Sealing
-Powerwashing
-Haul Away
-Custom Orders 
HOW IT WORKS:
It’s simple! Just head to the app/website and sign up to join our fleet.
Once you’ve entered some basic information, one of our representatives will be in touch to set you up on our platform.
Contractors are required to have commercial grade equipment and general liability insurance to become live.
Once live, contractors will be able to start picking up jobs and payments will be made through direct deposit for every job.
24/7 Live Customer Support. 
CONTRACTOR QUOTE:
“It just fills a gap in our current routes. We don’t have to gather customer information, we don’t have to gather their billing information, and we don’t have to bill them after the service is completed. All we have to do is show up to the job, plow it and send a picture when it’s completed” - Jeff D., NY
IN THE PRESS:
“Using technology to optimize existing coverage routes.” AXIOS
“Plowz & Mowz continues to gain traction.” Total Landscape Care
"A Solution for people who don't want to shovel their driveways" CNN
"Lawn Mowing? There's an app for that” USA Today
WEBSITES/CONTACTS:
For more information or to sign up as a provider visit www.plowzandmowz.com 
Contact Info: hello@plowz.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/plowzapp

bluejetty:00160711:ios.description:
Unlock Your Mind's Full Potential with Binaura
Join millions improving Sleep, Productivity, Memory and Relaxation with Binaura. We harness science-backed binaural beats, healing frequencies, and AI technology to transform your mind and body.
WHY CHOOSE BINAURA
• Science-Backed & AI-Powered Technology
• Binaura combines neuroscience with advanced AI algorithms to deliver personalized soundscapes tailored to your unique needs 
• Each session aligns with your brainwave patterns to optimize focus, sleep, relaxation, and meditation
REAL RESULTS FOR REAL PEOPLE
• Double Your Productivity: Users report a significant increase in task completion and reduced distractions by up to 70%.
• Fall Asleep in 10 Minutes: Experience deep sleep faster with our sleep sounds and wake up feeling 3x more refreshed.
• Reduce Stress in 5 Minutes: Quick relief sessions help you relax and regain mental clarity.
• Improve Memory & Mental Clarity: Enhance cognitive functions and manage ADHD symptoms effectively with our frequency healing sounds.
JOIN MILLIONS WHO HAVE TRANSFORMED THEIR LIVES
Over 4 million users worldwide have improved their mental performance with Binaura's AI-enabled personalized approach. Join professionals who have found balance with our mindfulness techniques and healing sounds.
FEATURES AT A GLANCE
• Beautiful Interface: Navigate effortlessly through a sleek, intuitive design that enhances your user experience. Now with full support of the Liquid Glass design for iOS 26 users!
• AI-Personalized Sessions: App's AI Assistant will personalize your soundscapes for deeper Sleep, Focus and Meditation, using our advanced AI datasets to meet your specific goals.
• Neuro Sound Feedback & Customization: Adjust and personalize sound frequencies like 432 Hz and 528 Hz using our sonic tone generator to align with your unique brainwave patterns for optimal results.
• AI Streams - unique adaptive AI-powered streams that respond to your active signals — heart rate, time of day, and fitness activity. Your sound experience now dynamically adjusts to your body and lifestyle, helping you focus, relax, or recover like never before.
• Daily and weekly Events and Challenges with unique rewards to keep your win streaks going hard and help achieve your goals in structured way!
• Deep Integration with native iOS features - Health, Fitness, Heart BPM, Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight, Live Activities, Widgets and much more!
HOW IT WORKS
Binaura utilizes the science of binaural beats, frequency healing, and neurofeedback to influence your brainwave patterns. By presenting two slightly different frequencies (e.g., 432 Hz, 528 Hz, theta waves) to each ear, your brain produces a third tone—a binaural beat—that encourages your brainwaves to align with the desired frequency.
Our AI technology enhances this experience by analyzing your usage patterns and preferences, creating personalized soundscapes that adapt over time to maximize effectiveness. Whether you're dealing with insomnia, seeking to manage ADHD, or aiming to enhance your spirituality and mindfulness, Binaura provides the tools to balance your mind and body.
TESTIMONIALS
• "I've tried many apps like Brain.fm, Endel, and Mellow Flow, but Binaura is the only one that helps me concentrate while studying." — Sarah L.
• "As someone with ADHD, the personalized frequency healing sounds have been a game-changer." — Alex M.
• "Falling asleep has never been easier. The sleepwave sounds are magical!" — Michael T.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Free Trial: Enjoy a 3-day free trial with full access to all features.
• Premium Membership: unlimited access on a monthly or yearly subscription. The price for your country is shown on this page before you buy.
• Cancel Anytime: No commitment. Cancel through your App Store account settings.
Privacy and Support
• Privacy Policy: https://binaura.app/privacy
• Terms of Service: https://binaura.app/terms
• Support: Need help? Contact us at support@binaura.app

bluejetty:00160480:ios.description:
Our app provides robust two-factor authentication (2FA) and multi-factor authentication (MFA), ensuring that your sensitive information stays protected. 
Features:
- Two-Factor Authentication (2FA): 
Boost your account security by adding an additional layer of protection beyond just your password. Our app generates secure, unique one-time passwords (OTPs) that are required along with your regular login credentials.
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): 
For even more security, our app supports MFA, adding another step in the authentication process. This offers multiple authentication methods for a stronger defense.
- TOTP and HOTP Support: 
Our app supports both Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) and HMAC-Based One-Time Password (HOTP) protocols, allowing you to secure a wide variety of services and platforms.
- Backup & Restore: 
Ensure your authentication data is never lost with our backup and restore feature. Securely save your information and retrieve it when necessary.
- User-Friendly Design: 
Our app features a simple and intuitive interface, making it easy to configure and manage your 2FA and MFA settings, regardless of your technical expertise.
- Encrypted Data Storage: 
All sensitive information is protected with advanced encryption, guaranteeing that your data remains secure from unauthorized access.
Experience top-level online security by downloading our app today and take control of your digital safety.
Subscription Details:
- Payment is processed through your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, with the renewal cost clearly indicated.
- Users can manage their subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited upon subscription purchase, where applicable.

bluejetty:00089139:ios.name: Pelago Health
bluejetty:00089139:ios.summary: Pelago provides virtual substance use support for individuals who want to change their relationship with alcohol, tobacco, or opioids. Pelago may be available at no cost to you through your employee benefits. Or, it may be available to you
bluejetty:00089139:ios.description:
Pelago provides virtual substance use support for individuals who want to change their relationship with alcohol, tobacco, or opioids. Pelago may be available at no cost to you through your employee benefits. Or, it may be available to you as part of your health plan, and the cost may vary.
Check if Pelago is provided through your employer or benefits provider: http://pelagohealth.com/how-it-works/for-members/
Read more about our terms of use, privacy policy, and EULA:
‣ https://www.pelagohealth.com/terms/
‣ https://www.pelagohealth.com/privacy
‣ https://signup.pelagohealth.com/?terms_of_use
Pelago can help members with the following substance use goals: 
‣ Reduce alcohol consumption, quit drinking, or explore a sober curious lifestyle 
‣ Quit or cut back on tobacco use (cigarettes, smokeless tobacco, cigars, cigarillos, roll-your-own tobacco, pipe)
‣ Quit or cut back on vaping (electronic cigarettes, heat)
‣ Overcome opioid dependence
With the Pelago app, you can:
‣ Attend 1:1 appointments with your coach, counselor, or physician 
‣ Set and review goals, and monitor your progress over time
‣ Track things like alcohol-free streaks or money saved from not smoking
‣ Access the cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) library, which offers guided support in evaluating and changing your habits 
‣ Message your dedicated care team member anytime, anywhere 
‣ View your prescribed medication (if applicable)
How to get started
1. Before downloading the app, sign up online. Use the information shared with you by Pelago, your employer, or your health plan. This information may have been delivered via email, mailer, flyer, poster, intranet, etc. If you aren't sure whether you're covered, look up your employer or health plan by using this link: http://pelagohealth.com/how-it-works/for-members
2. Schedule your onboarding appointment.
3. Download and log in to the Pelago app.
How does Pelago work?
Looking to make a change to your relationship with alcohol, tobacco, or opioids? At Pelago, you get to decide your goal — whether that’s to quit, cut back, or reimagine your relationship with a substance — and we’ll help you take small steps toward big changes. Upon getting started, Pelago delivers a unique care plan based on individual health, habits, genetics, and goals. Our program is fully virtual, delivered via a convenient app, and you can achieve goals at a pace that works for you. Additionally, our medication-assisted treatment (MAT) program delivers a combination of behavioral therapy techniques with the option of approved medication.
About Pelago
Pelago Health is the leading digital clinic for substance use care and management. Pelago is with its members every step of the way — helping them to navigate and overcome obstacles. At Pelago, we deliver evidence-based care informed by the latest science. We have used cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights to build the most effective and validated digital clinic. Read more about us at https://www.pelagohealth.com/company/our-mission/
Who can use Pelago?
Pelago provides virtual substance use treatment solutions offered to employees and qualifying dependents, as well as health plan participants. If you're not sure whether your company or health plan provides you and/or your dependents with access to Pelago, please contact your HR team or health plan.
Is Pelago secure?
Safety and security are top priorities at Pelago. Our technology is HITRUST certified and compliant with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). For more information, find our complete Security Policy at https://www.pelagohealth.com/company/security/

 • Highlight Videos

 • Push Notifications
 • Social Media Sharing

bluejetty:00166097:ios.summary:

Earth, fire, water, wind... The lig
bluejetty:00166097:ios.description:
A remodeled 2D take on the first game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play.
Earth, fire, water, wind... The light that once shone within the four Crystals was lost. Darkness covered the land, until the only hope for humanity rested in legends past. Become the Warriors of Light and embark on your own journey to restore power to the Crystals and save the world.
Switch between classes to improve your characters. Traverse the wide world with your airship and other vessels. Return to the game that started it all.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
■ Beautifully revived with new graphics and sound!
・Universally updated 2D pixel graphics, including the iconic FINAL FANTASY character pixel designs created by Kazuko Shibuya, the original artist and current collaborator.
・Beautifully rearranged soundtrack in a faithful FINAL FANTASY style, overseen by original composer Nobuo Uematsu.
■Improved gameplay!
・Including modernized UI, auto-battle options, and more.
・Also supports game pad controls, making it possible to play using a dedicated gamepad UI when connecting a gamepad to your device.
・Switch the soundtrack between the rearranged version, created for the pixel remaster, or the original version, capturing the sound of the original game.
・Now possible to switch between different fonts, including the default font and a pixel-based font based on the atmosphere of the original game.
・Additional boost features to expand gameplay options, including switching off random encounters and adjusting experience gained multipliers between 0 and 4.
・Dive into the world of the game with supplemental extras like the bestiary, illustration gallery, and music player.
*This remaster is based on the original "FINAL FANTASY" game released in 1987. Features and/or content may differ from previously rereleased versions of the game.
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 13.0 or higher
[Applicable Devices]
iPhone 6s, iPod touch (7th generation), iPad (5th generation), iPad Air 2, iPad mini 4 and higher

bluejetty:00171525:ios.description:
Features:
- 123 levels teach, train and test your knowledge of all 88 constellations defined by the International Astronomical Union.
- 180 levels teach, train and test your knowledge of 150+ brightest stars of the sky.
- NEW! 153 levels teach, train and test your knowledge of 110 Deep Sky Objects (Messier Objects).
- Create your own list of constellations, stars and DSOs for learning and practice.
- 7 default presets (e.g. zodiac constellations & navigational stars) ready for use.
- Three training and testing modes for each level (easy, medium and hard) to help you progress smoothly and guide you to eventually recognize the constellations, stars and DSOs in the real night sky.
- Opportunity to review your mistakes after completing each level.
- Device-specific pronunciation for constellations, stars and DSOs.
- Realistic night sky simulation and beautiful illustrations and animations.
- Combination of learning and gaming. Learn while having fun.
- Explore the mysterious night sky on your own on the Explore screen.
- Completely configure the game according to your preference. Adjust sounds & vibrations, change appearance of the sky (stars, illustrations, constellation lines, borders of constellations, equatorial grid lines, focus ring, Milky Way, etc.) and so on.
- Night mode to reduce the strain on the eyes.
- Absolutely no ads.
- Works completely offline.
Game
The game is designed to teach the user to recognize all the 88 modern constellations, brightest stars and 110 Messier Objects by taking them through a number of levels. Levels are divided into categories (constellations, stars & DSOs), regions (north, equator, south) and difficulties (easy, medium, hard). Each level teaches only a small number of objects and then trains the knowledge in a quiz game to aid memorization. Later levels also review and retest the knowledge of previously learnt objects.
Levels
In each level, you're first given an opportunity to see and memorize the objects (constellations, stars or DSOs) of that level. Use the arrows to go through all of them, and click 'Start' once you're ready. The description of each object is displayed on the panel at the bottom of the screen. The panel can be expanded by dragging it up to show more details about the object. After clicking “Start”, an object will be shown and you’ll be presented with 4 options. The level ends when you answer a certain number of questions (shown in the top-left corner) correctly. At the end of the level you'll have the opportunity to review the mistakes you’ve made before progressing further. Please note, in challenge levels, no hints are available and you are given only a limited number of lives to pass them.
Difficulties
Each level is available in 3 difficulties: easy, medium, and hard.
Easy levels show the lines of the constellations, making the experience less similar to the real night sky, but it's the first step of learning.
Medium levels hide the lines of the constellations, but show their precise borders and the lines of the surrounding constellations to help the recognition.
Hard levels are closest to the real night sky: they only show the approximate location of the objects, instead of the exact shape (the borders), and randomly choose the orientation each time, so that you learn to recognize the objects from another angle.
We recommend going through each difficulty, from easy to hard.
Explore screen
The explore screen (third button on the main screen) allows you to explore the sky on your own. Tapping on the objects (e.g. names of the stars or constellations) shows more information about them (e.g. abbreviation, brightest star, area of the sky, distance etc.). You can also use the same double-tap gesture to quickly hide/reveal all the decorations. The search icon (top-right corner) allows you to quickly find a particular object you're interested in.
Privacy Policy: https://www.dong.digital/skyacademy/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.dong.digital/skyacademy/tos/
