Quickly perform a phone number search on landlines or cell phones to find names, addresses, emails, and more. This app helps you reveal unknown callers, block spam, and stay protected. What you'll get with the free Whitepages Reverse Phone Lookup app: 
REVERSE PHONE NUMBER LOOKUPS 
• Search on any cell phone number or landline to get the owner’s name along with their address, email address, and other public record information 
• Look up more than 200 million landlines and business phone numbers for free 
IDENTIFY UNKNOWN CALLERS AND SPAM CALLS

EASILY ADD PHONE NUMBERS TO CONTACTS 
• Add looked-up phone numbers and names to your iOS contacts with just a tap 
HOW PEOPLE USE WHITEPAGES REVERSE PHONE SEARCH / CALLER ID APP: 
• Look up unknown caller id calling your cell phone to decide if you should block the number 
• Identify suspicious callers, spams and texts in seconds 
• Verify & update phone numbers in your contact list 
• Find out who has called you or a member of your family in the past 
• View trending spam numbers and add them to the block list proactively
• Get addresses & emails for acquaintances, extended family and others by searching on their phone number 
• Sync & clean up contacts to keep the contact list organized and up-to-date 
Testimonials 
“I appreciate the help looking up phone numbers” 
It’s very hard this day and time to locate people because they don’t have landlines anymore and people change their cell phone numbers too often. Whitepages helps me when I am searching for people to update their contact information at work. I recommend it. 
“A good security research tool” 
This app has surpassed my expectations. Anyone who uses it can almost immediately determine the intent of a caller.”

The version of this Bible is World
bluejetty:00100685:ios.description:
World English Bible (WEB) which is complete offline. There are several Bible translations that you can use these days. The most popular ones are the King James bible and that of new international version
The version of this Bible is World English Bible which is usually called WEB Bible verses. If you are looking for a Bible reference to support a Bible class or exhortation and are away from your usual reference materials, a World English Bible or WEB Bible could help. You can find this Bible version available with a quick word search using your favorite search engine. Downloading is a convenient way to have parts of a verse or WEB Bible book available to you at a minute's notice. The good thing about this Bible is it is completely offline and you can use it everywhere you want. 
An advantage of the World English Bible (WEB) Offline is its readability in the English language. The translators made every effort to express the underlying meaning of the original Greek, Hebrew and Aramaic texts in the language of today's English speaking people. This is not extreme or niche language, but that which would be understood by a large percentage of readers. 
The downloaded words are easy to read and don't require the need for paper, ink and other products to supply the document. Convenience and accessibility are the elements that make a downloaded Bible version popular. There is no danger of your toddler tearing a page or deciding to draw a picture.
WEB Bible optimized for Tablets. These days we have big screens for phone and also tablets. Not every app has been optimized to be used on tablets. This World English Bible has been optimized and runs seamlessly on your tablet. The font has been enlarged so you can see it on your tablet without any problem.
Daily Bible Verses
The Bible app gives you a daily bible verse every morning at your set time. The default time is 7am but you can always change it to your desired time. These have been hand picked to inspire you during the entire day. 
Note Taking
We all love to take notes but what if you don't have your notebook with you. Don't worry at all. This app has notes taking section that you can use to take notes. No need to take your book with you. This Bible has everything for you. Easy way to highlight your favorite verses and you can enjoy reading the word as long as you like it.
God bless you for using this app.

bluejetty:00182572:ios.description:
Your ticket to the bright lights of Premier League superstardom is here!
From the creators of the most popular cricket game in the world, Stick Cricket Premier League offers you the chance to:
CREATE YOUR CAPTAIN
Create and customise your player, before taking guard against the world’s best bowlers.
TRAVEL THE WORLD
From Mumbai to Melbourne, your skills are in demand! Team owners in India and Australia are battling it out to secure your signature.
BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM
Your owner will bankroll the recruitment of Star Players from around the world, boosting your chances of winning the League.
Choose from more than 50 Star Players to bolster your squad. Star Batsmen are more likely to clear the rope, while a signing a miserly Star Bowler will ensure the targets you chase aren’t as demanding.
If your squad is in need of some experience, you can coax an ex-player out of retirement on a short-term deal. 
Alternatively, try to confound the pundits by winning the League with a team of rookies. The choice is up to you.
ESTABLISH A DYNASTY
You’ve got five seasons to establish your team as a force in the Premier League. Your success-hungry owner will want five trophies... just don't end up with the dreaded wooden spoon instead.
RECRUIT COACHES
Hiring a batting coach will soon have your created captain slogging it like a Star, or reduce the runs your team concedes with the expert guidance of a bowling coach.
ENHANCE YOUR SIX APPEAL
The crowd wants maximums! Each League provides cash bonuses for every six you smash, as well as stumping up an appearance fee. You read that correctly: cold hard cash, just for showing up!

bluejetty:00096311:ios.description:
INMOST is an atmospheric, story-driven puzzle platformer, following three playable characters within one dark, interconnecting story. In an old abandoned castle, you’ll need to explore every nook and cranny, avoid detection, slice your way through enemies and spring deadly traps in order to escape the evil that lurks within…
**Winner of the Best Indie Game - Minsk Dev Gamm Awards**
--
■ Three main characters, each with their own unique gameplay styles
■ One interweaving story, set across two worlds
■ Scale the environment by sneaking past enemies, luring them into deadly traps, solving puzzles and slicing down foes
■ Explore every inch of the world to find secret passages
■ Each pixel is placed with love!
■ 3 hours of harrowingly beautiful gameplay
■ Playable in 15 languages including English, French, German, Russian, Spanish and many more!
■ Featuring the vocal talents of Andrew Dennis and Cassandra Lee Morris
-- 
“An intimidatingly polished horror platformer.” EDGE Magazine 
"Beautifully detailed architecture, towering monsters and some delicious lighting and particle effects abound.” Rock Paper Shotgun
"It’s amazing what talented artists are doing with pixels these days, and INMOST is a perfect example” PCGamesN
"INMOST has a beautiful pixelated aesthetic and emotional musical score.” Game Informer

bluejetty:00183700:ios.description:
Instant, easy and secure access to paying your bills and transferring money with the Polish Credit Union Mobile Banking app. View your account balances onscreen without even having to log in, convenient for when you're standing in the checkout line.
The branch in your pocket, you can:
• Deposit cheques
• View cheque images
• View your account activity and recent transactions
• Manage multiple accounts
• Pay bills now or set up payments for the future
• Scheduled payments: view and edit upcoming bills and transfers
• Transfer money between your accounts
• Use Interac® e-Transfer to send, receive and request money securely via email or text
• Manage and setup personal alerts
• Check the latest interest rates
• Choose to display your balances onscreen without having to log in
• Access your accounts quickly with Touch ID or Face ID
• Pay us a visit using the Branch/ATM locator utilizing your phone's GPS
• Watch archived videos from our weekly television program, "Polish Credit Union TV"
• Our Calculators can help you work out the details of your financial plan and assist you in reaching your goals
To take advantage of the full functionality of this app, you must already be registered and have logged in to Online Banking. If you are not an Online Banking member, you can still use the Branch/ATM locator, Rates and our Contact Us information.
There is no charge for the app but mobile data downloading and Internet charges may apply. Check with your mobile phone provider for details.
Your security is our priority, which is why our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full Online Banking website. You log in with the same membership details and once you log out or close the app, your secure session will end.
For more information, please visit our website www.polcu.com

[Key Features]
- Firmware Directory: Quickly browse the latest system versions, release history, and currently signed downgrade firmwares for all iPhone and iPad models.

- Desktop Widgets: Beautifully designed Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets in various sizes, allowing you to check firmware updates without even opening the app.
- Premium Visual Experience: A fully modernized card-based interface with seamless support for elegant Dark and Light modes, ensuring a smooth and comfortable user experience.

bluejetty:00132314:ios.description:
Welcome to Mods for Minicraft, your ultimate gateway to an enhanced Minicraft gaming experience! 
Dive into a world of endless possibilities with our iOS app, a comprehensive catalog of 80+ Minicraft mods spanning various categories. Designed with a convenient and thoughtful interface, our application is a treasure trove of exciting mods that will elevate your gaming experience to another level! 
Cars: Race into action with our collection of car mods. Whether you fancy sports cars, vintage classics, or rugged off-roaders, we've got them all. Transform your Minicraft world into an exciting racing arena! Vroom, vroom, off you go! 
Guns: Arm yourself for the ultimate combat with our exciting range of gun mods. From sniper rifles to rocket launchers, equip your Minicraft character with the most powerful weaponry and be the champion of your virtual battleground. Ready, aim, fire! 
Furniture: Decorate your Minicraft home with our collection of furniture mods. From cozy beds, stylish sofas, to fancy kitchenware, deck up your Minicraft dwelling just the way you like. Turn your virtual home into a dreamy abode! 
Dragons: Enter the world of mythical creatures with our dragon mods. Ride these majestic beasts, unleash their fiery breath or make them your pets. Brace yourself for an unforgettable Minicraft adventure! 
Animals: Populate your Minicraft world with our animal mods. From wild beasts, adorable pets to mythical creatures, create a bustling ecosystem within your game. Let the animal kingdom reign! 
Shaders: Enrich your Minicraft visuals with our shaders mod category. Add realistic shadows, vibrant color palette, and stunning water effects. Make your Minicraft world truly come alive with breathtaking graphics! 
Each mod comes with a brief description and a preview, giving you a sneak-peek into what's in store. One-click is all it takes to install the mods, or if you prefer, you can follow our detailed manual installation instructions.
To assure you of a seamless gaming experience, all our mods are rigorously tested and confirmed to be working. Quality are our topmost priorities. 
Key Features:
- Over 80+ tested and working mods
- User-friendly interface for easy navigation 
- Descriptions and previews for each mod 
- One-click installation or manual instructions 
Discover the unparalleled joy of Minicraft gaming with Mods for Minicraft! Unleash your creativity, transform your virtual world, and redefine the rules of the game. Your ultimate Minicraft adventure starts here!

In accordance with http://account.mojang.com/documents/brand_guidelines
For additional information, see our privacy policy and terms of use:

bluejetty:00062122:ios.description:
Welcome to the award-winning single most efficient way to learn about wine, an essential tool for budding sommeliers, those facing wine exams or anyone who would like to enjoy confident wine knowledge.
This is not a quiz app (although it has quizzes!); it’s all about learning and remembering the myriad of information around wine.
Decanter Know Your Wine is a microlearning app. It uses s p a c i n g to deliver learning in highly efficient short lessons. It asks you questions and uses Artificial Intelligence to learn from your answers so that you learn the content you're struggling with and don't keep repeating the stuff you know.
Use the app little and often and progress through a series of rankings en route to becoming a Know Your Wine Grand Master. Complete the program and your knowledge of wine will become exceptional. You might even begin to master some of our online quizzes! (https://goo.gl/2JmG98).
More questions will be added over time, so keep checking back.
Know Your Wine is brought to you by Decanter Magazine and powered by Feed Your Elephant. It is free to download and comes with over 10 free modules. Further modules are available as in app purchases or via annual auto-renewable subscription. 
Subscription details:
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the same rate as the original subscription.
• Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Further details on subscriptions including how to cancel, terms of use and Feed Your Elephant's Privacy policy can be found at www.feedyourelephant.com/contact-us.

bluejetty:00045216:ios.name: COPIC Collection
bluejetty:00045216:ios.summary: Copic Collection is a free smartphone app that lets you efficiently manage and search Copic markers that you currently own or are planning to purchase. It also lets you search for complimentary colors, and display color drawing samples. The
bluejetty:00045216:ios.description:
Copic Collection is a free smartphone app that lets you efficiently manage and search Copic markers that you currently own or are planning to purchase. It also lets you search for complimentary colors, and display color drawing samples. The app has been well received by many Copic users.
How to use Copic Collection 
'- Easily register products using barcodes: 
You can now scan barcodes to register your Copic products. 
For sets, you can register all Copic products included in the set by scanning the barcode on the package. 
You can easily view your Copic products registered on the app from a color bar list, making it easier to find the next color you may be looking for.
Register Multiliner products
Copic products other than Copic markers (Multiliner Pen/Multiliner SP Pen/Copic Drawing Pen/Gasen-Fude Brush Pen) can also now be registered in your list. 
Multiliner Pen products can be registered by color and line width.
View suggestions with the color picker feature
Do you ever find yourself wondering what color should be used to color particular areas? 
Copic Collection can help you with that. The app allows you to load photos, illustrations and other images from "Camera" within the app, and will display a list of recommended Copic colors that best fits a specified area of an image. 
If you select a color from the list and tap the star icon, the chosen color will be displayed in the "WISH LIST." You can use this feature as a memo for your next purchase.
- Your own MY COLOR MEMO
On the detail screen for each color, you can tap the MEMO icon to make notes about the corresponding color. 
For example, you can leave notes for a particular color such as "Used to color my favorite manga character" and "Color was used by a popular artist in a video."
- Tag the colors you used in a piece
You can load images of artwork created with Copic markers from "Camera" within the app and add "Color Tags" that indicate the colors that were used. You can then save the image with the added color tags. 
You can save the image as reference for your own use, or share the image with Color Tags on social media, etc.

Connect to your office or home computers from anywhere with a speed of 60 FPS and 4K quality. Access files, folders, emails, and software applications on remote machines, whether it's after-hours or while on the go.
Features:
 • Instant remote computer access, provided there is an active internet connection and RemotePC application installed on it
 •. Connect to multiple remote computers at the same time and manage each session independently.
 • Provides efficient team work with friends or colleagues by accessing their remote computers to work on presentations, documents, view/edit media files, etc.
 • Access PCs and MACs using your iOS devices.
 • Enhanced performance and low latency
 • Cross-platform compatibility
 • 60 FPS speed allowing 4K quality 
 • Faster remote streaming for gamers
 •. Supports Apple Pencil for precise navigation and control on compatible iPad devices.
Functionalities:
 • Transfer files via your iOS devices and computers with/without remote session.
 • Enable inactivity timeout to retain remote session running in the background for the specified time.
 • Lock the remote system via your iOS device.
 • Configure the display quality and speed of the remote session.
 • Modify the screen resolution of the remote display
 • Record remote sessions while accessing via iOS devices.
 • Control clipboard actions (copy and paste) from your iOS devices.
 • Access and manage logged off and locked devices remotely.
 • Remote printing of documents and images using a local printer.
 • Chat with the recipients for effective communication.
 • Enable ‘Trusted Devices’ for enhanced security of your RemotePC account.
 • Enable ‘Blank Host Screen’ to work privately on your remote device by turning the screen blank.
 • View multiple monitors at the same time for Enterprise accounts.
 • Restart your remote system via the iOS device in a safe mode.
 • Collaborate effectively by using Whiteboard to draw on the remote screen.
 • Multiple users can simultaneously access and work on a single remote machine.
 • Multitask during remote sessions by opening multiple iPad apps simultaneously

bluejetty:00182880:ios.description:
It started in 1995 -- one of the first true color card games ever made, at a time when Windows Solitaire was still running in 16 colors. Thirty years later, Hardwood Solitaire IV carries that tradition forward with over 100 beautifully crafted solitaire games available on your iPhone and iPad. Free to play, always.
Start with beautiful Klondike -- then explore a whole world of solitaire when you're ready.
Drag a stack of cards and watch them sway naturally in your hand -- a small detail nobody else does, and one you'll notice from your very first game. 
100+ Games Available -- including:
Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Pyramid, Yukon, Scorpion, Golf, Canfield, Montana, Russian Solitaire, La Belle Lucie, King Albert, Forty Thieves, Clock, Memory, Freecell 3 Deck, Klondike Deal 3, Spider 4 Suits, Aces Up, Black Hole, Penguin, Sultan, Sir Tommy, Josephine, Monte Carlo, and dozens more classic and rare variants.
Get the complete library in one purchase with our Complete Game Pack.
Features:
• Online leaderboards -- see how you stack up globally
• Auto Complete finishes won games automatically
• Intelligent hints when you need a nudge
• Built-in rules and help for every game
• Undo gesture -- swipe left
• Advance stockpile gesture -- swipe right
• Stunning environments and high-quality audio
• Total Customization: Unique card decks and backgrounds -- available with tokens, purchasable anytime.
More Hardwood Games:
• Hardwood Spades -- the classic trick taking game
• Hardwood Euchre -- Jacks are Trump
• Hardwood Hearts -- avoid the points
• Hardwood Backgammon -- race to safety
• Video Poker Duel -- competitive video poker for two
Questions, suggestions, or found an issue? We love hearing from our players at support@silvercrk.com

bluejetty:00161208:ios.name: Road of Kings - Endless Glory
bluejetty:00161208:ios.summary: Road of Kings - Endless Glory is an exciting new empire simulation RPG, which combines with strategy war games! You will experience the King’s life! The game pays attention to detail processing so that players can immerse in imperial manage
bluejetty:00161208:ios.description:
Road of Kings - Endless Glory is an exciting new empire simulation RPG, which combines with strategy war games! You will experience the King’s life! The game pays attention to detail processing so that players can immerse in imperial management, political intrigue, brutal war, military strategy, and flirtatious romance!
In particular: you can turn on PEACE MODE then will not be attacked by others! 
Main features:
● Be a king and build a harem
Romantic encounter will happen between you and seven beautiful, influential girls (even more, depending on your personal charm)! They are all glamorous princesses from different countries, such as the United Kingdom, Japan, China and Egypt. When the princesses start dancing, nobody can take their eyes off them!
● Recruit epic heroes
Recruit heroes and complete combat missions. Each hero has a 3D model and unique skills! You are supposed to add each hero to your favorite!
● Enjoy the rich rewards in game
It doesn’t affect your work at all! Send the hero to fight automatically - idling, can get a lot of rewards! You can accumulate wealth by idling every day. Unlike other SLG, no one can completely destroy your Kingdom! Enjoy the game as much as you can!
● Raise a family
Lovingly cultivate your children into brilliant persons!
● Alliance
Make friends and convert enemies into friends, fight for your throne!
● Join the PvP
You can play against other players around the world!
● Open the Peace Mode
After opening the Peace Mode, that is, Neutral Kingdom, you will not be attacked by other players, stay away from war and develop peacefully. and "Peace Mode" is completely free! 
 Therefore, if you like war, there are many active alliances of war players; if you like peace, there are plenty of peace-loving players creating "Neutral" alliances! You can choose the development direction according to your preference! All in all, it's a very unique strategy war game!"
 So would you choose to occupy enemy countries, imprison rival Lords and conquer their queens? Will you free the prisoners of war?
 Or would you choose to be a peace-loving King, marry a princess and start a family -- lovingly raise your children to be brilliant adults?

bluejetty:00149054:ios.description:
Welcome to Sundae Rewards!
Indulge in the joy of sweet surprises and turn every visit into a delightful experience with Sundae Rewards. Our loyalty program is designed to add an extra scoop of happiness to your handcrafted ice cream adventures.
Your Passport to Free Delights
Earn points, unlock sweet deals, and gain free treats when you use your unique QR code loyalty card during your visit to Sundae. Every dollar spent earns you points, bringing you closer to the ultimate reward – free frozen delights! Once you have gained enough points, pick out your free products in the rewards store and redeem them at your leisure!
Become Sundae Royalty
Achieve Sundae’s Royalty status by earning points through purchases, challenges, and frequent visits. With each Royalty tier you achieve, you will unlock exclusive products in the rewards store, gain points quicker, and receive exclusive promotions.
Flavor of the Month
Learn about our Flavor of the Month program and become a connoisseur of our most innovative and unique creations. Immerse yourself in a world of ever-evolving, delectable surprises.
Get the Scoop
Receive updates on new products, promotions, community involvement, and member only events, delivered directly to your mobile device.
Welcome to Sundae, where we share joy with every scoop. At Sundae, we believe that ice cream isn't just a treat; it's a celebration of life's sweetest moments.
Our Story
Sundae was born out of the Rocky Mountains with a passion for creating frozen delights. Established in 2016, we set out on a mission to redefine the ice cream experience by focusing on quality, creativity, and community.
Crafted with Love
What sets Sundae apart is our dedication to the joy of ice cream making. Each batch is carefully crafted by our skilled artisans who blend passion with precision, using only the finest ingredients to ensure that every scoop is a burst of natural goodness.
Community Commitment
We are proud to be part of many amazing communities in Colorado. We believe in giving back and actively supporting many local initiatives and charities.
Visit Us
Experience the joy of Sundae by visiting our stores located across Colorado. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just craving a sweet escape, our friendly staff is ready to serve you with a smile. Explore all Sundae locations, store hours, and contact information on the in-app map.

bluejetty:00144855:ios.description:
Looking for a hilarious and entertaining online multiplayer physics-based pvp fighting game that will have you and your friends rolling on the floor with laughter? Look no further, cause this game that brings together all of your favorite elements: animal battles, physics playgrounds, party games, and more.
The totally accurate physics-simulated battle mechanics will surely keep you entertained. As this is a PVP multiplayer party game it's best to play with friends, so invite them to form a gang, pick one of your favorite beasts and let the wrestling games begin!
With an array of crazy and wobbly characters including battle cats, warrior cats, capybaras, ninja turtles, squirrels, and even wobbly dogs, you'll have a blast trying to knock each other out in slapstick fights that will leave you breathless.
Experience the fun and excitement of a ragdoll simulator where the physics-based movements are realistic and funny. Whether you're running around as a ragdoll runner or punching your way through a gang fight, the wobbly world will surely have you laughing until your sides hurt.
Get ready to engage in animal battles and monster gang fights as you explore this ragdoll sandbox filled with rubber bandits, comedy beasts, and fighting reptiles.
Events:
Brawl - Engage in a wrestling battle as party animals in a 3 vs 3 PVP matchup where the objective is to score points by employing your fighting moves to knock out and eliminate opponents, utilize techniques like punching, falling flat on your face, and unleash your inner battle cat.
Football - Score big with wacky physics in this soccer game! Master the perfect kick, take on street football, and compete with stickman soccer players in World Soccer Champs. Use your head, and get ready to experience the wild world of soccer physics.
Kick the King - Animal battles rage in physics playgrounds, as teams compete to capture and hold the crown in the match arena.
Steal the chicken - In this chicken game, players must catch the hen and transport it to their respective zones while defending them from thieves. The rubber bandits will do anything to steal the valuable chickens, so prepare for an intense animal battle.
Racing - In this racing game, the 5 guys compete against another 5 with goozy physics-based ragdolls, making the gameplay totally unpredictable. Navigate through obstacles to avoid stumbling and falling flat on your face!
Characters:
Humans, beasts, monsters, we have them all, wobbly dogs, pandas, raccoons, axolotls, capybara, you name it, all party animals are present and ready to fight.
Customization:
As this is a multiplayer online game, it is important to be fashionable. Here you can customize your beast with silly and unique outfits. Choose from hats, masks, beards, clothes, and more to add some personality to your havocado characters. Show off your stylish wrestling gang to people in the playground.
Multiplayer;
Step into the world of stickmen and falling humans, the ultimate free-play multiplayer action game. Whether you're in the mood for PVP games or PVE games, or COOP, we've got them all, so you can play solo or team up with friends for endless hours of entertainment. Join our online community and battle it out with silly guys and experience hilarious and unpredictable moments.
Superpowers:
You get to join the monsters gang and unleash your inner superhero with their unique and powerful abilities. Engage in intense battles with your enemies, and collect energy by delivering knockout punches, kicks, and smashes to your opponents. Use your collected energy to unleash your special power and dominate the arena with your kung-fu skills. So, get ready to join the epic battle and become the ultimate champion of the monsters gang!
Ready for the ultimate knockout? This is the real game, download it on your mobile device. A ton of fun and laughter is guaranteed!

bluejetty:00178731:ios.name: Soccer Boss: Football Game
bluejetty:00178731:ios.summary:
Take on the role of a football manager in this realistic soccer strategy game.
You are a young, promising football manager at the start of your career. A handful of small clubs are prepared to gamble on your potential and make you their ma
bluejetty:00178731:ios.description:
Take on the role of a football manager in this realistic soccer strategy game.
You are a young, promising football manager at the start of your career. A handful of small clubs are prepared to gamble on your potential and make you their manager. Choose one and take it from the bottom league all the way to European glory. Or will you ditch them when other jobs become available at bigger and better clubs, working your way up to managing one of the giants of European football?
▶ REALISTIC CLUB AND LEAGUES STRUCTURE
There are 750 clubs to manage across 9 European countries including England, Spain, Germany, Italy, France, Russia, Portugal, Turkey and the Netherlands. Each country has realistic league and cup competitions, meaning there are 64 trophies to compete for in total – how much silverware can you win?!
▶ MASSIVE PLAYER DATABASE
There are 17,000 players in the game and your scouts will regularly provide reports on as many as they can. Make offers to buy or loan them, using your business acumen to negotiate transfer fees and personal terms. You’ll be in control of player sales too – will you accept that big offer for your star player?
▶ KEEP YOUR CHAIRMAN HAPPY
Each season your chairman will give you a realistic target to achieve. This could be something like avoid relegation, finish in the top 10 or even win the league. The chairman will expect you to steadily improve the team, so usually the targets will get higher and higher each season.You will be given a transfer budget and a wage budget for the season which you can spend on whoever you want. But be careful you don't spend what you don't have as the chairman will not take kindly to this and it could have a negative effect on your job security, maybe even resulting in the sack!
▶ APPLY FOR OTHER JOBS
As you career progresses, so your reputation will increase and other clubs will consider appointing you as their manager. You can apply for other jobs either in the same country you're currently managing in or abroad. But make sure you check out the state of the club first - you don't want to take on a side doomed to relegation, or a team which doesn't have much money as that wouldn't be good for your career. 
▶ APPOINT YOUR BACKROOM STAFF
There are other personnel to help you manage the club. The Head Coach, Academy Coach, Physio, Head Scout, Youth Scout and Fitness Coach all play their part in the success of the club. Hire and fire them at the right time to achieve the best results for your team.
▶ TAKE FULL CONTROL OF MATCHES
Before each match you must pick the team, carefully considering the fitness and skill level of each player. Choose the formation and tactics to suit the opponent you're facing and then it's kick off.
As the match unfolds, change tactics if you need to. Have you taken the lead against tough opposition? Consider switching to a more defensive mentality to grind out the win. Is your midfielder's fitness levels dropping too low? Maybe it's time to freshen the team up with a substitution. But if you make all your subs too early and then pick up an injury, what will you do then?! 
These tough decisions are part and parcel of managing the team on match day and will ultimately shape your career. 
Do whatever it takes to win all 64 trophies and become the ultimate Soccer Boss.

bluejetty:00178509:ios.description:
Tamilan Calendar - the most accurate and complete Tamil Panchangam app for Tamil speakers everywhere. Tamil calendar, daily panchangam, rasi palan, nalla neram, important days, festivals, and holidays - everything you need for daily life, all in one app. Built on traditional Hindu panchangam calculations for precise Tamil date and astrological details.
Today's Panchangam
See the Tamil date, Tamil month, Tamil year, English date, weekday, thithi, natchathiram (star), yogam, and chandrashtamam at a glance, updated daily. Valarpirai (waxing moon) and theipirai (waning moon) details are also shown clearly.
Nalla Neram & Gowri Nalla Neram
Never miss an auspicious time again. Morning and evening nalla neram, gowri nalla neram, rahu kalam, yamagandam, kuligai time, soolam, and parigaram are all laid out in an easy hourly schedule. Ascending, descending, and neutral day details are shown every day.
Rasi Palan
Read daily horoscope predictions for all 12 rasis, from Mesham to Meenam, in one simple screen.
Monthly Calendar
A clean, beautiful grid view of the entire month at a glance. Important days, festivals, holidays, and auspicious/inauspicious days for the month are summarized right below the calendar. Swipe between months easily.
Important Days
Track Pournami, Amavasai, Kiruthigai, Shasti, Sankatahara Chathurthi, Egathasi, Pradosham, Maha Sivarathri, Chathurthi, and every other important vratham day in advance, with reminders.
Festivals & Holidays
Hindu festivals (Deepavali, Pongal, Navarathri, Tamil New Year, and more), Christian festivals, Muslim festivals, and government holidays are all listed separately, organized month by month.
Auspicious & Inauspicious Days
Planning a housewarming, wedding, new business, or vehicle purchase? Quickly find Subha Muhurtham (auspicious) days for your important events, and see the Kari Naal (inauspicious) days to avoid.
Reminders
Set reminders for the important days you care about most - same day, 1 day before, or 2 days before, at a time you choose. If notifications are turned off, the app will guide you to enable them in Settings.
Home Screen Widgets
Add small, medium, or large widgets to your iPhone Home Screen and see today's Tamil date, nalla neram, and gowri nalla neram instantly, without opening the app.
Language & God Image
Use the app in Tamil or Tanglish. Choose your favorite god image to display on the home screen.

bluejetty:00083492:ios.description:
Looking for a MeRGBW Bluetooth app? You can now control your MeRGBW smart Bluetooth fixtures with this stand-alone app!
Manage smart lighting as you wish
Whether you have just a few MeRBGW fixtures in your home or a whole house of MeRGBW fixtures, you can easily manage these smart lights the way you want. Manage lamps by room or area grouping (such as lamps for an entire floor or all lamps in a living room) and easily control lamps anytime, anywhere. Lighting experience
Our lighting scenes are carefully designed by professional lighting designers to instantly transform the mood of a room. You can use scene tones, various scenes, etc. to create a unique and appropriate atmosphere. Browse the MeRGBW scene library and click on the scene to set it up.
Light formula for everyday life
Use four light formulas designed by lighting experts to help you spend every day in a healthy way. Start your day with the cool daylight setting to help you feel energized in the morning, while the brighter Focus setting helps you get work done efficiently. The "Relax and Rest" setting presents a darkening golden halo to accompany you into a soothing rest time.
Personalized automation
Set up smart lighting around your daily schedule. Whether you want your lights to provide a gentle wake-up call in the morning or a warm greeting when you come home, setting up these custom automations is fun and easy in the MeRBGW app.

bluejetty:00064408:ios.name: Words of Wonders: Search
bluejetty:00064408:ios.developer: FUGO BILISIM TEKNOLOJILERI VE YAZILIM TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
bluejetty:00064408:ios.summary: Welcome to Words of Wonders: Search! You will go on a journey around the world to explore wonderful cities and discover the hidden secrets of the seven wonders of the world. You will lose track of time and improve your vocabulary while play
bluejetty:00064408:ios.description:
Welcome to Words of Wonders: Search! You will go on a journey around the world to explore wonderful cities and discover the hidden secrets of the seven wonders of the world. You will lose track of time and improve your vocabulary while playing this (literally!) wonderful crossword puzzle game. As you play this offline crossword game, you will explore the beauty of the English language and improve your puzzle solving skills as you discover the words hidden on the board. Using your intellect, you will be able to combine letters to create words in order to solve the enigmatic puzzles of the crossword genre.
To explore the world of WoW, you will push the boundaries of English to keep on progressing while making use of the various and new hint options when necessary. As boards get larger and it becomes harder to find new words, you will soon realize that you have become much more skilled in such a short time. Your word skills will improve, and your vocabulary will be enriched as you solve puzzles on various and intriguing subjects in each level. You will gain points as a reward for your success, but you will also be able to easily use hints with creative animations for hard-to-find words, and thus solve even the hardest puzzles. The brand new crossword puzzle game WoW: Search will help you improve your vocabulary as well as your puzzle solving skills. As fans of previous WoW games know by now, our crossword puzzle games take you on a delightful journey around the world to experience the symbolic landmarks of various countries.
What will be your strategy to find the hidden words? Will you first look for the longer words? Or will you start with the short words, hidden in the depths of the word board? No matter which strategy you choose, you will visit each city in this wonderful word search game! In the meantime, you will also experience the unique blend of modern and popular words together with the rich vocabulary of the English language.
There will be many words that come to your mind based on the subjects of the levels. Let’s see if they match the thousands of words chosen from the most commonly used. How many of the words presented to you by WoW Search are new to you, and how much of them are you well-versed in as a crossword puzzle master? Let your competition with the dictionary begin!
As you think of words for each subject, find the words hidden on the board. Don’t be deceived by the extra letters and use hints to overcome the biggest challenges.
EXPLORE NEW CITIES
Your rich vocabulary will help you on your journey to discover the natural, historical and architectural beauty of the world! Each monument is unique, and you will need to find different words for each landmark. Not only will you learn new words and improve your vocabulary, but also experience the joy of exploring the world once again! Thanks to WoW Search, you will explore the world in a fun way while completing challenges you can never find in any other game.
PROVE YOUR MASTERY
While playing WoW Search, you will test your vocabulary while exploring wonders filled with challenging levels. Start your journey with exploring the first wonder and keep on progressing to reach the top. Thanks to the rich database of the game, each of the treasures of the world will be unique and each level will be harder than the last. Don’t let the deceitful letters mislead you, you are your own competition!
Enjoy the various levels and puzzles with a simple and pleasant design!
WoW Search is a highly popular word search game designed by the developers of the previous Words of Wonders. Take a look at the word board and let the adventure begin!

bluejetty:00094840:ios.description:
Read and reply to WhatsApp messages in your own language, no matter what language others are using! All your WhatsApp chats & voice messages in your language. 
WhatLingo is an app that automatically translates your conversations from WhatsApp in real-time. Perfect for multilingual communities, international teams, expats, travelers, and anyone who wants to stay connected without language barriers.
BREAK DOWN LANGUAGE BARRIERS
Are you missing important information in group chats because you're not fluent or fast enough in the language? WhatLingo solves this by instantly translating messages to and from your preferred language.
- See incoming messages translated to your language, including voice messages
- Reply in your language, using your regular keyboard - we'll translate it into your chosen language for you
- Switch between original and translated views with one tap
- Join any conversation confidently. 
SIMPLE TO SET UP
Getting started with WhatLingo takes less than a minute:
1. Download the app

bluejetty:00125861:ios.name: الجليس الصالح
bluejetty:00125861:ios.summary: Al-Jalees Al-Saleh is a comprehensive Islamic app that brings together the Holy Quran, Tafsir, Hadith, and Seerah in one modern and unified experience. It is an expanded and enhanced continuation of the Hadith Encyclopedia and the Seerah En
bluejetty:00125861:ios.description:
Al-Jalees Al-Saleh is a comprehensive Islamic app that brings together the Holy Quran, Tafsir, Hadith, and Seerah in one modern and unified experience. It is an expanded and enhanced continuation of the Hadith Encyclopedia and the Seerah Encyclopedia, among the earliest Islamic apps launched on the Apple App Store since 2009.
One companion for the Muslim's day: prayer times, the Mushaf with its tafsir, the books of Hadith and Seerah, the adhkar and the tasbih. No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking — and most of it works with no connection at all.
Please note: the interface and the entire library are in Arabic.
◆ PRAYER TIMES & QIBLA
• Times for your location with seven calculation methods — Umm al-Qura, Qatar Calendar House, Muslim World League, Karachi, Egyptian Authority, ISNA and the European Council — and both Asr opinions
• The method follows the country you are in, and the choice stays yours
• Per-prayer minute adjustments and iqama times
• Alerts before the adhan, ten minutes before the iqama, and at it
• A qibla compass, and an augmented-reality prayer mat that turns you towards it
• A Home Screen widget, and an Apple Watch app
◆ THE MUSHAF
• The whole Quran as printed pages, with every verse tappable
• Eleven tafsirs: Ibn Kathir, al-Tabari, al-Qurtubi, al-Baghawi, al-Sa'di, al-Waseet, al-Mukhtasar, al-Muyassar, al-Suddi, Tanweer al-Miqbas, and al-Siraj on the Quran's rare words
• An English translation of the meanings, and word-by-word grammatical analysis (i'rab)
• Twenty-seven reciters, with surahs you can download and listen to offline
• Repeat a range of verses, for memorising
• A khatma: choose how long it should take, and it advances as you read
• Bookmarks and coloured highlights
◆ HADITH
• Twelve collections: Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, al-Tirmidhi, al-Nasa'i, Ibn Majah, Musnad Ahmad, Muwatta Malik, Sunan al-Darimi, al-Daraqutni, al-Mustadrak, and Riyad al-Salihin
• Close to eighty thousand hadiths in their books and chapters, with bookmarks
◆ SEERAH
• Twenty books: Zad al-Ma'ad, Ibn Hisham, Ibn Kathir, 'Uyun al-Athar, al-Raheeq al-Makhtum, al-Shama'il al-Muhammadiyya, and al-Waqidi's Maghazi
• A reader whose pages turn like a book's, in a typeface and size you choose
◆ ADHKAR & TASBIH
• Morning, evening, after-prayer, sleeping and waking adhkar, each with its count and its source
• Add your own, with their counts
• A tasbih with targets of 33, 99, 100 or none at all; it keeps your completed rounds, runs on Apple Watch, and stays in step with it
◆ ISLAMIC OCCASIONS
• Ramadan, Laylat al-Qadr, both Eids, the Day of Arafah, Ashura, al-Isra wal-Mi'raj and the Hijri new year
• A monthly Hijri calendar with the occasion days marked
• A widget for the next one
◆ IT FOLLOWS YOU
• iCloud sync for your bookmarks, your own adhkar, your settings and where you stopped reading
• Search across the Quran, the Hadith and the Seerah
• Light and dark, and a choice of Arabic typefaces
Note: occasion dates are computed with the Umm al-Qura calendar, and may differ by a day or two with the sighting of the moon in each country.

bluejetty:00086941:ios.description:
From 1 August 2026, you will no longer be able to earn a travel discount in this app. Switch to the new Skyss app – you can still earn travel discount there. 
This old Skyss Billett app will be closed in autumn 2026.
For more information visit skyss.no
Skyss Billett is the easiest way to purchase public transportation tickets in Hordaland County. The application allows you to purchase both single tickets and season tickets for travel by bus.
The payment methods can be used in the application:
- Mobile account, refilled via VISA/MasterCard or by money transfer.
- Vipps.
- Credit card (VISA/MasterCard).
- Phone bill.
It is possible to associate multiple users to one mobile account, so that travels are charged to only this account. The mobile account is not the same account as the account associated with the Skyss-card.
After downloading the app you only have to add your credit cards the first time you use them. Future purchases can be made with the same cards.
Skyss Billett allows you to easily and quickly purchase tickets, but you must buy your tickets before you embark the vehicles. Customers are responsible for having a valid ticket and enough battery power left on their device to show the ticket to any inspector as long as you are onboard one of our vehicles.

bluejetty:00121084:ios.name: Cross-a-Pix: Nonogram Crosses
bluejetty:00121084:ios.summary: Paint squares and fill regions as you solve the puzzle and discover a beautiful pixel-art picture! Each puzzle consists of a blank grid, divided into various regions, with clues to the left of every row and at the top of every column. The o
bluejetty:00121084:ios.description:
Paint squares and fill regions as you solve the puzzle and discover a beautiful pixel-art picture! Each puzzle consists of a blank grid, divided into various regions, with clues to the left of every row and at the top of every column. The object is to reveal a hidden picture by painting squares and filling blocks according to the rules.
Cross-a-Pix are exciting logic puzzles that form whimsical pixel-art pictures when solved. Challenging, deductive and artistic, these puzzles offer the ultimate mix of logic, art and fun while providing solvers with many hours of mentally stimulating entertainment.
The game enables zooming the entire puzzle, or just the grid area while keeping the clue-panes locked. Other features include a unique fingertip cursor for playing large puzzles with ease and precision, and a show/hide rulers option helping focus on one row and column at a time.
To help see the puzzle progress, graphic previews in the puzzle list show the progress of all puzzles in a volume as they are being solved. A Gallery view option provides these previews in a larger format.
For more fun, Cross-a-Pix contains no ads and includes a Weekly Bonus section providing an extra free puzzle each week.
PUZZLE FEATURES
• 130 free Cross-a-Pix puzzles in SingleClue and DualClue
• Extra bonus puzzle published free each week
• Puzzle library continuously updates with new content
• Manually created by artists, top quality puzzles
• Unique solution for each puzzle
• Grid sizes up to 30x45 (50x70 for iPad)
• Multiple difficulty levels
• Hours of intellectual challenge and fun
• Sharpens logic and improves cognitive skills
GAMING FEATURES
• No ads
• Zoom entire puzzle or just the grid area
• Clue-pane locking option for optimal puzzle viewing
• Rulers show or hide option for easier row and column viewing
• Exclusive fingertip cursor design for solving large puzzles
• Unlimited check puzzle
• Unlimited hints
• Error checking option when row or column is completed
• Unlimited Undo and Redo
• Clue auto check-off when row or column is completed
• Automatically mark obvious empty squares with dots
• Concurrently playing and saving multiple puzzles
• Puzzle filtering, sorting and archiving options
• Dark Mode support
• Graphic previews showing puzzles progress as they are being solved
• Portrait and landscape screen support (iPad only)
• Track puzzle solving times
• Backup & restore puzzle progress to iCloud
ABOUT
Cross-a-Pix have also become popular under other names such as Campixu, PoliPix and Crazy Paving. Similar to Picross, Nonogram and Griddlers, the puzzles are solved and the pictures revealed using logic alone. All puzzles in this app are produced by Conceptis Ltd. - the leading supplier of logic puzzles to printed and electronic gaming media all over the world. On average, more than 20 million Conceptis puzzles are solved each day in newspapers, magazines, books and online as well as on smartphones and tablets across the world.

Privacy Policy: https://www.conceptispuzzles.com/index.aspx?uri=info/doc/220

bluejetty:00138446:ios.description:
Know exactly what you're breathing - and where the reading comes from.
AirScope combines hyper-local air quality, species-level pollen forecasts, wildfire smoke tracking, and real-time NOAA weather radar in one app. Every reading is labeled Measured, Combined, or Estimated, so you always know how much to trust it - something no other air-quality app shows you.
AIRSCOPE FEATURES
• Home Screen & Lock Screen Widgets - today's tree, grass, weed, and mold levels at a glance, without opening the app.
• Wildfire Smoke Tracking - animated NOAA forecasts of near-surface smoke, vertically integrated smoke, and surface visibility, plus satellite fire detections and fire intensity.
• Symptom Trends - charts that line your symptom diary up against pollen and pollution levels, so your personal triggers emerge over time.
• Health Indices - daily risk levels with plain-language guidance for asthma, COPD, sinus headache, migraine, dust & dander, cold & flu, and arthritis, plus outdoor indices for running, biking, hiking, and dog walking.
• Satellite & Hybrid map views, tappable detail cards for storms, fires, smoke, and weather alerts, dramatically faster loading, and full Spanish language support.
AIR QUALITY YOU CAN TRUST
Real-time and forecast AQI with a clear Good-to-Hazardous category - not just a color - plus pollutant detail for PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, and CO with hourly forecast graphs. AirScope blends EPA-grade ground stations, satellite sensing, and atmospheric modeling, and always uses the most accurate source available for your location.
POLLEN, DOWN TO THE SPECIES
Daily pollen counts and 5-day allergy forecasts for tree, grass, weed, ragweed, and mold - including the predominant species affecting you, so you know whether it's cedar, oak, birch, or ragweed behind today's symptoms.
MAPS & RADAR
Interactive, high-resolution maps with animation up to 15 days (10-day history + 5-day forecast). Tap anything - a storm cell, a fire, a smoke plume, an alert - for an instant detail card.
Layers include:
• Air Quality Index (AQI)
• Tree, Grass & Weed Pollen (current + animated forecast)
• Mold Spore Forecast (animated)
• PM2.5, Ozone & Surface Dust Forecasts (animated)
• Near-Surface Smoke, Vertically Integrated Smoke & Surface Visibility
• Fire Detections & Fire Radiative Power
• NOAA Doppler Radar - Base & Composite Reflectivity, Precipitation Type, Echo Tops (updated every 2 minutes, animated)
• GOES Infrared Satellite (East & West)
• Temperature, Pressure, Wind & Cloud Coverage
• Global pollutant maps - PM2.5, PM10, Ozone, NO2, SO2, CO, CO2
• NWS Warnings, Watches & Advisories (US)

Know exactly what you're breathing - and where the reading comes from.

AirScope combines hyper-local air quality, species-level pollen forecasts, wildfire smoke tracking, and real-time NOAA weather radar in one app. Every reading is labeled Measured, Combined, or Estimated, so you always know how much to trust it - something no other air-quality app shows you.

AIRSCOPE FEATURES
• Home Screen & Lock Screen Widgets - today's tree, grass, weed, and mold levels at a glance, without opening the app.

• Symptom Trends - charts that line your symptom diary up against pollen and pollution levels, so your personal triggers emerge over time.

bluejetty:00152847:ios.description:
RETHOUGHT – HEALING JOURNEY
Put a calmer perspective in your pocket.
Rethought helps you turn heavy, overwhelming thoughts into softer ones that actually feel real. Whether you’re going through a breakup, struggling with loneliness, stuck in overthinking, or just dealing with a tough day — Rethought gives you short reframes that lighten your mood without fake positivity. Open the app, select what you’re feeling, and receive words that bring comfort, perspective, and calm.
WHY RETHOUGHT WORKS
Science-based feed – During a quick onboarding, we ask a few gentle questions about your emotions, mindset, and struggles. Our engine blends psychology research with mood learning to suggest reframes that truly fit you, not random affirmations.
Daily perspective cues – Small nudges help when you need them most: quiet overthinking, soften negative self-talk, reduce anxiety, and remind you that you’re not alone.
Emotional habit loop – Real change happens in small steps. Every gentle reframe shifts your perspective slightly, helping you build resilience, increase self-trust, and feel lighter over time.
CUSTOM THEMES
Choose from many handcrafted backgrounds and fonts. Match your vibe — soft pastels, minimal, dark mode, calming gradients, nature, abstract art, or bold designs. Every theme is created to soothe your mood and make the words feel personal.
TOPIC LIBRARY
Explore a wide range of categories designed for real emotions:
Loneliness & isolation
Breakups & heartbreak
Anxiety & stress
Overthinking & self-doubt
Self-esteem & confidence
Positivity & hope
Calm & presence
Gratitude & mindfulness
Resilience & growth
Daily motivation & support
More packs are added regularly: relationships, career stress, healing after loss, self-love, faith and spirituality, and many more.
SIMPLE TO USE
Scroll for a fresh reframe anytime
Save favorites to revisit when you need comfort
Share as text, image, or story on Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, WhatsApp, or any app
Add a Home-Screen or Lock-Screen widget (iOS 14+) to see reframes instantly without opening the app
Set daily reminders or calming evening prompts to end the day on a softer note
Search by keyword, author, or topic to find exactly what you need
BUILT FOR MENTAL WELLNESS
Rethought is designed for real people and real struggles: loneliness, anxiety, sadness, breakups, overthinking, stress, self-doubt, and low confidence.
Instead of long courses or generic affirmations, you get short, human words that feel honest and practical. They don’t tell you what to do — they gently shift how you see yourself and your situation, which research shows is one of the most effective tools for emotional well-being.
RETHOUGHT PREMIUM
Unlock the full experience with Rethought Premium:
Access all calming themes
Open every reframe category, including premium packs for breakups, overthinking, and self-esteem
Unlimited daily nudges and reminders
A personalized journey that grows with your feelings and feedback

bluejetty:00185316:ios.description:
Jungle Boy is a side-scrolling game featuring 2D retro style graphics. The objective is to walk or run to the right, avoiding nasties and rocks. If you touch any nasties you lose a life, collect as many food as you can.
Spiders fall down from a strand of web before climbing back up and repeat the process, in some situations you will have to jump over a spider than walking under to avoid them.
Nasties move towards you along the ground, your only option is to jump over them or if available jumping onto a cloud.
Rocks will make you trip up, preventing you from running forward or jumping until you are clear of the rock.
NOTE:

bluejetty:00018955:ios.description:
Call of Duty®: Mobile FPS is the definitive online multiplayer FPS shooter and battle royale game on mobile. Jump into fast-paced shooting games with iconic Call of Duty maps, modes, operators, and weapons in one free-to-play experience designed for fans of gun games, sniper games, and tactical shooters.
Join millions of players in Call of Duty®: Mobile as you rank up, unlock powerful loadouts, and dominate competitive multiplayer and massive battle royale matches. Whether you love 5v5 FPS games, large-scale battle royale games, or tense ranked competitive play, Call of Duty: Mobile delivers authentic Call of Duty action wherever you play.
KEY FEATURES
• Fast-paced online multiplayer FPS shooter gameplay built for mobile.
• Massive battle royale modes with squads, vehicles, and tactical combat.
• Competitive ranked play that rewards skill and progression.
MULTIPLAYER AND RANKED COMPETITIVE
• Classic multiplayer across legendary Call of Duty maps like Nuketown, Shipment, Rust, Terminal, Raid, Hijacked, and more.
• Play core modes including Team Deathmatch, Domination, Search & Destroy, Hardpoint, Frontline, and limited-time playlists.
• Climb through Ranked Multiplayer, earn seasonal rewards, and prove your skills against players from around the world.
• Reach Legendary rank to unlock new levels of competition inspired by professional Call of Duty esports.
BATTLE ROYALE ON MOBILE
• Drop into large battle royale maps built for mobile FPS action.
• Squad up, pilot vehicles, and use tactical gadgets to outplay other teams in 100-player survival matches.
• Experience intense gunfights, strategic rotations, and high-stakes final circles as you fight to be the last squad standing.
SEASONAL MODES, EVENTS, AND CHALLENGES
• Play rotating limited-time modes and seasonal events that refresh the action.
• Take on in-game challenges and missions to earn themed rewards.
LEGENDARY WEAPONS AND LOADOUT CUSTOMIZATION
• Unlock and upgrade iconic weapons from across Call of Duty history, from assault rifles and SMGs to sniper rifles and LMGs.
• Customize your FPS loadouts with attachments, perks, scorestreaks, operators, and skins to match your playstyle.
• Experiment with different builds for close-range aggression, long-range sniper play, or balanced all-around gun game setups.
NEW SEASONS, EVENTS, AND REWARDS
• Enjoy frequent updates with new maps, modes, events, operators, weapons, and themed rewards.
• Complete seasonal challenges, event missions, and battle passes to unlock exclusive content.
OPTIMIZED FOR MOBILE
• Smooth controls, adjustable settings, and multiple HUD options tailor the FPS experience to your device.
• Optional HD resources, maps, and content downloads let you control game size while keeping top-tier graphics.
Download Call of Duty®: Mobile now to experience one of the top FPS shooting games on mobile. Jump into online multiplayer, battle royale, and competitive ranked modes—all in a single Call of Duty game you can play anytime, anywhere.

bluejetty:00073237:ios.description:
Honkai: Star Rail is a HoYoverse space fantasy RPG.
Hop aboard the Astral Express and experience the galaxy's infinite wonders filled with adventure and thrills.
Players will meet new companions across various worlds and maybe even run into some familiar faces. Overcome the struggles together caused by Stellaron and unravel the hidden truths behind it! May this journey lead us starward!
□ Explore Distinct Worlds — Discover the boundless universe filled with wonder
3, 2, 1, initiating warp! A space station with Curios sealed away, a foreign planet with an eternal winter, a starship hunting down abominations, the Planet of Festivities nested in sweet dreams, The Eternal Land where destiny hangs by a thread, the arcadia that had once fallen into a painting scroll... Every stop of the Astral Express is a never-before-seen view of the galaxy! Explore fantastical worlds and civilizations, uncover mysteries beyond imagination, and set out on a journey of wonder!
□ Riveting RPG Experience — A best-in-class immersive adventure beyond the stars
Embark on a galactic adventure where you shape the story. Our cutting-edge engine renders high-quality cinematics in real-time, our innovative facial expression system concocts genuine sentiments, and HOYO-MiX's original score sets the stage. Join us now and journey through a universe of conflict and collaboration, where your choices define the outcome!
□ Fateful Encounters Await! — Cross paths with characters intertwined by destiny
As you traverse the sea of stars, you'll not only have countless adventures, but also many chance encounters. You will forge friendships in a frozen land, fight side by side with comrades in the Xianzhou crisis, and have unexpected encounters in a golden dream. A game of an Aeon when the Phantasmoon waxes full... On this alien world, you will meet greet companions walking these different paths amongst the starts and experience incredible journeys together. Let your laughter and woes compose the story of your present, past, and future.
□ Turn-based Combat Reimagined — Exhilarating multifaceted gameplay fueled by strategy and skill
Engage in a combat system that sports a variety of team compositions. Match your lineups based on your enemy's qualities and strike while the iron is hot to bring down your foes and claim victory! Break Weaknesses! Deliver Follow-up Attacks! Deal Damage over Time... and try out the brand-new Aha Instant! Countless strategies and tactics await your unlocking. Build an approach suited for you and face the onrush of successive challenges! Beyond the thrilling turn-based combat, there are also simulation management modes, casual elimination mini-games, puzzle exploration, and more... Explore an exciting variety of gameplay and experience endless possibilities!
□ Top-Tier Voice Actors for an Immersive Experience — A dream team of multiple language dubs assembled for the entire story
When words come alive, when stories give you a choice, when characters possess a soul... We present to you dozens of emotions, hundreds of facial expressions, thousands of lore pieces, and a million words that make up this universe's beating heart. With full voice-over in four languages, the characters will transcend their virtual existences and become your tangible companions, creating a new chapter in this tale together with you.

bluejetty:00107414:android.description:
From June 1, 2019, the Traffic Police Department officially launched software to check traffic violations for cars, motorcycles, and electric bikes.
In an effort to raise awareness and promptly handle violations, we provide a traffic violation lookup application with a rich data source for drivers.
To date, the traffic violation camera system has been deployed in most of the 53 provinces nationwide, including national highways, expressways, and urban areas, to penalize offenses such as speeding, wrong lane use, disobeying traffic signals, and more.
To help drivers easily check violation information after being detected by the national traffic violation camera system, we have launched the National Traffic Violation Lookup application to make it easier for drivers to check and find their own violations.
Main features of the application:
✔️ Lookup license plates of cars, motorcycles, and electric bikes for traffic violations.
✔️ Check traffic violation fines and driver's violation information.
✔️ Provide information including: time, location of violation, type of violation, the unit issuing the fine, and especially the penalty amount and payment required.
✔️ Provide the number of violations.
✔️ Support links to online fine payment websites.
✔️ Easily search for traffic violation points in Vietnam.
✔️ Additionally, if your vehicle is about to undergo inspection, you can add the inspection sticker number for the application to support lookups from the Registry Department.
✔️ For the VIP version, you can add multiple vehicles, and the system will support you by regularly sending notifications about your violations.
Important note:
To effectively use the application, you should first check for violations at the Traffic Police Department, then continue checking from the Registry Department to be more assured before going for vehicle inspection.
Currently, the software supports multiple platforms including iPhone, Android, and Web.
We hope to receive your support. For any questions or support issues, please contact us at the address below.
Disclaimer:
The application is developed based on data from the 'Electronic Portal of the Traffic Police Department' at https://csgt.vn, with all data issued by the Ministry of Public Security - Traffic Police Department.

listings.name: Vietnamese Cold Penalty Lookup
listings.description:
From June 1, 2019, the Traffic Police Department officially launched software to check traffic violations for cars, motorcycles, and electric bikes.

In an effort to raise awareness and promptly handle violations, we provide a traffic violation lookup application with a rich data source for drivers.

To date, the traffic violation camera system has been deployed in most of the 53 provinces nationwide, including national highways, expressways, and urban areas, to penalize offenses such as speeding, wrong lane use, disobeying traffic signals, and more.

To help drivers easily check violation information after being detected by the national traffic violation camera system, we have launched the National Traffic Violation Lookup application to make it easier for drivers to check and find their own violations.

Main features of the application:
✔️ Lookup license plates of cars, motorcycles, and electric bikes for traffic violations.
✔️ Check traffic violation fines and driver's violation information.
✔️ Provide information including: time, location of violation, type of violation, the unit issuing the fine, and especially the penalty amount and payment required.
✔️ Provide the number of violations.
✔️ Support links to online fine payment websites.
✔️ Easily search for traffic violation points in Vietnam.
✔️ Additionally, if your vehicle is about to undergo inspection, you can add the inspection sticker number for the application to support lookups from the Registry Department.
✔️ For the VIP version, you can add multiple vehicles, and the system will support you by regularly sending notifications about your violations.

Important note:
To effectively use the application, you should first check for violations at the Traffic Police Department, then continue checking from the Registry Department to be more assured before going for vehicle inspection.

Currently, the software supports multiple platforms including iPhone, Android, and Web.
We hope to receive your support. For any questions or support issues, please contact us at the address below.

Disclaimer:
The application is developed based on data from the 'Electronic Portal of the Traffic Police Department' at https://csgt.vn, with all data issued by the Ministry of Public Security - Traffic Police Department.

bluejetty:00091269:ios.name: CoinsWorth: Coin Grade & Value
bluejetty:00091269:ios.summary: Find out what you have, what drives its value, and what to check next. Photograph the front and back of a supported US coin to explore its identification, estimated condition and value. Your first successful full report is free and remains
bluejetty:00091269:ios.description:
Find out what you have, what drives its value, and what to check next. Photograph the front and back of a supported US coin to explore its identification, estimated condition and value. Your first successful full report is free and remains available to revisit.
START WITH YOUR COIN
Take two photos or import pictures you already have. See the suggested identification and check the alternatives when the match does not look right. Photo quality and unclear dates or mint marks can affect the answer.
UNDERSTAND THE ESTIMATE
Explore the estimated grade and its uncertainty. Where supporting data is available, compare auction results and distinguish an estimate for your loose coin from prices for professionally graded examples. Estimates are a starting point for research, not a guaranteed sale price.
CHECK THE METAL VALUE
For supported silver and gold coins, see metal-content value from the available spot-price data, with its update time. Metal value and collector value are different ways to understand a coin; they are not added together. A dealer's offer may differ.
CORRECT THE IDENTIFICATION
Use "Not this coin?" to select a better match. CoinsWorth requests updated pricing for that identity where supported. If a reliable estimate is unavailable, the report says so.
ORGANIZE YOUR COLLECTION
Keep your scanned coins together and revisit their reports. Browse and tick off checklists for State Quarters, wheat cents, Morgan dollars and more. Some recent-issue checklists require manual entries when automatic identification is not supported.
FREE AND PRO
Your first successful full report is included. Additional full reports and premium collection features require CoinsWorth Pro. Browsing and manually checking off set checklists is free. Available plans, prices and any eligible trial are shown before purchase.
AI identification, grades and values are estimates, not authentication, professional certification or guaranteed sale prices. Photo quality, coin condition and market changes can affect results. CoinsWorth's grading reports cover supported US coins.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
CoinsWorth Pro offers auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation, or after an eligible free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings, or from Account > Manage subscription in the app. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Privacy Policy: https://coinsworth.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://coinsworth.com/terms.html
Support: support@coinsworth.com

bluejetty:00175638:ios.name: Clue
bluejetty:00175638:ios.summary:
Join fellow detectives all over the world in the official digital board game version of Clue! Gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects and solve the original murder mystery.
Follow Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Professor Plum, Chef
bluejetty:00175638:ios.description:
Join fellow detectives all over the world in the official digital board game version of Clue! Gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects and solve the original murder mystery.
Follow Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Professor Plum, Chef White, Solicitor Peacock and Mayor Green through the iconic Tudor Mansion, unlocking their motives and alibis as you go. 
Enjoy Clue the way you remember it in Classic Mode, or jump in for a quick game with Clue Cards mode. Alternatively, if you want to really test your sleuthing skills, try a new investigation format available exclusively to Clue – Ultimate Detective.
In Ultimate Detective Mode, everyone answers suggestions at the same time…but secretly! 
Face your suspects in a direct interrogation as you rely on your skills of deduction to get to the truth. Experience the mystery, solve the murder and become a top-tier detective!
HOW TO PLAY CLUE: 
1. Three cards are dealt face-down and set aside – this is the solution to the crime!
2. Everyone is dealt three cards. These are automatically crossed off your clue sheet, as they can’t be part of the solution. 
3. Roll the dice and move around the board. 
4. When you enter a room, you can make a suggestion – select who you think the murderer is, what weapon they used and where the crime happened. 
5. Other players will then aim to disprove your suggestion; if one of your suggestions matches a card in their hand, they show you that card to disprove it. 
6. Use your clue sheet to keep track of which characters, weapons and rooms have been disproven. 
7. Think you’ve figured it out? It’s time to make an accusation! Be careful though – if you’re right, you win, but if you are wrong, you’re out!
FEATURES
- THE CLASSIC TUDOR MANSION – Play the beloved original board game, now rendered in stunning 3D animation and entirely ad-free! 
- A BRAND-NEW GAME MODE – Exclusive to the digital version of Clue, Ultimate Detective Mode lets you interrogate multiple characters at once.
- MULTIPLE MODES – Compete against cutting-edge AI opponents that adapt to your skill level for the perfect game, or challenge detectives around the world. 
- ADDITIONAL ORIGINAL CONTENT – What happened after the shocking events of Tudor Mansion? Find out in a series of original new crime scenes designed specifically for the digital version of Clue! New characters emerge, bringing with them new clues, motives and case files to consider as you travel around the world in search of the truth. 
Sharpen your mind with the iconic murder-mystery board game, now available on mobile!

bluejetty:00114318:ios.description:
Brick Blast is an engaging bricks and balls game with simple rules, a hint of challenge, and plenty of effortless fun. Pick your angle, shoot the balls, and watch them blast through every brick in their path.
Brick Blast delivers pure enjoyment with no rush or pressure. Play at your own pace and enjoy smooth, dynamic gameplay that will help you unwind while training your logic and focus.
How to Play Brick Blast:
The goal is simple: break the bricks and keep the board clear. Swipe to aim and release to shoot—the ball shooter sends glowing balls flying across the screen, bouncing off walls and smashing through colorful blocks. Plan your shots wisely to hit the best angles, clear multiple bricks at once, and watch the balls bounce out across the board in dazzling chains of glowing hits before the blocks reach the bottom line.
Discover power blocks that make this block breaker even more exciting:
• Laser shoots across rows or columns, damaging all blocks along its path.
• Multiplier triples your balls for massive combos.
• Redirect changes the path to reach tricky angles.
• Extra Ball gives you more power until the end of the round.
Use power blocks skillfully to enjoy mighty ball blasts and brick-breaking chain reactions.

• A calming pastime—no pressure, no time limits, just pure focus and pleasure.
• A fun way to unwind while honing your strategy skills—perfect for players who love puzzle quests and brick-breaking games.
• Endless ball breaker gameplay that keeps you coming back for more.

bluejetty:00164867:ios.summary: Return to Woanope as Flux Dabes, intergalactic trucker and disgruntled corporate employee. After years away from the planet under a lucrative (if morally dubious) spokesperson contract for the Bureau of Shipping, you return to visit some ol
bluejetty:00164867:ios.description:
Return to Woanope as Flux Dabes, intergalactic trucker and disgruntled corporate employee. After years away from the planet under a lucrative (if morally dubious) spokesperson contract for the Bureau of Shipping, you return to visit some old pals and recover from corporate burnout. But before your vacation can even begin, a mysterious blast from the planet's surface sends you crashing into a new land, far from friends and alone in an alien wilderness.
EXPLORE A DYNAMIC ALIEN WORLD
Woanope is alive, thrumming with ecological interactions, curious creatures, friendly alien societies, and heaps of stories to uncover. Lure a Trunkle into an explosive meadow, fish up some Pho-rays by moonlight, or help those mischievous alien kids commune with a (probably) harmless multidimensional being. What could go wrong?
FIGHT ON YOUR TERMS
As you explore Woanope you'll discover and craft all manner of gadgets, elixirs, and weapons that deliver mix-and-match playstyles. Fight using stealth, traps, environmental hazards, and distance weapons. Or chug an Elixir of Juking, stun your opponent with a Space Wok, and jump right into the fray. Or just get... weird? Turn fish into bombs, or make a Pact with the Void to convert your pain into martial prowess.
CONSTRUCT A HOME AWAY FROM HOME
After a long day of exploring the wilderness, fighting Sluggabuns, and getting sneezed on by Trunkles, you'll need a place for you and your alien pals to relax. Build a cozy home-away-from-home where you can retreat from the outside world to craft, chat, fish, and farm -- or tame that orphaned Sluggababby you adopted -- in peace. Just don't forget to make space for your newfound friends... and potential roommates.
BUILD FRIENDSHIPS
Meet a colorful cast of characters in your journey across Woanope, each with their own unique skills and knowledge. Befriend them, help them with their goals, and discover new crafting recipes together through the power of friendship.
RAISE ADORABLE PETS
Find creature eggs out in the world, figure out how to hatch them, and raise them as little companions. You'll teach them the ways of the world and help them grow into formidable beasts. In return they'll keep you safe during your adventures.
CHANGE THE WORLD
Being zapped out of orbit was a pretty big clue that something is going awry on Woanope. But what!? Join the locals to figure out what's gone wrong, who's responsible, and how to make things right.
