bluejetty:00015186:ios.description:
Easy Anatomy is your ultimate guide to learning human anatomy.
Master anatomy faster and more effectively with our interactive 3D Atlas, Voice AI Tutor, Daily Review, flashcards, study notes, and expert-made videos. Perfect for medical students, athletes, artists, and anyone who wants to truly understand the human body.
High-detail 3D Atlas
Explore anatomically accurate male and female models with over 11,000 structures. Study every system of the body — from the skeleton to blood vessels — with maximum precision. Intuitive navigation makes it easy to focus on what really matters: knowledge.
Voice AI Anatomy Tutor
Talk to your anatomy tutor the way you'd talk to a professor. Ask any question out loud — the AI answers with voice and controls the 3D atlas in real time: highlights structures, isolates systems, focuses the camera on exactly what you're studying. It builds personalized study plans, runs quick quizzes, and guides you to the right videos, notes, and 3D materials. No other anatomy app has this.
Daily Review with Spaced Repetition
Every structure you study is tracked through four mastery levels — New, Learning, Known, and Mastered. Daily Review shows you exactly what to refresh today so you don't forget before your exam. Build a streak, master long-term retention, and turn anatomy into a daily habit.
16,000+ Illustrated Flashcards
Bright, clear illustrations designed for quick memorization. Reinforce learning with engaging quizzes. Flashcards cover all major systems, great for daily practice or exam prep.
3D Quizzes
Test yourself directly on the 3D model by finding and identifying structures — a powerful way to reinforce your memory that no other atlas offers.
500+ Expert Study Notes
Concise and to the point. Mind maps, charts, and summaries make even the toughest topics easier to grasp.
Videos
Not just lectures. Each video is a carefully crafted story where complex topics are broken down into simple parts, supported by illustrations and animations.
Fitness & Motion
See how muscles work in motion. Learn proper technique execution, improve biomechanics, and avoid mistakes with detailed 3D animations.
Our mission is to make anatomy accessible, engaging, and practical for learners everywhere. We keep improving the app, listening to your feedback, and adding new features to help you study more effectively.
Download Easy Anatomy today and start learning more effectively!

A UNIQU
bluejetty:00015372:ios.description:
With TV5MONDE EDU, learn French through videos from the TV5MONDE universe and expand your knowledge across a wide range of subjects. It is simple, easy and free. The exercises are aimed at beginners (A1) to advanced learners (B2).
A UNIQUE TEACHING APPROACH 
- You learn to understand French as it is spoken in Paris, Geneva, Dakar, Montreal, Brussels, and elsewhere. 
- You learn grammar and vocabulary in context. 
- You discover cultures, the French-speaking world, and the evolution of the French language.
- You learn about world affairs and explore art, science, history, and major issues related to the environment and human rights.
VIDEO AT THE HEART OF LEARNING
- Hundreds of videos to help you understand the world in French (news reports, music videos, film clips, etc.),
- Images help you understand situations and dialogue,
- Each video comes with subtitles and a French transcript.
PERSONALISED LEARNING
- You choose videos on topics that interest you: current affairs, music, fashion, cooking, art, history, everyday life, etc.
- You choose the skills you want to learn, and you will automatically be given a selection of videos and exercises tailored to your needs.
- You select the words and expressions you want to learn, and the app makes it easy to review and memorise them.
WAYS TO SUPPORT YOUR MOTIVATION
- You get new exercises every week.
- The exercises are varied so you don’t get bored (multiple choice questions, crosswords, fill-in-the-blank texts, etc.).
- Our intelligent method for memorising new words adapts to your knowledge.
- The beginner’s course is translated into 9 languages: German, English, Arabic, Korean, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian and Vietnamese.
LEARNING IN ALL CIRCUMSTANCES
- Content can be downloaded for use without internet connection.
- Video downloads are optimised to save data.
- Your results are saved and synchronised with the apprendre.tv5monde.com website.
TRAINING FOR TESTS AND CERTIFICATES
- Prepare for the TCF French language proficiency test with practice tests and a simulator that replicates real exam conditions.
- Prepare for professional French language certificates (international relations, business) with exercises based on real-life professional situations.
FRENCH-AS-A-FOREIGN-LANGUAGE (FLE) SPECIALISTS AT YOUR SERVICE
- TV5MONDE has been developing educational resources for 30 years.
- The exercises are created by French teachers at Alliance Française centres.
- Test and diploma training courses are produced in collaboration with France Éducation international and the Paris-Île-de-France Chamber of Commerce and Industry.
PRICE
Everything is free.

bluejetty:00145892:ios.name: Sniper Range Game
bluejetty:00145892:ios.summary: Most 3D Sniper Games are too simple, you just shoot straight to the target... reality is not like that. In this realistic simulation you can customize the cartridges, the bullets, the firearms, and select your favourite range. All relevant
bluejetty:00145892:ios.description:
Most 3D Sniper Games are too simple, you just shoot straight to the target... reality is not like that. In this realistic simulation you can customize the cartridges, the bullets, the firearms, and select your favourite range. All relevant information about weapons and ammunitions are procedurally generated, so it's also possible to change almost any property.
This game includes a good enough approximation of internal ballistics, it has a great external ballistics simulation, and it's about to feature terminal ballistics (destruction, ricochets, barrier penetration, and softbody penetration). 
The most important physics factors are modeled into this realistic sniper range game: gravity, drag (G7 Ballistic Coefficient), spindrift, and wind. It features realistic Scopes configurations: Elevation, Zoom with appropriately scaled reticles, and Windage. There's also an in-game and easy-to-use ballistic calculator to make it possible to make one-shot/one-hits under wild weather conditions.
This game was contrasted with JBM Ballistics giving great results.

bluejetty:00066081:ios.name: King of Bugs: Tower Defense
bluejetty:00066081:ios.summary: Embark on a captivating adventure with "King of Bugs", a tower defense game that takes you deep into the heart of the ant kingdom. King Karl leads his ants on a journey through a magical forest teeming with evil bugs as he seeks a new home
bluejetty:00066081:ios.description:
Embark on a captivating adventure with "King of Bugs", a tower defense game that takes you deep into the heart of the ant kingdom. King Karl leads his ants on a journey through a magical forest teeming with evil bugs as he seeks a new home for his people.
In this base defense strategy game, you'll experience a unique blend of tower defense dynamics. Defend the king against waves of bugs, deploying a variety of defense strategies and upgrading Karl's armor, sword, and protective fences to shield him from the insect onslaught.
The game offers a rich storyline, combining elements of love, courage and deceit within the ant kingdom. Immerse yourself in a cartoonish yet vibrant world, filled with colorful art and memorable characters. Engage in epic battles and clash with various bug adversaries, each level bringing new challenges and boss battles.
As you progress through levels, you can improve Karl's gear and unlock new abilities. Utilize a variety of different turrets driven by ants, with four kinds of towers, each tower featuring several upgrades. Every upgrade opens up new tactical possibilities, allowing you to craft a unique strategy for each level.
Key Features:
Fun and strategic tower defense gameplay
- Journey through a magical forest to find a new home for King's people
- Engaging and bright storyline
- Upgrade King's armor, sword, and protective fences
- Cartoonish and colorful art
- Author's music enhances the gaming atmosphere
- Memorable characters and fantasy storytelling
- Variety of turrets driven by ants, with four kinds of towers
- Deploy Karl's ants and ant mercenaries in towers to make them even more powerful
- Multiple upgrades for each tower, unlocking new tactical possibilities
Are you ready to lead Karl and his loyal companions into the ultimate clash of bugs and ants-defenders? Upgrade your towers, plan your strategy, and defend your ant kingdom in "King of Bugs", where tiny ants and epic adventures collide!

The Virtual Keypad™ App gives you control of your security system on-the-go. Connect to your home or business system to arm or disarm, control lights, locks, thermostats and more, easily with your app. Even view and record video from your security cameras. 
With the Virtual Keypad App, you can: 
• Arm and disarm your system
• View what’s happening at your home or business
• Control Z-Wave-connected devices such as thermostats, lights, locks and garage doors individually or all at once
• Set up Actions to automatically control your system throughout the day 
• View and control Z-Wave devices using a photo or a security camera 
• Receive notifications when doors are opened or closed
• View security cameras and your recorded clips 
• Add users to your security system from your app
• Search your complete system event history
• Cancel or verify alarms with live video view
The app requires a compatible control panel and connected service. For more information about upgrading your alarm system, contact your DMP installing alarm company today. 
All features may not come standard with your app. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

Whether you have food allergies or follow a specialized diet like Low FODMAP, Glute
bluejetty:00175456:ios.description:
With 1M+ satisfied members, Fig is the only app that supports EVERY dietary restriction and allergy, helping you find food you CAN eat and avoid reactions.
Whether you have food allergies or follow a specialized diet like Low FODMAP, Gluten-Free, Vegan, Low Histamine, Alpha-Gal, or any of our 2,800+ other options, Fig empowers you to navigate grocery aisles and restaurants with confidence and reclaim your love for food.
No more second-guessing or tedious label reading—simply scan, discover, and enjoy a wide range of foods that align with the specific dietary needs of you and your loved ones.
CUSTOMER REVIEWS
“This app is an ABSOLUTE GODSEND and I cannot recommend it enough. It works amazingly, is so easy to use, scans things super quickly and allows you to put in so many different things (I’ve got allergies, intolerances, and OAS [yay me, right!])” -Karina C.
“Fig has changed my life. Being able to easily scan labels and quickly see if a product is safe for me to eat has been a game changer. I used to cry almost every time I went to the store. My eyesight is terrible, so reading labels is difficult. Now I can get in and out easily. Thank you!!” -Allegra K.
“I have never felt more liberated, supported, seen and represented by an app and its founders. I am better able to manage my allergies and food intolerances through Fig and it has made an immense impact in my everyday life.” -Rachel S.
“Food allergies had turned grocery shopping into a nightmare for me. I was having so much trouble finding foods that I could eat that I started having panic attacks. A friend told me about the Fig app & I immediately downloaded it. My life changed again, only this time for the better! Wow, not only was I able to find new foods to eat, but I also discovered many foods that I thought were okay-weren’t. My health improved. I’m so thankful for Fig. -Raella T.
"Finally, an app that understands the needs of families with dietary restrictions. The Multiple Figs feature is a game-changer for managing my kids' allergies. Thank you, Fig!" - Jason M.
KEY FEATURES
-Check if a product’s ingredients are compatible with your diet in under a second using the barcode scanner
-Discover a comprehensive list of foods that work for you at 100+ grocery stores and restaurants.
-Learn about ingredients and follow complex diets with confidence.
-Make a profile for everyone you care about and find food that works for everyone at once.
-Create shopping lists and save hours at the grocery store.
Fig goes beyond basic ingredient analysis. Our powerful technology is powered by millions of ingredient ratings and notes from our team of 11+ expert dietitians, to help you find what you CAN eat at grocery stores and restaurants. No matter how unique your dietary needs are, Fig has got you covered.
Join the Fig Movement
Our small team consists of individuals with dietary restrictions, just like you. We understand the struggles and challenges you face, and we're committed to continually improving Fig to meet your evolving needs and fighting for causes that matter to us. Together, we're building the app we’ve all dreamed of and fostering a community where you feel represented and welcomed.
Download Fig Today!
Save yourself from the pain of reading every label, researching every ingredient, and wasting money on products you can't actually eat. Start using Fig and experience the joy of finding food that makes you feel your best.
We respect your privacy. For more information, please read our privacy policy at http://foodisgood.com/privacy.
By using Fig, you agree to our terms of service. Read them at http://foodisgood.com/terms-of-service.
Fig is free to download and use. However, we offer an additional subscription (Fig+) that unlocks additional features, including Restaurants, Multiple Figs, Unlimited Scans and more.
Want something added to the app? Email support@foodisgood.com and we’ll be happy to help you!

bluejetty:00023415:ios.description:
Harvest games for toddlers is a great way to play and learn something about our world for children. Start a new adventure with your little ones and our kindergarten game will help in creating children's place of interest. In the first module of the car games for kids we make bread in a bakery using modern industrial technology!
Machines for sowing seeds and fertilizer spreaders, watering machines, tractor and huge combine harvesters. The game seems to open the curtain behind the scenes of the farm world. It will be curious not only for preschoolers but for very little ones too. While getting some useful information children are able to play really fun!
The modern world is so universal - it offers almost everything we need but let’s look deep: where does the food come from on our table? How does it get to the store? What is it made of? Who makes it? And how long does the whole process take?
Now let's figure it out! When we see a ruddy and mouth-watering bread on the counter of the store we should remember: its path to us is long and extremely exciting!
- Arrange puzzles to build a car, repair it if necessary, wash it and send it on a mission in the field;
- Come through all stages of creating a fertile field, caring for the soil, sowing seeds and harvest time until the final stage - delicious bread;
- Your kid will find out how agricultural technology works, remember each name of all large and useful machines and learn what tasks they help people with;
- Children will not only observe the whole process of growing wheat but the kid will be a mechanic, a washer, an agronomist and a great connoisseur of nature and its gifts;
- The game trains memory, attention and observation as well as develops fine motor skills and coordination through mini-games between main tasks.
Always happy with your feedback and impressions at: support@gokidsmobile.com
Join our Facebook community: https://www.facebook.com/GoKidsMobile/
and follow us on Instagram https://www.instagram.com/gokidsapps/

bluejetty:00089073:ios.summary:

A World of Minigames: Explore a rich tapestry of
bluejetty:00089073:ios.description:
With many immersive features including: 
Interactive Idle Gameplay: Break free from conventional clicker games as you actively personalise and grow your guild, making every decision count.
A World of Minigames: Explore a rich tapestry of professions through completing various minigames such as mining, potion-crafting and bartending to gather the materials needed to equip your guild for missions. Their strength is forged through your skills, and the path to victory lies in your mastery of these professions.
Quest for Glory: Embark on daring adventures of quests and dungeons. Rise to fame as you conquer challenges and complete feats, attracting new classes of adventurer to your guild, each bringing unique skills and abilities.
Ad-Free Enjoyment: Bid farewell to intrusive ads with our optional ad system, ensuring uninterrupted gameplay.
Take your gameplay a step above other idle games with interactive minigames for each profession:
- Bartending: Serve drinks to the citizens for the gold needed to purchase upgrades for your guild.
- Apothecary: Experiment with different herbs and other ingredients to discover magical potions, giving your adventurers the edge when fighting the powerful monsters scattered throughout the dungeon.
- Foraging: Search through the forests to find wild vegetables and the herbs needed to craft potions.
- Gardening: Manage your garden to grow the crops needed to cook the best food for your guild-members.
- Cooking: Combine collected ingredients in the kitchen to provide food for your adventurers, granting them powerful buffs.
- Hunting: Hunt wild beasts for meats to use in the kitchen, and hides to craft the armour needed by your adventurers.
- Mining: Search through the mines for precious metals and gemstones to be used when crafting gear at the blacksmith.
- Tree Felling: Chop trees for the building materials needed to expand your guild, with each new structure adding opportunities for your guild to prosper.

bluejetty:00132576:ios.description:

In der App finden Sie den SPAR-Code – Ihren persönlichen Strichcode. Lassen Sie diesen bei jedem Einkauf an der Kassa scannen. Schon sparen Sie automatisch!
Einfach sparen:
Mit dem Joker ist Sparen so einfach wie noch nie! Ein Joker reduziert den teuersten, rabattberechtigten Artikel um -25%. Maximal vier teuerste, rabattberechtigte Artikel können pro Einkauf mit den Jokern reduziert werden.
SPAR-Produktwelt:
In der SPAR-Produktwelt entdecken Sie die ganze Vielfalt des SPAR-Sortiments – alle Eigenmarkenartikel von S-BUDGET, SPAR Natur*pur, SPAR PREMIUM, etc. bis hin zu zahlreichen Markenartikeln aus den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Getränke, Drogerie & Beauty sowie Haushalt. Die SPAR-Produktwelt bietet für über 30.000 Artikel alle Informationen zu Inhaltsstoffen, Allergenen, Nährwerten, Preisen, Aktionen und Verfügbarkeiten in Echtzeit für alle Vertriebslinien. So finden Sie schnell, was Sie suchen, und können Ihren Einkauf ganz einfach planen.
Exklusive Gutscheine:
Entdecken Sie regelmäßig exklusive Gutscheine und sparen Sie noch mehr. Ihre Ersparnis wird Ihnen sofort angezeigt und wächst mit jedem Einkauf.

Mit den digitalen Rechnungen haben Sie einen Überblick über alle Ihre Einkäufe und sparen nicht nur Papier, sondern auch Zeit an der Kassa.
Voll informiert:
Mit der SPAR-App sind Sie überall und zu jeder Zeit über die aktuellen Flugblätter und Neuigkeiten von SPAR, EUROSPAR und INTERSPAR informiert. 
Lieblingsmärkte:
Mit der Standortsuche finden Sie schnell Ihren SPAR-Markt in der Nähe, inklusive der Öffnungszeiten und allen zusätzlichen Services dieses Marktes. Außerdem erhalten Sie jene Gutscheine, die nur in Ihrer Region statt in ganz Österreich gelten, wenn Sie zumindest einen Lieblingsmarkt hinzugefügt haben.

Embark on a c
bluejetty:00171768:ios.description:
Welcome to Landover, the ultimate strategy board game that transports you to a vibrant world of islands and settlement building! If you love hexagon resource gathering strategy games, you're in for an unforgettable adventure!
Embark on a captivating journey of exploration, resource management, and cunning strategy. In Landover, you'll take on the role of a visionary settler seeking to establish and expand your civilization across the enchanting islands of this world. 
Play solo games against a wide array of different bots all with varying skill levels, personalities, and play styles! 
Or play up to 8 player games with friends, family, or other Landover community members. 
In Landover you can build your very own maps, test them out in single player games, and then play them with friends. If your map becomes popular, it might even be selected as an official Landover map. 
To win at Landover you will need to explore uncharted lands, gather precious resources, and develop your settlements into prosperous and thriving hubs of activity. Trade resources with the bank, form alliances, and compete for dominance in this exciting world-building game.
Key Features:
Map Builder: Build your own custom maps!
Daily Games: Play as many simultaneous daily games as you want. We'll ping you when it's your turn! Don't get bored waiting around for other slow players. 
Engaging Strategy: Plan your moves carefully as you build and expand your settlements. Every decision counts!
Island Exploration: Discover breathtaking islands, each with its unique resources and challenges.
Resource Management: Harvest and manage resources wisely to fuel the growth of your civilization.
Trade: Decide what resources to trade with the bank
Military: Build up your military to defend against barbarian attacks and use your military to raid your opponents (Just like the Robber!)
Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in the colorful and picturesque world of Landover.
Whether you're a seasoned strategy games veteran or a newcomer to the world of board games, Landover offers an immersive and satisfying gameplay experience that will keep you coming back for more.
Are you ready to settle the islands, establish your legacy, and become the master strategist of Landover? Download now and start building your empire!

Privacy Policy: https://nuttyparty.com/legal#privacy-policy

bluejetty:00105338:android.name: Back to Bed - Strategy Game
bluejetty:00105338:android.summary: Back to Bed is a 3D puzzle Indie game set in a unique, beautiful and artistic dream world, wherein you guide the sleepwalker Bob to the safety of his bed. To achieve this, you must take control of Bob’s subconscious guardian named Subob. Th
bluejetty:00105338:android.description:
Back to Bed is a 3D puzzle Indie game set in a unique, beautiful and artistic dream world, wherein you guide the sleepwalker Bob to the safety of his bed. To achieve this, you must take control of Bob’s subconscious guardian named Subob. The pair travels through a surreal and painting-like dreamscapes, filled with objects used to guide Bob towards the Bed, but also dangers that must be avoided! 
No ads and no in-app purchases.
“Back to Bed manages to simultaneously be predictable and surprising, sleepy and lively, scary and comforting—just like any good piece of Surrealist art.” - Killscreen
“Back to Bed is what happens when you let Dali, Escher, and Magritte develop a game.” - PowerUpGaming.co.uk
“What you see isn’t always what it seems, and the moments that use these ploys are some of the best Back to Bed has to offer. It’s mindbending and an utter delight.” - Twinfinite
Features: 
• Unique surreal and artistic game universe: A strange but beautiful dream universe that mixes elements from the real world and the world of dreams to create something unique, surreal and sometimes a bit scary. 
• Isometric puzzle levels: Navigate detailed 3D puzzles that defy the laws of physics, wherein the player must manipulate the strange environment to create a safe path Bob and avoid the dangers of the puzzle. 
• Two characters as one: Play as the embodied subconsciousness, in the form of a small guardian creature, trying to save its own sleepwalking body from dangers of the dream world. 
• Picturesque visual style: Discover the feeling of playing in a piece of art set in a digital frame. A visual style inspired by hand-painted techniques, surreal art and impossible shapes. 
• Nightmare mode: Unlock a more challenging version of the game, made for those who truly want to test their puzzle solving skills and enjoy thinking many steps ahead, or who are just too stubborn to give up. 
• MOGA-support: Enjoy Back to Bed with MOGA controllers.
“Now featured on NVIDIA TegraZone. Plays great with full controller support on NVIDIA SHIELD Portable and SHIELD Tablet, and Android TV.”
Awards & Nominations: 
- IGF Student Showcase Winner 2013 
- Dutch Game Awards 2012: Guts & Glory Indie Award 
- Unity Awards 2012: Best Student Project - Nominee 
- Nordic Game Indie Night 2012: Finalist 
- Casual Connect Europe 2014:

GaitherTV+ invites you to embark on a soul-enriching journey, where music, stories, and faith converge to inspire, uplift, and unite. Join our community today and let the power of gospel music transform your life.

bluejetty:00183235:ios.description:
Join thousands of others delivering and earning with us around their local area. We connect businesses of all shapes and sizes to you via our mobile app, to help them get their products into their customers' hands, and faster than ever before.
The Sherpa Driver app is where you’ll find and accept available jobs in your area, view all active job information, mark them as picked up or delivered, and more.
Why drive with Sherpa:
• You’re in the driver’s seat – you choose which jobs to accept, and when.
• With Senders spanning various industries, you have the freedom to choose the businesses you deliver for, and the suburbs you operate in.
• Find available jobs near you up to 7 days in advance – allowing you to better plan your days and maximise your earnings.
• Customise your notification preferences – turn new job alerts on/off to suit your delivery schedule.
• Follow the Suggested Route to complete stops in the most efficient order, with optimised delivery workflow via batch actions.
• You’ll have your 'regulars'. Build relationships with local business owners and delighted recipients each and every day.
• Clear tracking of your daily, weekly and monthly earnings in-app.
• Regular training to ensure confidence in executing appropriate delivery protocols across a variety of business industries.
• Live chat, phone and email support with Sherpa 7 days a week.
• Available programs and incentives to increase earnings and access exclusive benefits.
To ensure a smooth and quick approval process, we recommend you check out our onboarding checklist available at sherpa.net.au/driver. We can’t wait for you to become a member of our driver partner community. We think you’ll love the autonomy and flexibility of working for yourself as a Sherpa Driver.
Please note: The app tracks your location in the background, this can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00174541:ios.summary:

» Transcribe solo vocal recordings to sheet music 
» Transcribe solo vocal MP3 files to sheet music 
» View the transcribed music as c
bluejetty:00174541:ios.description:
Boost your creativity and transcribe your vocal songs into sheet music. 
All the features of Sing2Notes:
» Transcribe solo vocal recordings to sheet music 
» Transcribe solo vocal MP3 files to sheet music 
» View the transcribed music as classical score 
» Playback the sheet music and listen to the result 
» Download sheet as PDF, MIDI, or MusicXML
» Share your compositions with your friends 
HOW DOES IT WORK? 
Once your music piece is uploaded, our artificial intelligence powered transcriber processes it to generate a sheet music based on what it hears. 
When the processing is finished, you can view the final sheet and export it in three outputs - a Midi file, a PDF engraved sheet, and a MusicXML digital note sheet. 
It has never been easier to convert piano pieces to sheet music! 
WHAT THIS APP DOESN'T OFFER 
» Separation of multiple instruments: 
The note recognition can't separate multiple instruments from your voice. 
If you record multiple instruments playing simultaneously you will get bad transcription results! 
As the name says, Sing2Notes will only work with vocal recordings. 
» Live note recognition: 
This app is not able to show you live note recognition results. 
Instead, it will take some time to perform the frequency analysis and shows you the final sheet music. 
» 100% match percentage:
This app won't detect 100% of the played notes and there will also be wrong detections.
But depending on the quality of the input signal, it will give you more than useful sheet!
REQUIREMENTS
» Internet: active internet connection for server connectivity
» Microphone
SUMMARY
Transcribe music recordings from your microphone to sheet music.
With Sing2Notes you can create on-the-go recordings of your voice.
Those are uploaded to your personal songbook and transcribed to score.
Musical note recognition for piano has never been so easy!
CONTACT US
We're always happy to hear from you. No matter what comes to your mind, we want to hear it.
Would you like another feature? Does something not work as expected?
Send us an e-mail at: support@sing2notes.com
This app is actively developed and there are updates on a regular base

bluejetty:00025263:ios.description:
Save The Dog is a casual puzzle game. 
Your silly dog is curiously walking toward the hive. Before it's too late, let's save the dog! This is the addictive game for you! You can play this game to train your brain, moreover, save the dog is one of the most interesting draw games that help you to challenge your mind. Play now!
Your dog is being attacked by a sizable swarm of bees, and you can assist defend it by touching the screen and drawing a line of any shape. Not only can you save the dog, but also you can save other animals when changing many types of memes like panda, cat, frog... Share with your friends and play save the dog bee together!
Within 10 seconds of pulling your finger off the screen, if your dog has not perished in an accident or been stung by a bee, you will have completed the level and moved on to the next one.
How to play: 
- Swipe the screen to create a wall to protect the dog; 
- As long as you don't let go, you can always draw the line; 
- You can let go after producing a satisfactory pattern; 
- Wait for the bees in the hive to attack; 
- Hold your wall for 10 seconds, so that the dog will not be attacked by bees; 
- You will win the game. 
Game features:
- Enhance creativity and imagination
- Test your IQ easily
- Many challenge levels
- Interesting memes
- Challenge your ability on many levels
Complete levels and show how smart you are! Let's play and have some fun!

bluejetty:00019295:ios.description:
“As we’ve come to expect from Handelabra, the digital version is flawless.” - David Neumann, StatelyPlay.com
“One Deck Dungeon offers a wealth of strategic gameplay.” - Christian Valentin, AppSpy.com
“A surprisingly deep dungeon crawler with vital decisions to be made at every turn.” - PixelatedCardboard.com
===============================
Adventure calls... but you don't always have time to spend hours optimizing your character sheet or managing your inventory! One Deck Dungeon lets you jump right in to bashing down doors, rolling dice, and squashing baddies with style. Get a full roguelike game experience, boiled down to its essence, and captured in a single deck of cards and a handful of dice!
One Deck Dungeon is a dungeon crawling adventure game for one or two players. Each time you play, choose one or two of these 6 brave heroes:
• Mage - There's rarely a problem in the dungeon she can't solve with a spell.
• Warrior - Her favorite dungeon activity is squashing her opponents immediately.
• Rogue - Watch in awe as she dispatches monsters with style.
• Archer - Accurate, brilliant, catastrophically deadly.
• Paladin - She seeks out danger and shields her allies from deadly enemies.
• Mist - This breach mage has crossed over from the world of Aeon's End to help defend Mynerva. Learn more at AeonsEndDigital.com!
After every game, your heroes make progress toward unlocking up to 15 new talents, building up their power for future games.
There are 5 dangerous challenges to face:
• Dragon’s Cave - The thick-skinned wyvern who occupies this dungeon prefers her heroes on the crispy side.
• Yeti’s Cavern- If you can survive the freezing winds and biting cold, an abominable snowman awaits.
• Hydra’s Reef - Chop off one head, and another appears! This regenerating venomous monstrosity is a slippery foe.
• Lich’s Tomb - Hordes of undead foes, evil curses, and magical wards. What could possibly go wrong?
• Minotaur’s Maze - Abandon all hope, ye who enter here!
More content is available via In App Purchase:
The Forest of Shadows expansion doubles the content in the game. It features adventures in all-new lush yet deadly locales. A vast network of mossy underground tunnels and connected forest areas await your heroes! Play in 5 new dungeons with 5 new heroes, a new encounter deck, & more!
The Abyssal Depths expansion adds a new kind of threat: 6 different Fiends who hound you throughout your entire quest to reach the boss. Plus, 2 new aquatic heroes join the fight in the murky waters!
The all-new Relics of the Forge expansion more than doubles the content in the game. Choose from 12 powerful relics to take along in your quest, each with unique abilities and mechanics. Play in 5 new dungeons with 6 new heroes, a new encounter deck, & more!
Individual expansion cards:
• Caliana - This faerie has decided that dungeoneering looks fun! Don't let her get bored...
• Fanatic - A righteous Sentinel is here to smite evil wherever it may lurk!
• Witch - Her chaotic magic hammer is ready to smash glooping oozes into glooping puddles!
• Cinder Plains - The Hellhound awaits those reckless enough to venture here...
• Phoenix's Den - Only the bravest heroes can handle the heat!
Once you know your way around the dungeon, a game takes about 15 minutes. It might take a little longer if you're learning, or a lot shorter if you jump into a pit of spikes.
Warning: do not jump into a pit of spikes.
All cards in One Deck Dungeon have many colorful boxes. Roll your dice, and attempt to fill in as many boxes as possible. For every one you don't fill, you’ll suffer consequences in hearts and time! Once you complete an encounter you'll be able to learn a new skill, acquire a new item, or gain experience to level up your hero.
Welcome to the world of One Deck Dungeon. Adventure awaits!
One Deck Dungeon is an officially licensed product of “One Deck Dungeon” from Asmadi Games.
For more information on One Deck Dungeon, check out OneDeckDigital.com

bluejetty:00061193:ios.description:
Begin each day walking alongside Jesus.
Daily Word brings the timeless devotional writing of J.R. Miller (Come Ye Apart: Daily Readings in the Life of Christ) into a peaceful, focused reading experience. Each day follows the footsteps of Jesus through the Gospels, offering Scripture-grounded insight, practical encouragement, and quiet moments to center your heart on Christ.
A DAILY WALK WITH CHRIST
- Read the day’s Gospel-centered devotional reflection
- Meditate on accompanying Scripture passages and daily verses
- Follow the life, teachings, miracles, and love of Jesus throughout the year
- Use the calendar to revisit readings from any day of the year
LISTEN, REMEMBER, AND RETURN
- Listen to devotional readings with text-to-speech
- Add gentle background music for quiet meditation
- Set daily reminders at the times that best fit your routine
- Save meaningful readings and reflections in Favorites
- Turn uplifting verses and quotations into beautiful shareable images
MAKE THE EXPERIENCE YOUR OWN
- Choose from available Bible translations, including BSB, NET, and WEB
- Adjust fonts, text size, and appearance for comfortable reading
- Enjoy a distraction-free layout with full dark mode support
- Personalize your space with app-inspired theme colors like Scripture Gold, Parchment Amber, and Walnut Leather
- Arrange the Today view around the content and widgets you value most
Whether you start your morning in quiet prayer or need a mid-day pause in the Word, Daily Word offers a calm, dependable way to stay connected to Christ.
Take time each day to come apart and rest in His presence.
PRIVACY AND TERMS

bluejetty:00185650:ios.description:
Meet the highly anticipated iOS version of the *ORIGINAL* Death Worm game (a Top-50 indie game of all times according to indiegames.com).
Over 75,000,000 of downloads for Death Worm, 75 Million people addicted to Death Worm can't be wrong!
Control the mind-boggling underground monster with your finger!
What is he? An alien? An awakened prehistoric predator? Genetic monster? It is really not important for those unfortunate who have sunk into oblivion in his giant poisonous throat. Nothing personal - it's just the predator's lunch time.
NOWHERE TO HIDE: The Monster feeds in 4 different locations!
ENDLESS TERROR: Beat 60 challenging levels to complete the Campaign Mode!
NEVER GET BORED: Death Worm features 3 bonus Mini-Games!
EXPLOSIVE SURVIVAL: 3 different Survival Modes to keep feeding your hungry Monster as long as you can!
EVOLUTION: The Worm looks differently in every location that you unlock!
OMNIVOROUS: Animals, birds, businessmen, punks, lizards, and even dangerous predators like tiger are now nothing more than snacks for your monster Worm!
THE DESTROYER: blow up cars and tanks; bring down planes and helicopters and even the alien UFO’s! Fight enemies of over 40 types!
The Game supports HD and Retina displays and features smooth graphics and stunning visual effects! This is the game that perfectly suits if you need to quickly relieve stress or just have fun!

bluejetty:00042387:ios.name: Struct Club Fitness & Workouts
bluejetty:00042387:ios.summary: Struct Club = structure for fitness instructors who are inspired by music. Explore class templates or make your own. Run class to-the-beat. Share & exchange class designs with fellow instructors. Your workout, playlist, cues, and timer - al
bluejetty:00042387:ios.description:
Struct Club = structure for fitness instructors who are inspired by music. Explore class templates or make your own. Run class to-the-beat. Share & exchange class designs with fellow instructors. Your workout, playlist, cues, and timer - all in one. It's Canva x Google Maps for your classes. Supports Spotify & Apple Music (including MP3/local files). 
● Our Mission: To help you lead your pack ●
Run the most memorable beat-driven classes: Struct Club cues what to do, when, for the exact amount of time, synchronized with each song in your playlist, with a countdown timer (time & beats remaining) to keep you on-point. Now, you can focus on bringing your very best energy & coaching to your wolfpack – after all, that’s why your members keep coming back!
Craft Class: Struct Club integrates with Spotify (Premium) & Apple Music, allowing you to choreograph class by tagging your playlist with intervals, beat drops, tempo (with auto-BPM recognition), intensity, colors, and any cue notes - right on beat.
Exchange: With the Explore section, Team-Only library, and Share button for every class you create, get & give classes with friends and teammates. Use any class as a template for the next - all classes are duplicatable and editable! 
Scale Your Practice: The more you use Struct Club, the more elevated your future class creation process becomes. Create a class from songs that auto-categorize themselves based on how you've tagged them. Duplicate and edit prior Classes. Copy-Paste songs across classes while retaining all the tags you've added. Swap out old songs you'd like to replace with fresh ones, while keeping the cues. Abridge 60-minute classes to 45-minute ones. Plus - Struct Club learns your exercise planning patterns over time to suggest the next moves you’re likely to use. 
● Key Features ●
- Full catalogue of class templates (cycle, HIIT, sculpt, & tread)
- Song tagging with exercises, cues, intensity, and colors
- Tag cues to the beat-drop
- Auto-BPM readout (with Spotify) or custom Tempo display
- Cue prompter in-time with music with Cue-by-Cue, Full List, and Landscape view options
- Interval countdown timer 
- Crossfade (using Spotify settings)
- Share classes
- Team-Only libraries available
- Copy/Paste tracks across classes - complete with your cue tags
- Reorder class playlists anytime
- Add new tracks to existing classes
- Eligibility to be featured in Explore - and paid! 
Do you manage a team of instructors? Ignite their ability to coach to their full potential. Whether class programming is run by you or your instructors - or even a blend of the two - optimize your instructors’ efficiency and effectiveness to deliver the very best for your members, every time. Contact us at support@structclub.com to learn about what Struct Club offers for Teams.
● As seen on Forbes, CNBC, Apple Newsroom, and more! ●
Officially selected: Apple Entrepreneur Camp.
Officially featured: Today On The App Store.
● Testimonials ●
"For novice coaches and seasoned instructors alike, Struct Club takes your classes to the next level! With a beautiful, easy-to-use interface, frequent updates and a fabulous community, membership is a bargain at twice the price! If you or someone you know is seeking an alternative to being a lone wolf, join the Wolf Pack at Struct Club! You'll be glad you did!" - Sevana
“Super intuitive. Game changer.” - Emily 
“An awesome app! I’ve used it to plan profiles and easily find BPM for all my songs in one fell swoop." - Tina
● We’re overjoyed to welcome you to our Wolfpack, and invite you to engage with us ●
support@structclub.com 
Instagram: @structclub
Website: www.structclub.com
Twitter: @structclub
Facebook: www.facebook.com/structclub
P.S. Behind-the-scenes, we’re a team of fitness professionals ourselves who care about helping our community thrive, so please do reach out, share your story, and let us know how we can best support your practice. 
Terms of Service: https://www.structclub.com/tos

bluejetty:00029899:ios.description:
Clario Anti Spy
Anti-spy scan & checkup
Clario Anti Spy is a cybersecurity app created by leading experts in response to the growing public need to fight digital spying and stalking.
Our app can protect your calls, messages, contact list, photos, and videos from unauthorized access to give you total peace of mind when it comes to privacy and security.
► Now available in 8 languages — English, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, and Portuguese. The app auto-detects your device language and you can switch any time in Settings — every recommendation, checklist, and on-screen instruction is fully translated.
► Hidden App Scan: Discover which of your apps might potentially access your private information or even snoop on you. Clario AntiSpy lets you uncover apps disguised as parental control or device monitoring software to hide their actual purpose of keeping tabs on you and your data.
► Anti-theft Alarm: Prevent unauthorized access with a loud alarm that instantly activates if someone moves or tries to unlock your device. Perfect for keeping prying hands away.
► Device system check: Check if your built-in device protection is secure and receive our regular notifications when your attention is required.
► Anti-spy setup: Get step-by-step checklists guiding you through basic anti-spy protection on your device to decrease the chance of threats.
► Spy cam detector: See all devices connected to your Wi-Fi to spot any disguised cameras secretly recording you.
► Unlock catcher: Find out who and when unlocked your phone with photo evidence.
► Data breach monitor: Discover if any of your data is accessible to spies. Get notified if your passwords or other private info have been leaked.
► Human assistance: Contact our support team for help with your anti-spy questions.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/weareclario/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/clario.antispy/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/weareclario
Terms Of Use – https://clario.co/eula/
Privacy Policy – https://clario.co/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00082333:ios.description:
Welcome to "Bid Master", a game that combines the fun of auctions and bidding. You'll compete with other players in a game that's both easy and challenging.
As a savvy auctioneer, your mission is to find valuable items in abandoned warehouses and sell them to fulfill your dreams of wealth.
Warehouse Auctions
You'll participate in a series of thrilling warehouse auctions. Each warehouse is filled with unknown possibilities, and you'll need to use your intuition and strategy to determine which warehouse may contain treasures. Will you buy a seemingly ordinary warehouse, or will you boldly invest in a warehouse filled with potential? The choice is yours.
Compete 
You're not the only auctioneer. You'll be bidding against other players. Whether you're new to auctions or a seasoned pro, through the trials and tribulations of this game, you can easily become a winner.
Uncover Treasures
Every auction win, every time you uncover hidden treasures, brings you endless satisfaction and achievement. Whether it's valuable artwork, rare collectibles, or historical relics, they could all be hidden in these seemingly ordinary warehouses.
Path to Wealth
In the game, you can accumulate wealth and level up your auctioneer status to unlock more features and rewards. This game will take you from nothing to abundant wealth, feeling the joy and achievement of becoming rich.
Start Bidding Now
Now, prepare your bidding strategy and start your auction journey! In the world of "Bid Master", let's seek out hidden items and win wealth together!Download for free, PLAY Now!

bluejetty:00184235:ios.description:
See your future balance before you spend.
Foreseenly shows how upcoming income, bills and purchases may change your balance over time. Spot low points early and see whether changing a payment date or delaying a purchase could leave you in a better position.
Free to use. Optional in-app contributions only if it brings you value. No ads. No bank login.
PLAN BEFORE YOU COMMIT
• See your projected balance on future dates.
• Check how a purchase or extra debt payment affects the weeks and months ahead.
• Spot gaps between bills going out and income arriving.
• Change amounts or dates and see how your forecast changes.
A positive monthly total can hide a shortfall before payday. Foreseenly makes the timing visible.
BUILD YOUR FORECAST
1. Add your starting balance, expected income and expenses.
2. Set recurring transactions and one-time plans.
3. Explore your forecast and adjust as life changes.
Plan weeks, months or years ahead, up to 15 years. Use it for your own finances, household expenses or small business cash flow.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
You enter the financial information you want to plan with. No bank connection is required. Your financial data stays on your device and, if you enable sync, in your private iCloud account. We do not collect, store, or access your financial data.
Before you say yes, check the forecast.
▶ Terms and Usage
For best results, keep variable budget items up to date. Foreseenly™ CashFlow is not financial, investment, or legal advice. All forecasts and projections are illustrative only and may not reflect real-world outcomes. Use of this app is at your own risk. By using this app, you agree to Apple's Standard Terms of Use (EULA).

Dig bones hidden underground, solve problems using tools and build the dinosaur skeleton, take the dinosaurs out for an adventure and overcome dang
bluejetty:00177566:ios.description:
Johnny & Mitch - educational adventure in Jurassic World where kids can be true explorers.
Dig bones hidden underground, solve problems using tools and build the dinosaur skeleton, take the dinosaurs out for an adventure and overcome danger, and learn about shapes. Improve their memory skills with some fun memory games and unique themes.  
Visual perception
Concentration
Hand-eye coordination
Logical thinking
The game intended to expose the kids to the Jurassic world of the dinosaurs using exploring, adventures, and puzzles to solve.
Three unique learning mini-games. each game splits into three themes :
1. Digging & Assembling: 
Dig and assemble all the bones to recreate a dinosaur.
Theme 1: Desert   
Dinosaur: Raptor
Theme 2: Jungle  
Dinosaur: Triceratops
Theme 3: Snow
Dinosaur: Pterosaur
2. Shapes Adventure:
Help to clear the blocked path so the Dinosaur could cross to the other side safely.
Lava mountain
Geyser path
River streams
3. Memory game: 
Jungle - Explorer tools, Land dinosaurs & Winged dinosaurs.
Underground - Bugs, Dinosaur Skeletons & Eggs.  
Underwater- Fossils, Plants & Sea dinosaurs.
Features:
Meet 6 different dinosaurs.
Fun and interactive dinosaur mini-games to enjoy.
Delightful, kid-friendly sound effects.
Recommended for children ages 2-5.
No third-party advertising.

bluejetty:00063879:ios.description:
PickCrafter is an incremental idle crafting clicker game that lets you take control of a pickaxe and dig deep into the biomes. Even while idle or offline! Just start tapping to mine. Upgrade Legendary Pickaxes, collect all the blocks and gear, and unlock all the Biomes. Digging for gold has never been more exciting! Tap to start, then upgrade your Artifacts and Abilities to mine deeper, faster.
Download now and start mining for gold in one of the most addicting incremental idle crafting clicker games! How far can you dig?
PickCrafter FEATURES
Idle Clicker Gameplay
* Tap: Swing your pickaxe and Mine all the 3D blocks!
* Swing: Break blocks this way too!
* Mine: Earn PPS and craft blocks!
Incremental Upgrades
* Hopper collects blocks while idle or offline!
* Use Abilities and Artifacts to boost your Strength
* Mythical Blocks and Machines help you!
Upgrade Your Pickaxe
* Craft and upgrade your Pickaxes
* Defeat bosses, craft their special items and earn Trophies!
* Prestige to reach new heights
Idle Mining
* Earn resources even when you're not playing
* Daily Rewards - enjoy cool bonuses from the Daily Reward system
* Over 90 achievements to unlock
* Battle with your friends and rank up on the leaderboards
* No internet connection necessary
* No need for mods, launcher, or PE
PickCrafter is the perfect incremental clicker idle game for fans of endless fun. Tap the day away digging for gold, diamonds, amethyst, and more! Find companions, and craft items to boost your PPS - get digging today!
Download now to unleash your inner miner in PickCrafter!
Join your PickCrafter friends on Discord, Facebook & Twitter
https://discord.gg/pickcrafter
https://twitter.com/pickcraftergame
Need help? Visit our support page https://fiveamp.com/pickcrafter/support
Note: PickCrafter is free to play tap game and all items can be obtained through standard gameplay, however the option to purchase content using real money exists.
PickCrafter offers a paid Elite membership on top of other great gameplay features. Elite members have access to a unique Pickaxe, Runic awarded daily, exclusive store bonuses, and much more. Elite Membership - Monthly is priced at $9.99 /month and lasts for 31 days. Elite Membership - Annual is priced at $99.99 /year and lasts for 365 days. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of the purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off in at least 24-hours before the end of the current payment period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://fiveamp.com/policy
Terms of Use: https://fiveamp.com/terms

bluejetty:00135160:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Shape the fate of the Grishaverse. Travel war-torn Ravka and choose which powers prevail in this interactive adventure based on the fantasy series.
You determine the choices of the iconic heroes of "Shadow and Bone" in this interactive RPG featuring original adventures based on the Netflix series and bestselling books. Explore the world as Alina, Jesper, Sturmhond and General Kirigan as you discover previously untold stories set between Seasons 1 and 2 of the hit Netflix show. Encounter familiar faces, new villains, hard choices and dramatic twists in this narrative RPG that puts the player in charge as the story unfolds. 
Features:
• Play four new fantasy adventures as the iconic heroes of "Shadow and Bone," Alina, Sturmhond and Jesper, as well as the villain General Kirigan.
• Explore new and familiar locations in the Grishaverse: cross the dangerous Shadow Fold that isolates East Ravka, sail the seas in Sturmhond’s ship and visit Ketterdam with the Crows.
• Embark on quests to save captured Grisha, free old friends, topple corrupt officials or, in Jesper’s case, just steal a bunch of cool stuff.
• Choose how each character responds in conversations that shape the fate of the story.
• Level up your heroes’ Charm, Strength, Intelligence and Perception to unlock more story choices and ways to interact with the world.
• Play minigames to survive ambushes, sneak into strongholds, escape pursuers and cast Grisha spells to advance the story. 
- Created by Chimera Entertainment.

Fitmeter Bike turns your iPhone/iPad into a bicycle computer with incredible functionality. Try it once and it’ll remain the only biking app on your iPhone for years to come! 
Whether you are an amateur that is just starting, or a pro preparing for a competition, Fitmeter Bike is the advanced tracker you need to track and upgrade your cycling.

- GPS based position and route of the session will be displayed on a map including distance markers.
- Current speed
- Distance
- Duration of the session
- Pause time
- Auto Pause detection
- Average speed
- Top speed
- Altitude tracking. Uphill / Downhill
- Burned calories
- Split times

- Import / Export all activities from / to iCloud or a CSV file
- Statistics. Speed and Altitude over distance
- Records. See your all-time records and a summary over all sessions.
- Facebook support. Post sessions to your Facebook timeline.
- Apple health support: Active Energy, Cycling Distance, Weight, Workouts
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Dutch, Hungarian
Now go, get this cycling tracker app and turn your iPhone into a bicycle computer!
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00121453:ios.name: Hungry Shark Evolution
bluejetty:00121453:ios.summary:
Become the ultimate predator in this offline shark game where you’ll rule the ocean and eat your way through an underwater world of adventure
Take control of a mighty, hungry shark and survive as long as possible by eating everything in s
bluejetty:00121453:ios.description:
Become the ultimate predator in this offline shark game where you’ll rule the ocean and eat your way through an underwater world of adventure
Take control of a mighty, hungry shark and survive as long as possible by eating everything in sight! In this thrilling, classic arcade-style shark game, evolve your predator into a fierce sea beast, from Great Whites to the ferocious Megalodon, and explore the ocean’s depths filled with fish, animals, and other creatures.
Unleash Your Predator Potential!
It’s eat or be eaten in this shark evolution simulator where your mission is simple: evolve and survive. Start as a small fish and work your way up the ocean’s food chain, evolving your shark through multiple levels until you dominate the underwater world! Hunt, eat, and attack whales, fish, birds, and more. This offline game lets you explore without Wi-Fi while keeping the action going.
Equip Powerful Gear and Accessories!
Boost your shark with awesome accessories like jetpacks, lasers, and even fancy hats! Equip your shark to swim faster, bite harder, and survive longer as you navigate the open world.
Meet Your Baby Shark Companion!
Need help exploring the open world? Recruit baby sharks to join you in the hunt! Each baby shark offers unique abilities to assist you on your journey. Evolve your sea animal and watch your baby shark’s powers grow with you as you dive deeper into the shark evolution game.
Survival of the Hungriest!
The ocean is full of surprises and challenges. As a shark in this offline game, it’s your job to keep eating and evolving. Be wary of dangers lurking in the deep, but know that each meal makes you stronger. Take a bite of everything and discover the thrill of survival in a classic retro shark game!
Game Features:
  •  Play as one of many different sharks and animals, including iconic predators like the Great White, Hammerhead, and Megalodon.
  •  Dive into an open world of fish, animals, and prey, hunting for your next meal as you evolve in size and strength.
  •  Collect and evolve over a dozen unique fish, sharks, and baby sharks, each bringing a new layer of strategy to your journey.
  •  Equip powerful accessories like jetpacks, lasers, and top hats to customize your shark and make it the ultimate predator.
  •  Activate Gold Rush to extend survival and score big points in this arcade-style shark game.
  •  Intuitive controls let you tilt or tap your way to becoming a legendary sea predator.
Additional Information:
This game contains in-app purchases for Gems and Coins to enhance gameplay. You can also earn Gems and Coins in-game or by watching ads. This game remains fully playable offline!
Join Our Community!
  •  Facebook: HungryShark
  •  X (Twitter): @Hungry_Shark
  •  YouTube: @HungrySharkGames
  •  Instagram: @hungryshark
Feedback & Support:
If you need help or have feedback, visit our support page: Ubisoft Support

Take Control of Your Health with Health Care!
Your health matters and we make it simple to track and understand it.

- Log & View: Easily record blood pressure (BP), blood sugar (glucose), and heart rate.

- Secure data storage—your health data stays safe.
Take charge of your health today!
Download now and start record your vital signs effortlessly.

bluejetty:00164249:ios.name: Cats & Dogs Weather
bluejetty:00164249:ios.summary:
FEATURED in App Store's "App of the Day", "4 New Apps We Love" and "Apps & Games We Love This Month!"
Cats & Dogs creates a unique pawsome experience, mixing routine weather checking with virtual pets in the most enjoyable way that barks j
bluejetty:00164249:ios.description:
FEATURED in App Store's "App of the Day", "4 New Apps We Love" and "Apps & Games We Love This Month!"
Cats & Dogs creates a unique pawsome experience, mixing routine weather checking with virtual pets in the most enjoyable way that barks joy! 
At the outset, users choose their favourite furry companion — a playful pup or a cute kitty — select your local weather, as powered by Dark Sky, and then the fun begins.
You don't just get the precise and accurate weather forecast information, it’s also now your job to take care of your cuddly pet by dressing them up in the silliest, cutest and trendiest outfits…but you can’t dress them in any old frock!
Cats & Dogs rewards you by dressing your virtual pet in the right clothes for the weather in your neighbourhood. So, if it’s pouring down with rain, you might fancy wearing a pirate hat, some fun fishy flippers or perhaps a nostalgic Victorian swimsuit — the more correct items worn, the happier your pet becomes and the more rewards you reap!
From tuxedos to dragon suits, you're sure to enjoy creating countless clothing combinations!
Not only is Cats & Dogs loads of fun, but it’s also beautifully designed and super simple to use — with animated weather backgrounds and fun graphics— even if you don’t dress your pet, it’s still the best-looking weather app around…..and it's FREE to download!
Weather Features:
• GET accurate, real-time weather forecast whenever and wherever you are in the world.
• SEE weather forecasts for the next hours, days and week.
• GO BEYOND with in-depth weather data such as sunrise/sunset times, UV index, wind, chance of rain, moon phases and many more! 
• EXPERIENCE sunny, rainy, windy, stormy, foggy and snowy days with delightfully animated weather!
Virtual Pet Features:
• TAKE CARE of your cuddly virtual pet — choose from a Cat or a Dog!
• GIVE your pet a name!
• COLLECT, unlock, mix & match 1000's of clothing combinations!
• HAVE FUN matching outfits with the weather to get treats! 
• FEED your pets their favourite snacks! Bone-Appetit!
• ENJOY dressing your pet up in the silliest, cutest or trendiest ways possible!
• UNLOCK levels for exclusive items!
• EARN rewards by completing challenges!
• COLOUR your app, your way!
• CHOOSE from different scenic backgrounds!
• SHARE your favourite ensembles with your friends and send them gifts! Get social!
And there's so much more coming! We packed as much content and TLC into this game as possible and we'll continue to add new features, content and challenges in regular updates. 
PLEASE NOTE:
Cats & Dogs is FREE to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money/currency. 
This app requires iOS 11 or above and a stable internet connection for live weather updates, third-party advertising and in-app purchases.

• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)

• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of The New 96.1 app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within The New 96.1 app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00139649:ios.summary:
Recurrence helps you manage and track everything relating to the repeating tasks in your life so you never miss a thing again.
Recurrence is more than just another app that reminds you what needs to be done — it tracks what you did, too. A
bluejetty:00139649:ios.description:
Recurrence helps you manage and track everything relating to the repeating tasks in your life so you never miss a thing again.
Recurrence is more than just another app that reminds you what needs to be done — it tracks what you did, too. An example: you have a pet that needs medication. Maybe it needs checkups at the vet, too. Recurrence can remind you when you need to do give it the medication it needs as well as to arrange a visit to the vet, all while tracking things from past ones — what it weighed during the last visit, which medication was prescribed, and anything else you think might be handy!
By changing the way you think about reminders and repeating tasks, Recurrence becomes more than an app that reminds you to do things — it becomes the place that tracks your entire life as well.
Recurrence features include:
◆ Task tracking and customizable repeats
Create tasks that repeat when you need them to with customizable options including a lock that prevents a task from being checked off before it's ready.
◆ Task sharing
iCloud sharing support so you can complete items with a spouse, friend, or family members.
◆ Task organization
Categorize your tasks so you'll always be able to find what you're looking for. Or just search, it's up to you!
◆ Task customization
Tasks can be configured to show all kinds of information including the number of occurrences, the last completion, notes, and more.
◆ Siri Shortcut support
Mark tasks as completed using nothing but your voice.
◆ Full task history and notes
You'll see when tasks were completed as well as notes from each completion, great for tasks that you want to keep a track of over time.
◆ Full widget support
Now you can see your recurring tasks right on your Home Screen or Lock Screen.
◆ Cross-device support
Your tasks follow you from iPhone to iPad to Mac and back again with seamless syncing.
Recurrence is a free download with a five-task limit. Unlock unlimited tasks with Recurrence Premium — available as a monthly or annual subscription, or lifetime purchase. Premium subscriptions can be canceled at any time, but will renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the next payment is due. 
For more information, see our privacy policy & terms of use: https://www.shayesapps.com/policies

bluejetty:00152703:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of hidden objects, where every picture hides a story. Can you spot them all?
Sharpen your eyes & calm your mind in this FREE yet addictive hidden object puzzle game. Slow down, zoom in, and find every hidden object across beautiful scenes!

Explore cozy cafes, mysterious attics, and dreamy landscapes filled with cleverly hidden items. Whether you're a casual puzzler or an expert finder, this relaxing game will challenge your brain while soothing your soul. Ready to search, find, and rise up the leaderboard? Let the hidden object hunt begin!
How to Play Our Hidden Object Games:
- Examine each picture carefully.
- Tap to collect the correct hidden object.
- Zoom in & out to reveal tricky spots.
- Use hints when you get stuck.

- Exquisite Hidden Object Scenes
From whimsical gardens to dusty libraries, each level is full of detail, charm, and hidden objects waiting to be found. No animations - just gorgeous still art for maximum focus and clarity. With new updates and added challenges, your object-finding adventure never ends!
- Global Leaderboard Challenge
Feeling competitive? Complete puzzles fast and accurately to rank among the world's top seekers! Every object you find brings you one step closer to the top.

No rush, no stress - just calm exploration. Enjoy a peaceful search experience accompanied by soothing background music that helps you relax and stay focused after a long day.

- Fun for All Ages
Whether you're 8 or 80, you'll enjoy the peaceful challenge of seeking out cleverly placed objects. Great for family play or solo relaxation.
If you love hidden picture games, visual puzzles, or just the satisfaction of finding something that's almost invisible, this is the game for you. Download Hidden Puzzle now and start your calming hidden object journey today.

listings.description:
Descartes MacroPoint™ for Truckers is the most trusted and secure app used by drivers. Enjoy automated communication of arrival, departure, and in-transit location data to your customers in real time. Descartes MacroPoint™ for Truckers is free to use. Automatic location updating keeps the app hands-free. Ensure a safe and uninterrupted driving experience with MacroPoint for Truckers. 

Benefits & Features 

• Automatically sends in-transit location data 
• Reduce check calls & increase on-road performance 
• Receive real-time notification of load assignments 
• Instant tracking connectivity to all your customers 
• Improve customer satisfaction 

Descartes MacroPoint™ for Truckers enables location sharing and other communication with your trusted partners during active load assignments only and always over a secure connection. 

To read more about our terms and privacy policy, please visit: www.MacroPoint.com/privacy-policy/

**Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. However, MacroPoint for Truckers doesn't run the GPS services in the background continuously. The app uses GPS only when the device moves significantly (i.e. 100 meters).

bluejetty:00027271:ios.description:
HIGHER – Where global K-POP fandoms come together
A vote for your favorite artist, stages you want to rewatch, and moments you want to cherish forever. HIGHER is a global fandom platform where K-POP fans around the world support artists through voting and video watching, collect special moments with TIMEPIECE, and build milestone records together.
◆ Your vote becomes the light that shines on your artist!
From SBS Inkigayo official voting to various artist support votes, express your love for your bias with your vote.
- Real-time voting to determine the 1st place winner of SBS Inkigayo
- Hot Stage voting to select the best performance on SBS Inkigayo
- Ending Fairy voting to make your bias look even cooler and more beautiful on SBS Inkigayo
When fans' choices gather together, artists and their stages become more special.
◆ Turn moments into eternity, collect shining moments forever with TIMEPIECE!
From the excitement of comeback stages to the emotion of winning 1st place. Discover TIMEPIECE, HIGHER's premium photocard containing special moments of artists.
- Collect TIMEPIECE capturing special moments from music shows
- Collect limited edition photocards with voice, NFC, and extra special features
- Digital TIMEPIECE in your hand, physical printing service for TIMEPIECE
- Record the artist's journey through Timeroad, archiving your TIMEPIECE
As your collection of TIMEPIECE grows, the memories shared between bias and fans become even richer.
◆ Celebrate 1st place made together, spread the word worldwide!
Fandom support gathers to become special gifts for artists. Depending on voting rewards, celebration videos of artists can be featured across domestic and international advertising media.
- Participate in various support votes to challenge for your artist's 1st place
- Broadcast artist videos via domestic and global offline ad media
- Global support projects completed together with fans worldwide
Your support makes your bias shine, and this light gathers to reach across the globe!
◆ Enjoy videos and add your support!
Enjoy videos of your favorite artists, and join their journey toward new records.
- Participate in Circle Chart Social Chart calculations by watching videos
- Support artists together with fans around the world
You can repay artists with support for various videos prepared for fans.
◆ Events and rewards that add joy to fan activities!
From opportunities to meet artists up close to rewards for voting and cheering, discover various benefits on HIGHER.
- Apply for ticket giveaways for MBC Show! Music Core and SBS Inkigayo
- Participate in various giveaways such as signed polaroids and signed CDs
- Earn free rewards by watching ads and participating in mission offerwalls
※ Please check in-app announcements for voting rewards, event schedules, and participation terms.
◆ ONE GLOBAL FANDOM
Support originating from different places comes together as one on HIGHER.
From a single vote for your favorite artist to stage moments to cherish forever, join fans worldwide. The shining journey of artists created together, HIGHER.
[Terms&Policies]
- Terms of Service: https://higher.fan/en/terms-of-service
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Privacy Policy: https://higher.fan/en/privacy-policy
[App Access Permissions Guide]
HIGHER optionally uses the following access permissions. You can use the service even if you do not agree to the optional permissions.
- Photos and Media (Optional): Setting profile photos and downloading voting certificates
- Camera (Optional): Taking profile photos
- Notifications (Optional): In-app updates on voting, TIMEPIECE, events, and other content
- Location (Optional): Participating in Higher Pop (location-based TIMEPIECE)
- Ad Tracking (Optional): Verifying completion and ensuring reward payout when participating in reward ads
* Access permissions can be changed anytime in device settings.

bluejetty:00155112:ios.description:
Dollar Bill Scanner: CashScan is the ultimate tool for currency enthusiasts and collectors worldwide. Using advanced AI-driven technology, CashScan allows you to effortlessly identify and catalog banknotes and bills from across the globe within seconds.
Simply snap a picture of your currency or upload an image from your phone's gallery. CashScan will automatically match the image with its comprehensive global database, providing you with accurate and detailed information. Each identification result offers a comprehensive overview of the banknote, including its denomination, series, country of origin, year of issue, and other valuable historical details.
With CashScan, you can conveniently record and store your international currency collection directly within the app, ensuring you never lose track of your valuable items. The app saves your scan history, making it easy to manage and track your diverse currency collection. Dive deep into the fascinating world of global currency and discover intricate details about bills and banknotes from around the world.
Key Features of Dollar Bill Scanner: CashScan
Instantly identify bills and banknotes from around the world
Comprehensive database covering multiple currencies
Detailed information about bill series and historical context
Real-time Market Value Analysis
Track rare and unique banknotes from different countries
Save and manage your global currency identification history
User-friendly interface for collectors and currency enthusiasts
Dollar Bill Scanner: CashScan is perfect for numismatists, collectors, and anyone interested in the rich history of global currency. Download CashScan now and unlock a world of currency knowledge!
Terms of Use: https://www.collabandconquer.com/refuge/tos
Privacy Policy: https://www.collabandconquer.com/refuge/privacy-policy
For any inquiries or assistance, feel free to contact us at banknoteidentifierapp@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00150554:ios.name: Cryo - Cold Shower
bluejetty:00150554:ios.summary: Discover the amazing health benefits of cold showers. Science shows that regular cold exposure improves mental clarity, builds grit, and helps you get healthier. To get the most benefits, make cold showers an integral part of your daily rou
bluejetty:00150554:ios.description:
Discover the amazing health benefits of cold showers. Science shows that regular cold exposure improves mental clarity, builds grit, and helps you get healthier. To get the most benefits, make cold showers an integral part of your daily routine. Cryo helps beginners and veterans alike by making cold showers a habit with a progress-based routine.
***Features***
- A personal 60-day plan that grows your cold time 15 seconds at a time
- Voice-assisted warm-up and cold shower timers
- Hands-free voice commands: say "ready", "pause", "resume" or "restart"
- A breathing guide to keep you calm in the cold
- Streaks, session history and a progress chart
- Log how each session felt, the water temperature and a note
- Daily reminders at your shower time
- Story-ready cards to share your streak
- Wellness quotes after every session
Known benefits of cold showers
• Reduced stress levels. Cold showers put a manageable amount of stress on your body and trains your nervous system to become resilient safely.
• Improved sexual health. Prolonged exposure to cold water is shown to naturally boost testosterone production in men, boosting libido and enhancing overall strength and energy in the bedroom.
• Increased willpower. Cold showers condition your mind in becoming comfortable with being uncomfortable.
• Weight loss. Cold showers naturally increase your metabolic rate and are an effective method in helping you get lean and lose body fat.
• Stronger immune system. Cold showers increase the number of white blood cells in your body. White blood cells are critical in protecting your body against diseases.
• Faster muscle recovery. Research found that cold immersion can help enhance recovery and reduce feelings of fatigue for athletes. Cold showers help you train harder and reach your fitness goals faster.
If you have any feedback, please contact us via email (cryoappsupport@gmail.com) or twitter @getcryo - we will get back to you immediately!
Cryo Pro
Cryo Pro unlocks the full app, with weekly and yearly plans. The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://getcryo.app/privacypolicy/

bluejetty:00070185:ios.description:
The popular Japanese fishing game Ace Angler is now a mobile fishing game! Let’s go on a fishing adventure and earn coins!
“Ace Angler: Fishing Spirits M” is a fishing game where you earn coins by catching fish/sharks!
Snag the big fish/sharks and rake in tons of coins!
Catch a wide variety of fish/sharks from massive sea creatures to ones never seen before!
■Fishing Game Content
In this fishing game, use coins to select a fishing rod, then catch fish/sharks with it to earn more coins. Fishing rods that make it easier to catch big fish/sharks cost more coins to use.
Fish fall into different classes. The higher the fish's class, the more coins you'll earn for catching it.
The trick is to select the right fishing rod for the fish’s class you're trying to catch.
The fishing controls are simple, so everyone from beginners in fishing to ace anglers can fish to their hearts' content!
■Fishing Stages
Use the coins you've earned to purchase fishing stages at the shop.
Test your fishing skills in a total of six stages, including Coral Reef, Deep Sea Ruins, Sunken Ship, and Deep Sea.
Plus, there are special fishing stages where you may get the chance to win lots of extra coins by catching fish, sharks and other kinds.
■Fish
The fishing game features not only fish/sharks but also over 100 kinds of sea creatures, including clownfish and great white shark.
Fish you catch will be registered in the Fish Encyclopedia, so catch fish,sharks and other kinds and complete your fish encyclopedia.
Fishing game "Ace Angler: Fishing Spirits M" is recommended for people who:
Usually enjoy fishing games/shark games and coin games.
Want to enjoy fishing games easily on their smartphone.
Like fishing but can't visit fishing spots.
Want to enjoy fishing/shark games or coin games during their commute or spare time.
Have played other fishing games or coin games before.
Love marine life such as fish and shark.
