bluejetty:00187828:ios.summary:
Exploring a new city, commuting to work, or just need a quick ride across town? Rent a classic or electric bike with Donkey Republic and join over 2 million riders across Europe on the most flexible bike sharing service around.
WHY RENT A
bluejetty:00187828:ios.description:
Exploring a new city, commuting to work, or just need a quick ride across town? Rent a classic or electric bike with Donkey Republic and join over 2 million riders across Europe on the most flexible bike sharing service around.
WHY RENT A BIKE WITH DONKEY REPUBLIC?
- Free unlocks on every ride
- Choose between classic bikes or e-bikes to match your ride
- Rent up to 8 bikes at once for you and your friends
- Lock and unlock your bike as many times as you like, without ending your rental
- Human support by chat or by phone if you need assistance
START RIDING IN MINUTES
- Create an account in the app
- Find a classic bike or e-bike at a pick-up location near you on the map
- Unlock the bike and enjoy your ride!
- Done riding? Bring the bike to a nearby drop-off location and follow the instructions in the app to end your rental
PRICING & PASSES
- Just Ride: pay as you go with no commitment. Get bonus ride credit when you top up your wallet.
- Passes: take as many rides as you want within a set period of time at a discounted price. Perfect for a weekend of cycling or a city break on two wheels.
- Memberships: included daily ride time or discounted rates, theft insurance, and access to bikes in all Donkey Republic cities. Say goodbye to bike maintenance costs!
RIDE IN 190+ CITIES ACROSS EUROPE
Copenhagen, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Antwerp, Ghent, Geneva and many more. Rent a bike in dozens of cities with one app and one account. Visiting somewhere new? Open the map, find a classic bike or e-bike nearby, unlock, and see the city like a local.
SUSTAINABLE CITY RIDES
Every bike ride means fewer cars and cleaner air. Cycling on a Donkey Republic shared bike is one of the lowest-carbon and most affordable ways to get around your city. Far cheaper than owning, leasing, or maintaining your own bicycle.
QUESTIONS?
Real people, not just a help page. Get instant answers to common questions in the app, chat with our support team, or call us if you'd rather talk to someone. Whatever's happened with your ride, we'll sort it out.
Ready to ride? Download the app, find a rental bike near you, and enjoy your city on two wheels.

bluejetty:00062704:ios.description:
Speak Spanish from day one. Follow a step-by-step beginner course, practice real conversations out loud, and get instant AI tips that show exactly which word to fix.
Spanish Learning for Beginners takes you from your first "¡Hola!" to real everyday conversations — one short lesson at a time.
A STEP-BY-STEP COURSE 
• 12 chapters and 83 lessons, from greetings to ordering food, directions and daily life
• Every lesson builds on the last: Pocket Phrases, Words to Know, How It Works (grammar made simple), then Listen and Let's Talk
• Checkpoints to put it all together, plus bonus lessons when you want more
PRACTICE REAL CONVERSATIONS
• Let's Talk: play your part in short everyday scenes — meeting a classmate, ordering at a café, asking for help
• Say your answer out loud and keep the conversation going
• Listen back to the whole scene with both voices
AI PRONUNCIATION COACH
• Get a score for every sentence and every word you say
• See which sound came out wrong and how to fix it — e.g. "came out as 'se', try 'te' like 'tay'"
• Track your speaking progress over time in My Speaking
WORDS THAT STICK
• Flashcards with native audio and pronunciation for every word
• Swipe "Got It" or "Review Again" — the words you miss come back until they stick
LISTEN TO NATIVE SPEAKERS
• Dozens of everyday dialogues recorded by native speakers, for beginner, intermediate and advanced learners
• Spanish and English side by side, with line-by-line playback
• Download conversations and keep listening offline
Whether you're traveling, studying or starting a new life in a Spanish-speaking country, learn the Spanish you'll actually use — and start speaking it today.
Start learning for free. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited speaking practice, offline mode, background listening and no ads.

bluejetty:00082869:ios.description:
PicsRoom - Your All-round AI Life Assistant
Open up a new dimension of smart life with PicsRoom - this application that integrates four core functions: artificial intelligence recognition, artificial intelligence photo aging, artificial intelligence chat and photo enhancement. Infuse your life with the warmth of technology and make every use a pleasant experience.
1. AI Visual Recognition: Make the World Tangible
Scan everything like an encyclopedia! Just snap a photo of plants, animals, products, currencies, or landmarks, and get precise encyclopedic information in milliseconds. Become a walking knowledge base effortlessly.
2. AI Fun Face Swap: Unleash Creative Social Boundaries
Leverage our powerful AI database to predict your past and future looks. With just one photo, generate your appearance across all age groups – perfect for playful social sharing or nostalgic journeys through time.
3. AI Chat: Your 24/7 Caring Companion
Whether you need answers to questions, seek advice , from scientific principles to daily tips, or simply want a listener, AI Chat responds instantly. Experience warm conversations that accompany you every moment.
PicsRoom is not a cold tool – it’s a smart partner that understands life, creativity, and you. From today onward, let AI be your eyes to explore the world, your brush to express yourself, and your close friend by your side.

bluejetty:00186745:ios.name: Dinosaur Plane Games for kids
bluejetty:00186745:ios.summary: Embark on an exhilarating adventure with Dinosaur Plane — a captivating kids' flight simulator that combines the thrill of flying with educational elements, perfect for young explorers! This app, tailored for children up to five years old,
bluejetty:00186745:ios.description:
Embark on an exhilarating adventure with Dinosaur Plane — a captivating kids' flight simulator that combines the thrill of flying with educational elements, perfect for young explorers! This app, tailored for children up to five years old, is a unique blend of fun and learning, offering one of the most engaging preschool airplane games in the market.
Enhanced Features of Dinosaur Plane:
• Kids Flight Simulators and Airport Adventures: Featuring 14 creatively designed planes, including playful ones like the eggplant-shaped and fishbone planes, Dinosaur Plane provides an exciting flight experience through various airports around the world.
• Children’s Airplane and Airport Adventures: Kids will soar past global landmarks like the Eiffel Tower and the Pyramids, turning each flight into a fun-filled learning adventure.
• Educational Aviation Games for Kids: Beyond just flying, Dinosaur Plane serves as an educational tool, teaching about different cultures, geography, and historical sites in an interactive manner.
• Toddler Airplane Activities: With easy-to-use controls, the game is designed to improve fine motor skills and cognitive abilities through engaging airplane activities.
• Unique Aircraft Games for Kids: Experience extraordinary moments like flying close to the ocean to see jumping fish or venturing into space to encounter dinosaur astronauts!
• Free-Flight Exploration in Kids Airport Simulators: Children have the freedom to fly anywhere in an open-world setting, promoting creativity and discovery.
• Immersive Scenery and Sound Effects: Stunning visuals and sound effects create an immersive experience, making players feel like they are truly exploring the world.
• Interactive Learning Journey: As children navigate through different airports and landmarks, they collect badges and take photos with their dinosaur friends, creating lasting memories.
• Safe and Focused Gameplay: With no third-party advertising, Dinosaur Plane offers a secure and uninterrupted environment for children to play and learn.
Dinosaur Plane is more than just a game; it's a journey into imagination and discovery. Whether it's piloting through the clouds, exploring famous sites, or making new dinosaur friends, the sky's the limit. So, let your child take control of the cockpit and start their global adventure today!
About Yateland:
Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting user privacy. To understand how we handle these matters, please read our complete privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00044968:ios.description:
Your story lives in The Eagle. From reporting on all of your favorite teams to the news that matters most in the community, we cover it all. Get in-depth stories from the region and beyond – including news, sports, opinion, obituaries, entertainment, and politics.
Easily access the very latest news in an app built for you. Read, see, and hear exclusive commentary, stunning photography, video updates, and binge-worthy podcasts. 
Plus, subscribers have the ability to upgrade to News+, our premium ad-free experience! That means faster-loading pages and an uninterrupted reading experience. 
Our app features:
* Your Stories – personalize your experience by selecting the local news topics that matter most to you
* Get notified – stay in the loop by selecting alerts for news, sports, weather, and more
* Easy navigation – see all the latest local stories by simply swiping up/down, and left/right.
* Read stories your way – either in the News Feed or via the E-edition
* Breaking news updates – top banners let you know what’s happening right now
* Follow author – get notifications whenever your favorite writers post a story
* Bookmark for later – save stories to enjoy at your leisure
* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access.
https://theeagle.com/terms

guidance. When you're done, log your tasting notes so you can dial in your perfect cup over time.

brew into precise pour steps, wait periods, and actions like swirling or pressing — so you never have to guess.

TASTING REMINDERS
Get a notification after brewing so you can log your tasting notes while the flavor is fresh.
SINGLE ORIGIN +
Unlock unlimited custom recipes, 500+ community recipes, brew history search, accent colors, and custom app icons with a one-time purchase.
Whether you're a home barista dialing in a new bag or a beginner following your first pour-over, Single Origin keeps you on track and helps
you brew consistently.

bluejetty:00034118:ios.description:
Revolutionize your fitness journey with Spren, the ultimate health app and fitness app:
• Advanced BMI-Calculator & Body Fat Calculator: Use your smartphone as a body scan tool for accurate body fat percentage and BMI measurements, results are comparable to DEXA scans.
• Comprehensive Health App Reports: As a sophisticated body tracker and body measurement tracker, Spren provides detailed insights including body fat percentage, BMI analysis, body composition breakdown
• Research-Based Fitness Tracker: Align your results with healthy ranges from extensive research, similar to DEXA scan standards.
• Weight Tracker & Weight Loss Tracker: Monitor your weight and track weight loss effectively, going beyond what traditional smart scales offer.
• Body Composition Analysis: Understand the nuances of body composition, not just BMI, using Spren as your personal fitness tracker and health app.
• Smart Scale Alternative: Experience the convenience of a smart scale combined with the detailed analysis of a professional-grade body fat calculator, scanner, and BMI calculator.
• Personalized Nutrition Planning: Set targeted goals and begin tracking toward them today with a data-backed nutrition plan created just for your needs.
Get a multi-page PDF report that includes:
• Body fat %
• Fat mass
• Lean mass
• A/G fat ratio
• Resting metabolic rate
Plus, see how your results compare to healthy and optimal ranges from published research.
The technology seems magical, but the science behind the imaging algorithm has been validated by several independent peer-reviewed studies, making research-grade body composition analysis accessible to anyone with a smartphone.
Spren is more convenient than comparable methods like DEXA and underwater weighing, and the results are more comprehensive and accurate than bathroom scales or other apps.
Focusing on weight loss alone may not be helping you achieve your deeper health goals. If you're losing lean mass versus body fat, you're not getting fitter.
With Spren you will:
• Avoid the confusion and frustration of false plateaus.
• Help understand if your nutrition, fitness, and recovery programs are working for you.
• Ensure that you're making progress toward your deeper health goals.
Discover the true progress of your fat loss, lean gains, metabolic health, and longevity with Spren's research-grade body composition analysis — go beyond the scale and take control of your health journey. bluejetty:00180681:ios.name: Mobile Passport Control
bluejetty:00180681:ios.summary: Mobile Passport Control (MPC) is an official application created by U.S. Customs and Border Protection that streamlines your CBP inspection process at select U.S. entry locations. Simply complete your travel information, answer CBP inspecti
bluejetty:00180681:ios.description:
Mobile Passport Control (MPC) is an official application created by U.S. Customs and Border Protection that streamlines your CBP inspection process at select U.S. entry locations. Simply complete your travel information, answer CBP inspection questions, capture a photo of yourself and of each member of your group, and follow the instructions provided on your receipt. 
Important Notes:
• MPC does not replace your passport; your passport will still be required for travel.
• MPC is only available at supported CBP entry locations.
• MPC is a voluntary program which can be used by U.S. Citizens, certain Canadian Citizen Visitors, Lawful Permanent Residents, and returning Visa Waiver Program applicants with an approved ESTA.
More information regarding eligibility and supported CBP entry locations can be found on our website: https://www.cbp.gov/travel/us-citizens/mobile-passport-control
MPC can be used in 6 simple steps:
1. Create a primary profile to save your travel documents and biographic information. You can add and save additional eligible people to the MPC app so that you can submit together from one device. Your information will be securely stored on your device to be used for future travel.
2. Select your CBP port of entry, terminal (if applicable), and add up to 11 additional members of your group to include in your submission.
3. Answer CBP inspection questions and certify the truthfulness and accuracy of your answers.
4. Upon arriving at your selected port of entry, tap the “Yes, Submit Now” button. You will be asked to capture a clear and unobstructed photo of yourself and of each other person that you included in your submission.
5. Once your submission is processed, CBP will send a virtual receipt back to your device. Follow the instructions on your receipt and be prepared to present your passport and other relevant travel documents.
6. The CBP Officer will complete the inspection. If further information is required, the CBP Officer will let you know. Please note: The CBP Officer may ask to capture an additional photo of you or your group members for verification.

bluejetty:00089318:ios.name: Monthly Calendar Moca
bluejetty:00089318:ios.summary:

■ Vertical scrolling
Monthly calendars are joined together vertically, which makes it
bluejetty:00089318:ios.description:
A calendar app built for the month view. Months flow continuously — scroll up and down as far as you like. Released in 2012 and still actively updated.
■ Vertical scrolling
Monthly calendars are joined together vertically, which makes it especially convenient when you want a quick look at what's coming up.
Even at the end of the month, you can browse next month and beyond without interruption.
Tap a date to see that day's events in a list at the bottom of the screen.
■ Made for month-view people
If you mostly use Google Calendar's custom "4 weeks" view, or you always keep the built-in Calendar app in Month view, this app is for you.
On the other hand, it may not suit you if you want to manage every event in fine detail. Rather than showing everything about each event, Moca prioritizes giving you an overview of the next several weeks at a glance.
■ Works with your iOS calendars
Moca reads your calendars and events from the accounts already added in Settings on your iPhone or iPad. Your Google and iCloud calendars work with Moca as-is, so there is no complicated setup inside the app.
You can add and edit events from Moca as well.
■ Minimal, essential customization
- Which calendars to show
- Holiday display
- First day of the week
- Font size, bold text, and how many events to show per day
- Event times in the month view
- Color themes (including custom colors)
- Dark mode (automatic / always light / always dark)
- App icon badge
- Rokuyō, the traditional Japanese six-day cycle
■ Other features
- Widgets: put your next event or today's date on the Home Screen or Lock Screen
- Event search: find your events by keyword
- Duplicate events: copy the same event to multiple selected dates at once
■ One small request
Moca is developed by one person, who uses it every day to check their own schedule. If anything feels awkward or doesn't work properly, the developer would like to fix it — so please get in touch with support directly. Reviews don't allow the developer to ask about your situation or to follow up with you individually.
Tap the gear button at the bottom right to open the settings screen, then choose "Send feedback and bug reports". You are also welcome to contact support at the email address below.
app+mc@aill.org
■ Frequently Asked Questions
Q. How do I remove the ads?
You can remove ads with an in-app purchase.
Tap the gear button at the bottom right to open the settings screen, then choose "Remove Ads" at the bottom of the Settings section.
If you have purchased before, try "Restore purchases" on the same screen.
Q. How do I change the color of an event?
Event text is shown in the color assigned to its calendar.
Under "Calendars" in the settings screen, add separate calendars for different purposes, then assign events to them so that they appear in different text colors.
Q. How do I show an event as a bar?
Events with "All-day" turned on are shown as a bar.
You can also turn on "Multi-day event always shows on band" under "Options" in the settings screen, and events that span multiple dates will be shown as a bar even if they are not all-day.

bluejetty:00029438:ios.name: Senior Word Game
bluejetty:00029438:ios.summary:
Senior Word is a beautiful word puzzle game with all the challenging yet entertaining word hunt features you love! Train & exercise your brain in a fun, relaxing way and stretch your critical thinking skills and IQ to a new level.
SPECIAL
bluejetty:00029438:ios.description:
Senior Word is a beautiful word puzzle game with all the challenging yet entertaining word hunt features you love! Train & exercise your brain in a fun, relaxing way and stretch your critical thinking skills and IQ to a new level.
SPECIAL FEATURES
* CHALLENGE YOUR MIND: These word find games are easy at first, but they get challenging fast. Is your mind ready to get pushed to the next level with word puzzles?
* INCREASING DIFFICULTY: Work your way up 4 levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Pro!
* NO WIFI REQUIRED: This offline word puzzle doesn’t require wifi, which means you can play with anyone anywhere!
* CREATED FOR ALL AGES: The perfect crossword game for kids, adults, and even your grandma!
* REDUCE STRESS: Word puzzles combined with breathtaking landscapes create a relaxing wordscapes search
* 100% FREE: Download and play this word search free!
HOW TO PLAY
* IT’S EASY: Search for words by swiping up, down, left, right, or diagonally in infinite word search games
* EXPLORE UNIQUE LEVELS: Choose from a variety of themes featuring new destinations from around the globe, in addition to classic categories from your favorite word search games
* DESTRESS: Unwind after a long day at work with calming, zen crosswords. Word Search Journey is an amazing mental getaway if you’re up for the challenge!
* EXPAND YOUR VOCABULARY: With each level, your vocabulary will level up and prepare you for the next exotic word puzzle!
We promise you’ll leave each game feeling accomplished, smarter, and more at peace! Senior Word is satisfying, challenging, and the perfect new twist of a classic word search game and a world exploration you won’t want to put down!

bluejetty:00071803:ios.description:
Build a village and solve the problems with this free relaxing and fairytale merge & match games!
Help solve the hard level merge to rebuild the village. 
Play the cluttered area with boosters of various concepts and rebuild it! 
Discover the hidden areas.
The game features:
- Merge and create new items
Merge to create new decorations! Keep merging to create various decorations.
- Discover various things 
There are always various new things to explore such as the limited customized event and rewards, seasons and various items, hidden areas, and many more. Discover the hidden secrets in your mind and light up the world!
- Hidden items
Look for new items hidden behind boxes and cobwebs. Merge them together to find more decorations.
- Decorating
Clean up the bushes, fallen leaves, and boxes to rebuild, decorate and expand the village.
- Complete each section
Complete levels by getting hundreds of addictive merged items! 
For this, you need to play hundreds of merge games available. Some of them may be challenging, but if you're lucky you can earn rewards (boosters, reward boxes) throughout the game. They can help you overcome the fun but tricky merging explosion!
- Relieve stress
In addition of being fun and beautifully designed, our game is a great way to relax! Take a break from stressful activities and spend some healing time in the calming world of landscaping and zoning decoration. Reviving a ruined village will be satisfying.
Are you ready to decorate your village? Install now and play anytime and anywhere without any internet connection needed. 
Shall we go merge the items now?
We always do regular updates for more merges and attractive chapters to rebuild the village! Please keep an eye on the updates and leave a review!

bluejetty:00090595:ios.description:
Stop overthinking and let chance decide! Random Generator is your ultimate toolkit for fairness, whether you need a random number, a secure password, or a fair team draw for your next game. From board game nights to professional tournament seeding, this app ensures every result is 100% unbiased.
Key Features
 Random Number Generator: Generate up to 9 numbers at once within any custom range. Choose between unique results or allow repeats.
 Fair Team Maker: The smartest way to create random teams. Assign skill ratings to players to ensure balanced, competitive matches for football, basketball, or gaming.
 Spin the Wheel (Roulette): A fun, visual way to pick a winner. Perfect for "What should we eat?" or "Who goes first?"
 Name Picker & List Manager: Import your custom lists to pick a random name instantly. No more re-typing—save your player lists for future use.
 Digital Dice Roller: Toss up to 9 dice simultaneously. Perfect for Monopoly, Risk, or any tabletop RPG.
 Secure Password Generator: Create unhackable passwords with customizable criteria (uppercase, symbols, and length).
 Custom Experience: Toggle between Dark and Light modes and adjust result transition speeds to suit your pace.
Common Uses
 Sports & Gaming: Quick team draws for FIFA, football, or local tournaments.
 Board Games: Use as a digital dice replacement for any tabletop game.
 Decision Roulette: Simulate "Spin the Bottle" or create a lottery draw.
 Daily Choices: Pick a random meal, winner, or daily task.
 Global Support
We support 12+ languages, including English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Arabic, and Hindi, making it the most accessible randomizer app worldwide.

bluejetty:00156732:ios.name: Sling Fight 3D
bluejetty:00156732:ios.summary:
► Sling Fight 3D – Fun slinging action
Line up the sights of your slingshot and fling another jelly man into action in this fast and frantic casual catapult game where lovable jelly figures do battle to claim an awesome pile of electronics
bluejetty:00156732:ios.description:
► Sling Fight 3D – Fun slinging action
Line up the sights of your slingshot and fling another jelly man into action in this fast and frantic casual catapult game where lovable jelly figures do battle to claim an awesome pile of electronics and all sorts of other junk. What on earth do they need all those TVs and laptops for? Who cares? 
Just sling some more of them into battle, grab the gadgets, ward off the enemy jelly men, and enjoy their adorable jelly victory dances when you’ve captured the required amount of junk. A one-of-a-kind crazy casual game guaranteed to give you short sharp shots of adrenaline and wild fun. 
►IF IT AIN’T GOT THAT SLING…
• The game really couldn’t be simpler — aim your slingshot at an item on the board and catapult a jelly figure into action to capture it and carry it off to your base. The other side is after those items too, though, and their jelly men are ready to fight jelly tooth and jelly nail for them, so you’ll have to outpace them or outnumber them to ensure the spoils are yours.
• Or could it? — as you progress through the levels, new features appear in the game to spice up the slinging fun, from tricky obstacles that need to be destroyed before your guys can grab the goodies to jellygnite explosives that will blast every jelly man in the vicinity (including the carrier) to pieces, and even multipliers that will swell your jelly ranks right there on the field. Use your slingshot with care to overcome the obstacles, take advantage of boosters, and keep on carrying home the loot.
• Tremble like jelly! Boss levels are an extra challenge, with fierce and heavily armed jelly giants that will have your jelly men quaking in their jelly boots. Throw everything you’ve got at them, make sure to catch the boosters, and eventually even the mighty will succumb to your slingshot in these epic jelly battles.
• All slinging, all dancing — victory in Sling Fight leads to wild celebrations. It’s worth slinging in a few extra jelly men just to watch their unique and crazy victory dances and see their blank jelly faces come alive with a whole range of joyful emoticons. bluejetty:00071145:ios.name: Yandex Maps & Navigator
bluejetty:00071145:ios.summary: Search for an address or the best places nearby both online and offline. Yandex Maps provides information about organizations and helps you reach your destination by car, public transport, bike, or on foot based on current traffic condition
bluejetty:00071145:ios.description:
Search for an address or the best places nearby both online and offline. Yandex Maps provides information about organizations and helps you reach your destination by car, public transport, bike, or on foot based on current traffic conditions.
Search for and select locations:
• The largest organization database and filters to refine your search.
• Detailed information: contacts, hours of operation, services provided, photos, and reviews.
• Floor plans to find your way around Moscow's major shopping malls.
• Search for places and addresses without an internet connection (offline maps).
• View places saved on your smartphone, tablet, and PC.
Custom map settings:
• Real-time location of buses, trams, trolleybuses, and minibuses.
• Road maps that show current traffic conditions in the city.
• Parking layer with the location and cost of official parking.
• Street panoramas for a road-side view of any address.
• Choose from three map types: Roadmap, Satellite, and Hybrid.
Public transport, car, bike, and walking routes:
• Pedestrian navigation: paths between buildings, through parks, across squares, and other pedestrian zones.
• Bike navigation: road types, underpass and overpass preferences, and highway warnings.
• Public transport routes with timetables and estimated time of arrival.
• Optimal driving routes based on live traffic conditions and driving options.
• Step-by-step instructions with voice navigation.
• Speed camera, speed limit, and speeding notifications.
 • Real-time updates on traffic, road accidents, speed radar, and more.
Offline maps:
• Driving routes and voice navigation.
• Downloadable lightweight maps (minimum storage space, for example, the Moscow map is just 187 MB).
• Database of organizations with hours of operation, services provided, and more.
• Over 2000 cities in Russia, Armenia, Belarus, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Latvia, Turkey, Ukraine, and Estonia.
Information from users:
• Mark road events on the map and comment on user submissions.
• Regular updates to the Public Map keep you informed about your city.
• Write reviews, upload photos, and update information about organizations.
Yandex Maps has an Apple Watch app. Use it to:
• Navigate the map.
• View the nearest metro station and public transport stops.
• Find out when public transport will arrive at a nearby stop.
• Track traffic patterns a few hours ahead of time.
• View weather forecasts.
Terms of Use: apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula
Privacy Policy: yandex.com/legal/confidential

This word game's innovative gameplay offers a significant mental challenge and fun. Enjoy a modern word puzzle that combines word search, anagram games, and crossword puzzles! Immerse yourself in beautiful scenic backgrounds to relax and soothe your mood. In Peace Word Puzzle, you need to search and connect the correct letters, finding an average of 20 hidden words per level to test your vocabulary. bluejetty:00079173:ios.description:
Welcome to Greg, the zero-guesswork plant care app & community!
We make growing indoor plants super easy and fun.
Unsure of how much to water your plant babies? We got you! We'll identify your specific plant type, tell you exactly how much to water it, and remind you when it's time.
By downloading Greg, you also join a global community of other passionate plant parents ready to answer questions, nerd out on all things plants, and offer big-time garden inspo.
With Greg, it's all about connecting to plants - and each other - to stay reminded of just how interconnected we *all* are on this big, beautiful planet of ours.
So, whaddya say? Wanna grow together? Download Greg and let's get started!
-> FEATURES
Auto-Magical Plant Identification
- Scan any plant (for free!) and Greg’s PlantVision will identify the species, tell you all about it, measure the pot, and even the distance to the nearest window
Highly-personalized plant care
- Trust Greg to develop a custom watering plan based on each plant's species, size, plus the actual details of your home environment
Zero-guesswork watering & reminders
- Discover *exactly* how much each of your plants is thirsty for, and get a reminder when it's time to water 'em
Community troubleshooting
- Turn to more veteran growers for answers to any plant questions you have, and get an answer in minutes
Thriving global community
- Connect with others in #Communities built around shared interests & discover/interact with new plant pals in the app's Social Feed
More to come!
- We're always looking to grow, so stay tuned for new features as we have 'em…
-> USER REVIEWS
- "Definitely worth it for someone passionate about plants" - Tree2727
- "Greg is by far the best plant app I've used" - LolaCupcake586369954
- "10/10 have recommended to so many friends so far!" - FireySpirit711
- "This app is a literal life saver for my plants." - Lemonlaw625
- "I've killed every plant I've touched, so this is exactly what I needed!" - 21JazzCat
-> PRICING
For $29.99 a year (less than $0.08 a day) unlock:
Precision Watering
-Find out how much H2O each plant needs and never overwater again!
Smart Watering Reminders
-Receive a notification when each of your plants is ready for watering.
Indoor Light Gauge
-Ensure that all your plants are getting enough sunshine to survive.
Seasonal Updates
-Get plant care recs that adapt as the weather in your area changes.
Get started with a 7 day trial! We’ll be sure to ping you before the Trial ends in case you want to cancel.
Pricing outside of the US may vary, as actual charges will be converted to your local currency.
Please note that your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Subscriptions settings at least 24 hours before a new period starts.

bluejetty:00128221:ios.summary:

Stitch. lets you create beautiful embroidery patterns, by solving levels and Hoops of va
bluejetty:00128221:ios.description:
Stitch. is a casual puzzle game with embroidery on a numbered grid. The main objective is to fill in the levels' areas with no gaps to complete Hoops. 
Stitch. lets you create beautiful embroidery patterns, by solving levels and Hoops of various difficulties and sizes. It's easy to learn, but hard to master! 
Stitch up all the beautiful landscapes, plants, animals, objects, and more.
SIMPLE RULES, CHALLENGING SOLUTIONS
Stitch. offers an expansive range of playable content and thousands of easy to extremely challenging levels. Pick the pattern, size, and category of the Hoop you prefer and move forward through the levels to create an embroidered masterpiece. 
REALISTIC EMBROIDERY ENGINE
Like any other form of art, hand embroidery brings you a peaceful, calming, and inspiring experience.
Developed in-house, the realistic embroidery engine helps you enjoy the feel of playing with the real embroidery thread on your device. 
REGULAR HOOPS
Stitch. features over 800 regular Hoops in multiple sizes and categories. 
Up to a long embroidery adventure? Pick a beautiful landscape hoop in XXL size. 
Looking for something quick and fun to help you unwind? - Stitch up a cute teddy bear or a colorful plant!
 Every Hoop you complete can then be shared.
WEEKLY HOOPS
Weekly Hoops are limited edition content that becomes available to play every week.
Discover a new Weekly Hoop every 7 days and get it solved until it is gone!
Weekly Hoops' themes and patterns reflect famous international events and unlock fun, educational facts about each of them.
Did you know World Embroidery Day is celebrated on July 30?
FREE STITCH MODE
After completion, each Hoop can be alternatively played in Free Stitch mode. Pick your favorite pattern and color it just the way you like!
Free Stitch mode becomes available after the tutorial steps completion.
CHALLENGES
Follow and complete all the various and fun challenges to collect points, upgrade in tiers and obtain achievements.
ACCESSIBILITY
Stitch. offers a range of accessibility features that are imported from your iOS/iPadOS settings and can be managed through the main menu of the game:
1. The “Number Outlines” feature creates sharper and more contrasted outlines for the numbers on the grid to help color blindness or the visually impaired.
2. The “Reduce Motion” feature disables all sudden movements and animations.
3. The “Big Numbers” feature increases the size of the numbers of the grid for better visibility. 
UNIVERSAL & FAMILY FRIENDLY
Stitch. is a family-friendly game, suitable for players of all ages and genders.
(IGRS rating: 3+)

bluejetty:00186533:ios.description:
Welcome to Kidjo TV! 
With Kidjo TV, your kids will discover a world of adventures and learning! This edutainment app is every kid's dream come true. Packed with smart cartoons and engaging tutorials, Kidjo TV is perfect for preschoolers and elementary school kids, providing endless fun while giving parents a well-deserved break!
Kidjo TV ensures a safe and ad-free experience for young kids aged two to seven. With no public profiles, it's a worry-free zone for moms and dads, offering safe screen time, screen-time limits and customizable program settings to cater to each family's needs.
Kidjo TV is Coppa certified (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act), guaranteeing age-appropriate content that parents can trust. Its kid-friendly design empowers little ones to explore the app independently, sparking curiosity and excitement. Kids will be thrilled to explore the fun world of Kidjo on their own!
With over 3000 videos and educational content, kids will always find something new to watch, sing, or learn! From licensed cartoons to nursery rhymes, fun animal facts to life-skills songs and games, Kidjo TV has it all. Let kids immerse themselves in a world of creativity with magic tricks tutorials, origami, science experiments, yoga, and arts & crafts projects. All cartoons, tutorials, clips, and songs are carefully curated and approved by child development experts… and kids!
Kidjo TV offers a wide range of content suitable for all ages. While toddlers are delighted with nursery rhymes and baby songs, older kids meet lovable heroes like TroTro, Samsam, and Mighty Express. Moreover, they can immerse themselves in exciting adventures alongside Garfield, Masha and the Bear, Unicorn Academy and the Paw Patrol. So, which cartoon will capture your kid's heart?
Long car rides and waiting rooms become delightful with Kidjo TV's Backpack mode. Download and store clips for offline use on the go, making journeys even more enjoyable!
Let your kids experience the magic of Kidjo TV’s Live feature. With a single tap, they can dive into a seamless streaming experience and watch back-to-back videos of their favorite characters without any interruption!
Join the Kidjo TV adventure today and watch your kid’s imagination soar!
At Kidjo, we understand that each moment with your kids is unique. This is why we created 3 different experiences for them. Welcome to the world of Kidjo! For a stimulating visual experience, your kids can turn to Kidjo TV. But when it's time to unwind, dream, and prepare for bedtime, Kidjo Stories becomes their go-to companion with enchanting bedtime stories. And when they want to immerse themselves in a world of interactive challenges, they can enjoy Kidjo Games’ catalog of fun and educational games. There’s something to delight every kid at Kidjo! 
Kidjo is the best choice for parents who want their kids to have a safe and fun screen-time experience. Try the full range of Kidjo's fantastic features now! Subscription can be canceled anytime. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Our privacy policy can be found at: kidjo.tv/privacy and our terms of service can be found at: kidjo.tv/terms. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00040490:ios.name: Brew Meister: Track your beer
bluejetty:00040490:ios.summary:
BREW SMARTER. TRACK FERMENTATION. IMPROVE EVERY BATCH. 
Brew Meister makes it easy to measure, monitor, and manage your brewing process. Whether you're making beer, kombucha, or hard seltzer, track fermentation in real time, compare batches
bluejetty:00040490:ios.description:
BREW SMARTER. TRACK FERMENTATION. IMPROVE EVERY BATCH. 
Brew Meister makes it easy to measure, monitor, and manage your brewing process. Whether you're making beer, kombucha, or hard seltzer, track fermentation in real time, compare batches, and hit your target gravity — all in one app. 
Connect EasyDens, SmartRef, or pH2Go to capture precise measurements directly in the app. Brew Meister also supports wireless fermentation monitoring with Tilt Hydrometer, RAPT Pill, and iSpindel. 
No measuring device? You can also enter readings manually. 
TRACK FERMENTATION IN REAL TIME 
Stay on top of your fermentation from start to finish. 
- Monitor gravity and temperature with live fermentation curves 
- Track fermentation progress within individual batches 
- Get alerts for temperature changes and target gravity 
- Combine wireless and manual readings in one timeline 
RESULTS WITH CONTEXT 
Go beyond the measurement and understand what your results mean at each stage of the brewing process. 
- Tag measurements by brewing stage, such as Mashing, Final Gravity, or Bottling 
- See expected ranges based on your brewing stage 
- Get guidance that matches the task and your measurement 
- Receive next-step suggestions when readings move outside the expected range 
MEASURE SMARTER, CALCULATE LESS 
Spend less time calculating and more time brewing. 
- Automatic ABV and attenuation calculations from original and final gravity 
- Built-in temperature compensation and unit conversions 
- SmartRef wort and alcohol corrections 
- Beer color in SRM, Lovibond, and EBC 
- Specific gravity at your preferred reference: 20/20, 15/15, or 20/4 
- Quick, Continuous, and Precise measurement modes 
MANAGE RECIPES & COMPARE BATCHES 
Keep your brewing history organized and use previous results to improve consistency from batch to batch. 
- Create custom batches and organize measurements with notes and timestamps 
- Save recipes, batch notes, and measurement history 
- Tag measurements with predefined value types or create your own 
- Compare results across batches 
- Find previous measurements and batches with full-text search 
- Export your data as PDF or CSV 
YOUR BREWING, ALL IN ONE PLACE 
From individual measurements to complete fermentation histories, Brew Meister brings your brewing data together in one place. Measure with connected devices, monitor fermentation, understand your results, and compare batches to keep improving your brewing process. 
With a free Meister Cloud account, sync your measurements and batches across compatible devices, including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple Silicon Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and the web. Brew Meister is free to download, with optional subscription plans for advanced features 
Learn more: Smart Measuring Devices | Tony - A brand of Anton Paar 
SUPPORT 
Contact us at support@get-tony.com. 
PRIVACY POLICY 
https://www.get-tony.com/policies/privacy-policy 
TERMS OF USE 
https://www.get-tony.com/policies/legal-notice 
-------------- 
AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTION TERMS 
Brew Meister is free to download, with optional monthly and annual subscriptions for advanced features. 
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Payment and renewal pricing are displayed before purchase. 
Subscriptions and free trials can be managed or canceled in your Apple Account settings. If a free trial is offered, the subscription renews at the displayed price unless canceled before the trial ends.

bluejetty:00094742:ios.description:
Ever stared at a blank canvas, deadline looming? Those days are over.
With PPT AI, type a single prompt and watch as AI crafts a complete, visually striking deck tailored to your needs. Our advanced AI technology understands context, purpose, and audience to create professional-quality visual narratives that captivate and convince.
How It Works: Simply describe what you need: "Quarterly sales report with growth projections" or "Pitch for my sustainable fashion startup" – then let our AI handle the rest. Within moments, receive a beautifully designed deck with perfect layout, typography, and visual elements that enhance your message. (Subscription Required to Create and export PPT)
Perfect For:
• Business Professionals – Turn meeting notes into polished decks for clients and stakeholders in seconds. Make data-driven insights pop with automatically generated charts and graphs that tell your story at a glance.
• Educators – Create engaging teaching materials without spending hours on design. Focus on teaching, not formatting. Transform complex concepts into digestible visual narratives that students can easily understand and remember.
• Students – Transform research into compelling visuals that impress professors and classmates alike. Make your arguments stand out with professional-quality designs that look like they took hours, not seconds.
• Entrepreneurs – Generate investor-ready pitches that communicate your vision clearly and professionally. Hook potential investors with clean, modern designs that showcase your business potential without the need for expensive design services.
• Marketers – Develop campaign proposals and strategy showcases without design bottlenecks. Quickly iterate through multiple concepts and approaches to find the perfect visual storytelling for your brand.
• Remote Teams – Create consistent, branded materials across your organization regardless of design skill levels. Ensure every team member can produce high-quality visual content that maintains brand standards.
Key Features:
• One-Prompt Creation – Generate complete decks from a single description 
• Smart Content Organization – AI that understands how to structure your information logically 
• Beautiful Design Elements – Access to premium graphics, icons, and imagery 
• Brand Alignment – Maintain your visual identity across all materials 
• Export Options – Share your creations in multiple formats (Subscription Required to Create and export PPT)
• Intelligent Data Visualization – Automatic chart creation from your numbers
From boardroom to classroom, conference to sales floor – PPT AI delivers visual perfection on demand.
No design skills needed. No templates to wrestle with. Just beautiful decks that get your message across, every time. Save hours of work and eliminate the frustration of design tools with our intuitive, AI-powered solution.
Download now and reclaim your time while delivering communication perfection.

bluejetty:00148882:ios.description:
The SF Hunt – created by Handstand – is a 12-hour, 100 riddle scavenger hunt that marches you all over your beautiful city.
Using the mobile app, teams of 4-6 people solve riddles that lead them to unique locations around the city. bluejetty:00144612:ios.description:
Rucoy Online is a Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game where you can fight monsters with your friends in it’s real time open world.
Features:
√ Player vs Player (PvP)
√ Guild System
√ Play as a Knight, Archer or Mage
√ You can change your character class anytime
√ Use spells to deal more damage
√ Ally with other players and form a team to defeat strong monsters and get extra experience
√ Hunt dozens of different monsters
√ Find the best equipment
√ Increase your level and skills without limits
√ Ever growing open world
√ Chat with other players
√ Customize your character
How to play:
- To move touch where you want to go
- To attack simply select a target
- Use the buttons on the left side to restore health, mana or use a special ability
- Use the buttons on the right to change weapons
- To pick up loot from the ground just touch the hand icon
- Each level increases your health points, mana points, moving speed, attack and defense
PvP system:
- Attacking and/or killing innocent players will mark you as cursed
- Attacking and/or killing cursed players won't mark you as cursed
- There is a gold reward for killing cursed players
- Standing on a PvP zone will reduce the duration of your curse
Website: www.rucoyonline.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/rucoyonlineofficial
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/RucoyOnline/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/RucoyOnline

bluejetty:00077918:ios.description:
The #1 Fully Illustrated Bible App — Every Verse Brought to Life.
32,357 original illustrations. One for every verse in Scripture. Brilliant Bible is the only app that illustrates the complete KJV Bible—Genesis to Revelation—in stunning artwork.
Finally, a Bible that draws you in and makes daily reading feel less like discipline and more like discovery.
Most Bible apps give you text on a screen. Reading starts to feel like a task. You mean to open it daily, but days slip by. What if reading the Bible felt like being there?
WHAT READERS ARE SAYING
***** "It has really improved my ability to stay engaged when reading. I also notice I remember more and process the info better bc of the pictures. The artwork is gorgeous."
***** "I've been looking for a good Bible app that helps me to read the Bible everyday... Then I found this perfect app!"
***** "I needed this, thank you Lord."
WHY BRILLIANT BIBLE WORKS
* You'll actually want to open it – Visual beauty draws you back. Each verse paired with art invites you to contemplate and linger.
* You'll remember what you read – Images anchor Scripture in memory. Passages you've read dozens of times reveal new layers when you see them illustrated.
* You'll understand the story – Chapter summaries provide context so you never feel lost, even in the most complex books.
* You'll build the habit you've been wanting – Reading streaks celebrate your consistency and keep you coming back day after day.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED
* The Complete Illustrated Bible – All 66 books of the KJV, every verse brought to life in original oil painting style artwork. 32,357 illustrations in total.
* Chapter Summaries – Brief, clear context for every chapter so you always know where you are in the story.
* Bible Reading Plans – Structured paths through Scripture to guide your daily reading and keep you on track.
* Comic Adaptations – Key Bible stories reimagined in vivid graphic novel format—perfect for visual learners and family reading.
* Share Beautiful Verses – Send illustrated Scripture to friends and family with a tap.
* Family Sharing – One subscription covers up to 6 family members. Read together, even apart.
RATED 4.8 STARS
Join thousands of readers who've discovered a new way to experience God's Word. Brilliant Bible has earned a 4.8-star rating from 3,500+ reviews.
START YOUR FREE TRIAL
Try Brilliant Bible free and see the difference for yourself. Your subscription supports continued development and keeps the lights on for a small team passionate about making Scripture beautiful.

Tu opinión es importante

¿Cómo funciona?
1. Descarga la app.
2. Crea tu cuenta y completa la solicitud en solo unos minutos.
3. Elige el monto que deseas solicitar, según el límite aprobado.
4. Recibe tu dinero: Selecciona entre los métodos de desembolso disponibles el que mejor se adapte a ti.

Disponibilidad
Actualmente estamos operando en Puerto Rico, Florida y Utah.

¿Quieres saber cuándo estaremos disponibles en tu estado?
Síguenos en nuestras redes sociales para estar al tanto de todas nuestras novedades y actualizaciones.

Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/kiwicredito
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/kiwicredito
TikTok - https://www.instagram.com/kiwicredito

Seguridad ante todo
Tu seguridad es nuestra prioridad. Utilizamos encriptación SSL de 256 bits para proteger tu información. Nunca compartiremos tus datos con terceros ni almacenaremos tus credenciales bancarias.

Términos y políticas
Términos de uso - https://www.kiwicredito.com/terms-use
Política de privacidad - https://www.kiwicredito.com/privacy-policy
Licencias estatales - https://www.kiwicredito.com/state-licenses

Soporte
¿Tienes preguntas o necesitas ayuda? Contáctanos en support@kiwicredito.com y te responderemos lo antes posible.

Tu opinión es importante
Si estás disfrutando de la app, déjanos una reseña. Tu retroalimentación nos ayuda a seguir mejorando y a ofrecerte un mejor servicio.

bluejetty:00093223:ios.summary:
EDA AI — Your Nutrition Tracking Tool
EDA AI helps you monitor your diet and see daily calorie and macro targets. You can analyze the estimated calorie content and nutritional composition of your meals and keep a food diary.
Key features:
bluejetty:00093223:ios.description:
EDA AI — Your Nutrition Tracking Tool
EDA AI helps you monitor your diet and see daily calorie and macro targets. You can analyze the estimated calorie content and nutritional composition of your meals and keep a food diary.
Key features:
1) Meal Analysis via Photo
Take a picture of your meal and the app will estimate its calories and macros (protein, fat, carbohydrates). You can edit the data anytime to better match your dish.
2) Personal Targets
Before using EDA AI, the app uses:
- Gender
- Age
- Weight
- Physical activity level
- Your goal (weight loss, weight gain, or maintenance)
Based on this data, the app estimates your daily calorie and nutrient targets.
3) Customization and Flexibility
Update your details and adjust goals at any time.
4) Meal Archive and Calendar
- Meal history is stored in an archive.
- A calendar helps you track what and when you’ve eaten over the month.
5) Multilingual Support
Available in Russian and English.
6) Modern Design
A clean and intuitive interface makes the app simple to use.
Sources and methodology for calculations are available in the app.
Important: This app is for informational purposes only and does not provide medical advice.

VIOSSI is the official app for the VIOSSI menswear label — suits, tuxedos, blazers, shoes and accessories, built for the moments that ask you to look sharp.
SHOP THE FULL COLLECTION
Browse every suit, tuxedo, blazer, shoe and accessory in
bluejetty:00156694:ios.description:
VIOSSI is the official app for the VIOSSI menswear label — suits, tuxedos, blazers, shoes and accessories, built for the moments that ask you to look sharp.
SHOP THE FULL COLLECTION
Browse every suit, tuxedo, blazer, shoe and accessory in the range. Filter by size, color, style and model, and sort the way you actually shop. New arrivals and best sellers are marked so you can see what just landed. Saw a look you like? Search by photo: take a picture or pick one from your library and see similar pieces from the range.
FIND YOUR SIZE WITHOUT GUESSING
Enter your chest, shoulder and waist measurements once and the app recommends a size on suits, blazers, vests and pants, checking your jacket size against your pants size on two- and three-piece suits. Save your measurements to your account and they travel with your order, so our team knows what you need.
SEE IT PROPERLY BEFORE YOU BUY
Full-screen photography, real customer reviews and ratings, and clear stock levels on every size — including a heads-up when only a few are left. Tap Notify Me on a sold-out size and we will tell you the moment it is back.
A CHECKOUT THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Apple Pay and every payment method the store accepts, handled by Shopify's secure checkout. Add shipping protection or free returns at checkout if you want them. Promo codes apply in the bag, so you see the real total before you pay.
AFTER YOU ORDER
Track your parcel from the app and see your full order history. Need a return or exchange? Our team arranges it by email. Save your favorites to a wishlist that follows your account across devices.
VIOSSI ships across the United States and Canada. Questions about fit, delivery or an order? Reach us at info@viossi.com.

bluejetty:00038920:ios.name: Public Reading of Scripture
bluejetty:00038920:ios.developer: The Grace and Mercy Foundation, Inc.
bluejetty:00038920:ios.summary:
Transform Your Bible Study Experience
The Public Reading of Scripture (PRS) app is here to help make you successful in reading and listening to the Bible. It only takes 98 hours to listen to the whole Bible in English. With PRS, you can co
bluejetty:00038920:ios.description:
Transform Your Bible Study Experience
The Public Reading of Scripture (PRS) app is here to help make you successful in reading and listening to the Bible. It only takes 98 hours to listen to the whole Bible in English. With PRS, you can connect with a community devoted to the powerful practice of listening to the Bible in a way that is biblical, sustainable, and enjoyable.
Key Features:
Dramatized Audio Bibles
Experience the Scriptures like never before with our dramatized audio Bibles. Professionally narrated with high-quality sound effects and background music, these audio renditions bring biblical stories to life. Whether you're listening alone or with a group, the dramatized versions offer a deeply enriching and memorable experience.
Group Reading Plans
Our group reading plans are crafted to encourage collective spiritual growth. Join or create groups to read and reflect on Scripture together. The app provides structured plans that guide you through coordinated daily readings, fostering a sense of community and shared purpose. These plans are perfect for church groups, study circles, or family devotionals with lengths of 20 minutes, 30 minutes, 45 minutes and 60 minutes per session.
Bible Tracker
Stay on track with your spiritual goals using our intuitive Bible Tracker. This feature helps you monitor your progress through different books and chapters of the Bible. It provides visual insights and reminders to keep you motivated and committed to your reading schedule. Whether you're aiming for a yearly Bible completion or a focused study on specific texts, the Bible Tracker is an indispensable tool for your spiritual journey.
Our Mission:
Deepen Your Understanding: The dramatized audio Bibles and guided reading plans provide a richer, more engaging way to comprehend the Scriptures.
Foster Community: Connect with others through group reading plans, enhancing your spiritual growth as part of a supportive community.
Track Your Progress: The Bible Tracker ensures you stay committed to your reading goals, offering a structured path to find discipline in reading God's Word.

bluejetty:00179307:ios.description:
You can play Bingo Game as a host or a player.
◆How to play◆
*Multi Play*
- As a HOST
1. Tap "Start as a HOST" button.
2. Make a group for Bingo Game.(Enter ID)
3. Tell the ID to players(such as your friends) before starting the game.
4. When starting the game, tap "Start as a HOST" button again and enjoy Bingo Game!
- As a PLAYER
1. Tap "Start as a PLAYER" button.
2. Enter the ID which HOST has told you.
3. If the ID matches, you can join the group for Bingo Game.
4. Your iPhone can be used as a bingo card now, and you can enjoy Bingo Game!
*Single Play*
You can enjoy Bingo Game with single mode!
◆This game is for◆
◎ Those who want to enjoy party game
◎ Those who want to play Bingo Game with friends/family
◎ Youtubers who want to play Bingo Game with their funs online simultaneously(real time)
◆Why this game is innovative◆
More than 100,000 people can access at the same time.
◆Why I made this app◆
There are so many Bingo Game Apps in App Store, but many of them are just the ones which let us play with the players randomly matched.
I thought that it would be much more fun if we could play Bingo Game with our friends or popular Youtubers.
Let's have a fun with this game!

bluejetty:00147232:ios.description:
Track your calories effortlessly with the Smart AI Calorie Tracker and Intermittent Fasting App designed to help you lose weight, follow your favorite diet, and stay healthy! Whether you're doing OMAD, Keto, Carnivore, Vegan, or your own Cal Diet – this app adapts to your lifestyle!
 Why Track Your Calories: Cal AI App?
Cal Diet App is a smart way to track your calories and master your water and nutrition goals! With a built-in intermittent fasting tracker, customizable eating windows, and personalized insights, you’ll stay in control of every meal, every fast, and every calorie!
 No more guesswork – Just real progress
With Cal AI, you can track your calories with confidence using a massive U.S. based food database that allows for fast and accurate logging. The app provides smart calorie breakdowns for your meals, snacks, and drinks, along with visual charts to help you clearly see your intake and monitor your weight loss progress over time. Plus, Cal AI offers personalized, AI-powered suggestions based on your unique goals and habits. Whether you’re just beginning your health journey or fine-tuning your current plan, tracking calories has never been easier!
 Diet-Friendly for Every Lifestyle: Choose your goal, follow your preferred Cal Diet or pick from popular options!
- OMAD: Track your single daily meal with smart fasting integration
- Keto: Log carbs, fats, and protein with keto macro targets
- Carnivore: Track meat-based meals with no fluff
- Vegan: Plant-based tracking with nutrient insights
- Custom: Create your own diet and let Cal AI Tracker adapt to you!
Track Cal AI App features a powerful intermittent fasting tracker that helps you stay on schedule and committed to your goals. Whether you follow the popular 16:8 method — fasting for 16 hours with an 8-hour eating window — or prefer more advanced routines like 18:6, 20:4, or OMAD (One Meal A Day), Cal AI makes it easy to stay consistent. You can also create custom fasting plans tailored to your lifestyle, complete with reminders and progress tracking. With Cal AI, fasting becomes flexible and simple!
You’ll love Cal AI because it’s an all-in-one solution that combines a powerful calorie tracker with a built-in fasting timer. The app is easy to use, with fast and intuitive food logging that saves you time. It offers real-time AI feedback and calorie insights to help you make smarter choices throughout your day. Whether your goal is to lose weight, maintain your current progress, or build healthier habits, Cal AI adapts to your needs. Plus, it’s designed specifically for users in the U.S., featuring localized food entries and familiar measurements for a seamless experience!
Lose Weight! Stay Healthy! Keep It Simple!
Start now – Track your calories, follow your Cal Diet, and reach your goals with Cal AI! Download today and take control of your body!
Fast & Fit PRO:
You can subscribe to have an ad-free experience and to get access to all the fun filters, filters updates, and all amazing features within Fast & Fit
Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed monthly, annually, or every 3 months at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be Sanaged, and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00070614:ios.description:
Address: Kuwait, Sharq, Al Shuhada Street, NBK Tower
Fees: No fees for account opening 
Awards: Awarded for the “the Best Information Security and Fraud Management” in Global Finance’s World’s Best Digital Bank Awards (2024). World’s Best Digital Banks 2024: Round 1 | Global Finance Magazine https://gfmag.com/award/award-winners/worlds-best-digital-banks-2024-round-1/
We're changing the banking game. Weyay is Kuwait's first digital bank. We empower you – our country's next generation – to take control of your money and unleash your potential. All from your mobile phone. Here's how…
BUILT ON TRUST
Weyay is the brainchild of the National Bank of Kuwait. Powered by the financial expertise of our parent company, you know your money is in safe hands.
FUSS-FREE, FULLY-DIGITAL SIGN UP
Open an account from your mobile phone in minutes. No more paperwork, no more waiting in lines. We've made it safe and easy – just take a quick selfie and scan your Civil ID, and you're in.
THE LATEST TECH KEEPS YOUR ACCOUNT SAFE
We use super-smart, super-secure technology to keep your account safe and make banking easy. Face ID lets you log in quickly, and OTP codes help verify your identity.
YOUR OWN CUSTOM CARD
Customize your Weyay card to suit your taste. Choose from green or blue and make it yours. We'll deliver it directly to you, but you don't have to wait – you can access your card details anytime from the app.
IT'S EASY TO GET YOUR ALLOWANCE
Transfer your allowance to your Weyay account in a few taps, and get a special treat when your first payment lands. Then unlock more rewards every month.
TOP UP YOUR ACCOUNT, FAST
Use any Kuwait-based debit card to quickly add money to your Weyay account, or just top it up with a bank transfer.
REWARDS YOU'LL LOVE
The exclusive rewards start the moment you join. The more you use Weyay, the more you get. Try features to unlock cool stuff, or get money off the brands you love.
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR MONEY
Stay in control of your money and check transactions as they happen, from the app.
If anything does not look right, you can raise it immediately with a few taps.
24/7 SUPPORT
Life doesn't stop. That's why we are available round-the-clock to help when you need it. Chat with us on WhatsApp, or call our Solutions Center anytime.
THERE'S MORE TO COME…
EASILY SPLIT THE BILL WITH FRIENDS
No more confusion over who owes what. We'll do all the math for you. Send requests to those who need to pay up, and make it easy to pay your share.
HIT YOUR GOALS WITH SAVING POTS
We'll help you save like a pro. Create pots and set personal goals – it's super quick and simple to top them up and the app will do the rest. We'll give you nudges to keep you motivated and on track, and celebrate with you when you hit them.
PAY BILLS FROM YOUR PHONE
Keep on top of those bills – pay for your mobile phone or any other bills with a few taps in the app.
TRANSFER MONEY TO FRIENDS IN A TAP 
We've made sending money to friends (and getting money from them) easy and fun. No bank details needed – just sync your contacts. Add a note, image or voice note and make it personal.
WANT TO JOIN US?
Get the Weyay app, open your account today and start creating your future.

bluejetty:00089040:ios.description:
Draw, race and win! Pass obstacles and don't break your car before finishing race!
Unleash your creativity and build your own wild ride! Draw your vehicle by connecting dots using limited ink, then race against opponents through crazy obstacle tracks. Use your imagination to design a car that can survive the bumps, jumps, and wild physics of the race. But beware — one wrong move, and your car might fall apart!
Game Features:
Draw your own custom cars
Race on physics-based tracks filled with challenges
Outsmart opponents and finish first
Limited ink means smarter drawing = better results
Your car breaks based on speed and design—stay in control!
Unlock new levels and wacky shape challenges
Can your design handle the chaos? Each race is a test of your engineering and drawing skills. Build smarter, race faster, and don’t fall apart before the finish line!
Get ready for the ultimate draw race game where your imagination fuels your speed! In this car drawing game, you sketch your own vehicle with limited ink and then enter a thrilling physics racing challenge. It's not just about speed—it's about how well your creation survives the track.
Design your car in this ink racing game, then draw and drive through wild terrains packed with traps, ramps, and surprises. It’s a fun obstacle game that puts your design and driving skills to the test. Each level is a new racing challenge—will your wheels stay on, or will it all fall apart in a spectacular physics car crash?
Build smarter, race faster, and become the ultimate car builder in this crazy racing game. Whether you're into sketch race chaos or crafting the perfect draw car 3D machine, this is the game for you. Perfect for fans of draw runner chaos and car break simulator action!

bluejetty:00120524:ios.description:
RapL is a workforce enablement platform that bridges knowledge gaps, improves performance, and empowers every employee with what they must know to succeed. Through AI-assisted content creation and personalization, real-time field intelligence, and actionable insights, RapL transforms how organizations train, inform, and perform. It empowers every employee with the right information, at the right time, to perform confidently and consistently. 
Designed for enterprise and distributed teams, RapL combines AI-driven learning, field intelligence, and actionable insights to improve readiness, reduce errors, and drive business performance.
How RapL Helps Your Organization:
1. Build consistent knowledge and performance across your workforce, partners, and associates.
2. Provide managers with visibility of knowledge gaps and team readiness.
3. Reduce errors, compliance issues, and operational delays through continuous reinforcement of critical knowledge and real workplace scenarios.
4. Ensure the right information reaches the right people through personalized updates and automated alerts.
Key Features: 
- GenAI Based Rapid Content Creation: Generate micro-lessons, documents, and quizzes instantly in multiple languages with built-in genAI tools.
- Personalized Enablement: Tailored microlearning and reinforcement of critical topics and scenarios for every role and team across the hierarchy.
- Field Intelligence and Analytics: Easily collect and report field data with real-time analytics and automated alerts.
- Gamified Learning Experience: Points with leaderboards, badges, and rewards encourage continuous learning and improvement, driving high employee engagement and retention.
- Knowledge Map: Track progress by topic, team, or individual while continuously identifying and closing knowledge gaps.
- Enterprise-Grade Scalability and Security: Enterprise B2B SaaS application for global deployment across teams and industries.
Who Uses RapL:
Trusted across industries including Retail, FMCG, Automotive, Facility Management, Hospitality, Healthcare, Tech, Finance, Transportation and Logistics, and Manufacturing.
Drive Workforce Readiness and Performance:
Deploy RapL across your organization or specific teams to enable consistent performance, faster execution, and informed decision-making powered by AI.
Learn more at https://getrapl.com

bluejetty:00131663:ios.summary:
---

I sincerely appreciate you taking the time to check out the app.

bluejetty:00131663:ios.description:
---
What's up? This is Jon, the creator of TACNAV-X, an offline tactical navigation platform built for austere and contested environments.
I sincerely appreciate you taking the time to check out the app.
TACNAV-X is dedicated to the 24 Soldiers killed in action during our deployment to Afghanistan in 2010, and to the men and women who continue to serve today.
I'm still here, I'm still listening, and I'm still building.
God bless you,
Jon
---
KEY FEATURES:
• Offline mapping capabilities (full app usage with no emission of a cellular signal)
• Purpose-built for the individual Soldier
• WGS-84 standard (MGRS, UTM, BNG, and USNG coordinates)
• A military-quality precision targeting platform
• Tactical drawing mode (useful for mission planning, building overlays, targeting, etc.)
• Waypoint plotting functionality with military graphics (per FM 1-02.2)
• Compass “FastLock” function for capturing quick and precise azimuths
• ‘Go to Grid’ feature for precision planning and targeting
• Snap and save photographs onto the main map to increase situational awareness
• Location, waypoint, and photo-sharing capabilities (via email and text)
• One-button night mode function for low-light situations
• Apple Watch support included for free
BACKGROUND:
Built from the ground up in the rugged mountains of eastern Afghanistan, Tactical NAV (also known as TACNAV-X) was developed by a U.S. Army Field Artillery officer with the vision of crafting a low-cost and highly accurate mobile navigation platform tailored for the U.S. military.
Tactical NAV’s journey began in the Pech and Korengal Valleys of Kunar Province, Afghanistan.
U.S. Army Capt. Jonathan J. Springer, a Field Artilleryman serving as a Fire Support Officer with the 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault), began developing this tactical navigation platform immediately after the memorial services for Spc. Blair D. Thompson and Spc. Jared C. Plunk, who were killed in action on June 25, 2010.
Despite initial rejections by the Department of Defense, Captain Springer remained steadfast in his mission to continue developing TACNAV-X, even to this day. 
He used his life savings to fund and develop TACNAV-X, all with the ultimate hope of saving military lives and helping his fellow service members accomplish their missions at home and abroad.
Tactical NAV officially launched on the App Store on February 14, 2011.
BUILT FOR ACCURACY:
TACNAV-X was extensively field-tested during military operations in Afghanistan and later at Fort Bragg, including comparative testing alongside the AN/PSN-13 Defense Advanced GPS Receiver (DAGR) and other military navigation systems.
MISSION:
Empower military service members with a highly accurate and powerful mobile navigation platform.
VISION:
Assist and support our nation’s service members with their mobile navigational needs and enable them to operate and win in both training and combat environments.
BOTTOM LINE:
Tactical NAV has undergone extensive real-world evaluation alongside Nett Warrior, ATAK, BFT, the DAGR, and other military targeting and navigation systems. During comparative testing, TACNAV-X demonstrated accuracy within 1 meter of a DAGR.
IAPs & SUBSCRIPTIONS:
Currently, offline mapping mode is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time purchase. Drawing mode, previously an in-app purchase, is now included free for all users.
All revenue generated from these features contributes to further development and updates, and a portion of the proceeds are donated to charities that specifically benefit disabled veterans.
IMPORTANT NOTES:
The Department of Defense does not endorse Tactical NAV or TACNAV-X. The app should not replace a government-issued device during life-threatening or combat operations.
SUPPORT:
If you have any questions about the app, please contact Jonathan Springer directly at jon@tacnavx.com.

bluejetty:00179092:ios.name: Cleanpath - Quit Lust & Urges
bluejetty:00179092:ios.summary:
Cleanpath: Block Distractions, Build Better Habits

Cleanpath helps you create more distance
bluejetty:00179092:ios.description:
Cleanpath: Block Distractions, Build Better Habits
Trying to change a habit can feel manageable until an urge hits, you’re bored, stressed, or one tap away from falling back into the same routine.
Cleanpath helps you create more distance between you and the distractions you want to avoid. Block apps and websites, limit adult content, understand your triggers, track your progress, and build a routine you can stick with one day at a time.
Whether you want to step away from adult content, reduce distracting habits, or build more self-control, Cleanpath brings everything together in one place.
Features
• App Blocker - Restrict distracting apps that tend to pull you away from your goals.
• Web & Content Blocker - Block selected websites, custom URLs, and keywords in Safari, with built-in adult content blocking.
• Streaks & Gems - Track your streak, see your progress, and earn gems as you stay consistent.
• Panic Mode - Get quick access to support when an urge feels strong and you need a moment to pause and redirect your attention.
• 90-Day Recovery Plan - Follow a structured, day-by-day plan and focus on one step at a time.
• Path Quiz - Reflect on your triggers, habits, and usage patterns to better understand what tends to pull you off track.
• Recovery Activities - Choose from meditation, daily affirmations, workouts, walks, runs, and journaling when you want to redirect your time and attention.
• Recovery Analytics - Look back at your streaks, check-ins, and recorded activity to see your progress and patterns over time.
• Daily Check-In - Log how you’re feeling each day and review your entries over time.
• AI Support - Use AI support when you want to reflect, organize your thoughts, or get general motivational guidance.
Built for everyday progress
Cleanpath combines app blocking, website blocking, self-control, habit tracking, daily reflection, and recovery-focused features in one place.
Some days you may need the blocker. Other days it might be Panic Mode, a workout, journaling, your streak, or simply checking in with yourself.
Use the parts of Cleanpath that make sense for you and build your routine around your own goals.
Cleanpath gives you a simple place to block distractions, understand your patterns, stay aware of your progress, and keep moving forward at your own pace.
Important: Cleanpath is intended for personal development and habit support. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or professional therapy. AI responses are intended for general informational and motivational purposes only. If you have concerns about your physical or mental health, addiction, or compulsive behavior, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.
Privacy Policy: https://maximaapps.com/cleanpath/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://maximaapps.com/cleanpath/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00159129:ios.description:
Fluxvid turns your photos into short videos. Add a picture, choose a camera move like drone chase, whip pan or slow motion, and get a clip that looks like it was filmed on a real set. For pictures that don't need to move, there are photo looks such as fisheye, top-down and close-up.
You can also start with words. Write what should happen in the video, add a photo if you want to keep a certain look, and pick vertical, wide or square. Or put yourself into any picture or short clip: choose the person who should be you and add a clear photo of yourself. Please use only your own photos, or photos of friends who are okay with it.
Most videos are ready in one to three minutes, and you get a notification when yours is done. Everything is kept in your Library, where you can save it to Photos or share it. Videos and photos use credits. Fluxvid PRO comes weekly or yearly and adds credits every period, and extra credit packs are available any time. If something fails, no credits are used.
Payment is taken from your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. PRO renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the current period ends. The renewal is charged in the last 24 hours of the period. You can manage or cancel PRO in your Apple Account settings. Credit packs are one-time purchases.
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/termsofusefluxvid
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacy-policy-fluxvid
