bluejetty:00021444:ios.summary:
When you go fishing, it is very important to know how to recognize the optimal weather conditions so that our fishing is fruitful.
Temperature, atmospheric pressure, moon phases and wind are all factors that should not be underestimated.
W
bluejetty:00021444:ios.description:
When you go fishing, it is very important to know how to recognize the optimal weather conditions so that our fishing is fruitful.
Temperature, atmospheric pressure, moon phases and wind are all factors that should not be underestimated.
Wherever you are this app gives you the local atmospheric pressure indicating the condition of the fishing trip.
Make sure you have turned on your device's location services and that you are connected to the Internet. At this point the app will detect your geographical position. The display will show the location name, current air pressure, fishing trip status and weather conditions.
You have the option to choose the barometer inside your device (if present) or to use the weather service to detect the atmospheric pressure.
[ Main features ]
- Real-time atmospheric pressure measurement
- Condition of the fishing trip: excellent, good, poor
- Main needle (current pressure) and reference needle (previous pressure)
- Support for the device's internal barometer
- Ability to select the device's internal barometer or weather station barometer
- Supported units of measurement in mBar, inHg, mmHg, hPa, kPa, torr
- Ability to track the latest barometric pressure reading
- Location detection
- Weather conditions detection
- Search City
- Save favorite places (unlimited)
- General information on reading and interpreting data
[ Barometer type ]
You can choose to use your device's internal barometer or the barometer with data from the weather station closest to you
[ Unit of measure ]
You can easily choose to see the atmospheric pressure measured in mBar, inHg, mmHg, hPa, kPa, torr
[ Support ]
If you like the App, leave a review on the App Store.
For suggestions contact us at info@lionsapp.com, or visit www.lionsapp.com

bluejetty:00070434:ios.description:
Peacekeepers At War is an RPG shooter game that takes mobile war games to the next level. Join the battle full of unparalleled action to claim your ground and defeat the enemy!
Of all war online games out there, Peacekeepers At War is the game that doesn’t cease to surprise players with its military game stylistics and plenty of shooting. Never before have army games on mobile platforms been so entertaining and full of battle fun. Join the battle as a one-man army to shoot the enemies, upgrade your base and soldier, collect resources, and do everything else you want to do in a casual online shooter.
SIMPLE & INTUITIVE GAMEPLAY
As soon as you launch Peacekeepers At War online battle game, you join the army battle.
· Collect resources in a casual mode;
· Use the collected resources build and upgrade your war battle base;
· Build and collect equipment to improve your shooting capabilities;
· Use and upgrade your equipment and firearms like in the most classic action RPGs;
· Attack the enemy’s idle army to get coins and other resources, while exploring the map;
· Attack the army in the Dungeon to get bonus resources, equipment, and weapons;
· Become stronger as you take on more and more powerful idle army enemies.
MULTIPLE RESOURCES
All action RPG games are known to feature a wide range of resources, and Peacekeepers At War is no different even though it’s an online shooter:
· Chop the wood to build the base and upgrade your skills;
· Extract technical resources to build equipment and weapons crucial for your war RPG success;
· Get ammunition to upgrade your weapons and equipment to shoot more effectively and absorb less damage;
· Defeat enemies to collect golden coins that you can use to upgrade your RPG online game base elements.
A WIDE RANGE OF WEAPONS AND EQUIPMENT

Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00079207:ios.description:
Luminar — Your all-in-one, on-the-go photo editor and creative companion for iPhone, iPad and Vision Pro. Explore powerful AI-driven tools and an interactive interface that responds to your touch, delivering a uniquely engaging photo editing experience.
Streamlined design with unparalleled control
Luminar's user-friendly design allows you to edit your photos with intuitive gestures, featuring smoothly gliding sliders and spinning dials that respond realistically to your touch with motion and sound. With Luminar, there are no complicated functions or processes. Less fuss, more creativity.
Smart AI enhancements
Powered by cutting-edge technology, Luminar is the revolutionary smart AI photo enhancer for your every need:
- SkyAI: Seamlessly replace dull skies with brilliant ones for impressive backdrops
- EnhanceAI: Effortlessly enhance photo quality with a single slide, adjusting color, tone and clarity for professional results in seconds
- StructureAI: Unlock hidden details and clarity in your images, enhancing contrast and texture for striking visual impact
- Light Depth: Add natural depth and dimension with AI-powered, depth-aware lighting
- FaceAI: Automatically enhance face features, brighten the face and subtly refine proportions
- SkinAI: Automatically retouch the skin and remove imperfections for a clean and smooth result
- BodyAI: Shape a subject’s midsection in a realistic way by adding or removing volume
- BokehAI: Blur backgrounds, adjust focus, customize bokeh shapes
All-in-one powerhouse
- Curves: Edit photos with precise color and tone adjustments, achieving the perfect balance and mood
- Details: Enhance every detail with just a tap, bringing your images to life with clarity and sharpness
- Crop: Easily trim, align, flip and rotate for the perfect composition, ensuring your images stand out
- Landscape: Transform your landscapes with ease and enhance golden hour lighting, brighten foliage, or remove haze for breathtaking results
- Monochrome: Convert your color photos to stunning black and white masterpieces, adding depth and mood to your images
- Erase: Effortlessly remove distracting elements from your photos to place focus on your subjects
- Photo Filters: Enjoy a diverse collection of photo effects that add a unique style to your shots
- RAW File Support: Edit your RAW photos directly on your mobile, preserving maximum image quality
Seamless integration with Apple devices
Designed for the Apple ecosystem, Luminar makes it easy to edit photos taken on your iPhone or iPad, enhancing your editing workflow. On the iPad, you can add personal touches using the Apple Pencil for sharper details and convenient edits. Plus, discover a new immersive editing experience with Vision Pro, optimized for iPadOS and VisionOS.
Luminar — Envision more
Whether you're a beginner or a pro, the Luminar AI photo editor offers a range of features to suit your needs, including detail enhancement, photo retouching, color adjustment, and more. Try Luminar now and experience next-level photo editing at your fingertips.
Compatibility Note:
The Luminar picture editor is optimized for devices running iOS/iPadOS 17 and newer. Please note that on iPad 6-gen, certain advanced features such as Erase, Sky AI and Relight AI are not available.
To access all features, you need to purchase one of the plans below:
1 Week subscription
12 Months subscription (+7 days free trial. Once the trial is over, you will be charged a yearly subscription)
Lifetime license
Subscriptions auto-renew at the cost of the chosen package, unless canceled 24-hours in advance prior to the end of the current period. The subscription fee is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://skylum.com/legal
Terms of use: https://skylum.com/legal-eula

AI Tattoo Generator - InkLab: Turn Your Imagination Into Ink
Explore your creativity with AI Tattoo Generator - InkLab, the most advanced tattoo design app for generating personalized, high-quality tattoo designs. Whether you're a tattoo lover, a first-timer looking for unique tattoo ideas, or a professional tattoo designer, Ink AI gives you the power to create stunning tattoos effortlessly.
With our powerful ai tattoo generator, you can turn any thought, phrase, or aesthetic into a unique piece of body art. From minimalist ink to elaborate sleeve concepts, from symbolic text to traditional motifs, Ink AI brings your vision to life with style and precision.
Key Features of AI Tattoo Generator - InkLab:
AI Tattoo Generator
At the core of Ink AI is our smart ai tattoo generator. Just describe what you want, and our advanced tattoo ai turns it into stunning tattoo designs within seconds. Think of it as your personal tattoo designer who is ready 24/7.
Tattoo Text Generator & Font Tools
Looking to ink a meaningful quote or name? Use our built-in tattoo text generator and tattoo font generator to experiment with fonts, calligraphy, and placements. Personalize your body art with words that matter to you.
Unique Tattoo Ideas & Styles
Get inspired with a huge range of tattoos ideas: tribal, Japanese, fine line, gothic, minimalist, anime, and more. Generate endless unique tattoo ideas with a single tap using tattoo ai generator technology.
Text to AI Tattoo
Convert words, meanings, or concepts into fully rendered tattoo designs using the text to ai tattoo feature. Enter your thoughts and get instant visual designs created by our advanced tattoo ai.
Try Virtual Tattoos Before You Ink
Not sure how it will look? Easily try virtual tattoos on different body parts using AR. Preview size, placement, and style in real time, so you can make confident choices before getting inked.
Full Body Customization & Placement
Whether it's your arm, leg, back, or even fingers, our tattoo generator lets you explore exact placements. Create and adjust tattoo designs for every area of your body with precision.
Export High-Quality Tattoo Stencils
Ready to take your design to the studio? Export high-resolution tattoo stencils to guide your tattoo artist. Ink AI helps ensure your final result looks exactly how you envisioned it.
Why Choose InkLab - AI Tattoo Generator?
Powered by Tattoo AI
Experience cutting-edge tattoo ai generator technology that personalizes every tattoo. No two tattoo designs are ever the same.
Smart & Intuitive Design Tools
Whether you’re experimenting with a tattoo font generator, planning a sleeve, or exploring tattoo ideas, Ink AI makes the process fun and easy.
Perfect for All Levels
From first-timers to pro tattoo designers, anyone can use our tattoo design app to unlock their creativity.
Endless Tattoo Ideas
With ai tattoo generator technology at your fingertips, you’ll never run out of inspiration or fresh tattoo designs.
Download AI Tattoo Generator - InkLab now and bring your ideas to life through the art of ink. From text to AI tattoo magic, Ink AI makes every design personal, powerful, and ready to wear.

bluejetty:00074391:ios.summary:
Camera M is a professional manual camera app designed to do one thing exceptionally well — help you capture beautiful photos at the highest possible quality with powerful, precise manual controls akin to a DSLR.
HIGHLIGHTS
• Fluid gesture
bluejetty:00074391:ios.description:
Camera M is a professional manual camera app designed to do one thing exceptionally well — help you capture beautiful photos at the highest possible quality with powerful, precise manual controls akin to a DSLR.
HIGHLIGHTS
• Fluid gesture-based native manual controls with Fine-Tuning feature
• iOS 27 optimization with Liquid Glass design
• Optimized for iPhone 18 Pro, with aperture control
• Zero-process RAW support for the most natural look
• Max Image Processing to ensure the absolute best image quality
• ProRAW*, RAW, HEIF, JPEG, TIFF, and PNG image formats
• Single, Burst, Timer, Live, Depth*, Dual Photo*, and Bracket shooting modes
• Triple Photo mode with simultaneous ultra-wide, wide-angle, and telephoto camera capture*
• Minimum focus distance display for macro photography
• Intelligent Focus Tracking
• Focus Peaking and 4x magnifier loupe with panning function
• Live RGB and RGB luminance histograms
• Manual gray card calibration
• Great widgets for photography
• Darkroom integration
CAMERA CONTROLS
– Manual focus
– Macro and Scene focus presets
– Exposure bias
– Manual ISO & exposure duration adjustments
– ISO & exposure duration semi-priority modes
– Manual white balance temperature and tint
– White balance presets
– Gray card white balance calibration
– Auto, on, and off flash modes
– Manual torch brightness level
– Manual switching between Ultra Wide, Wide, and Telephoto cameras*
– Digital pinch zoom with 10x range
– Camera Control support for all manual controls
– Lock Screen camera capture support
IMAGE FORMATS
– Apple ProRAW*
– RAW with stabilization
– HEIF with optional minimum compression
– JPEG with optional minimum compression
– TIFF
– PNG
– Live Photo
– P3 wide color support*
SHOOTING MODES
– Single
– Burst
– Timer
– Depth*
– Dual/Triple Photo*
– Live Photo*
– Bracket
TOOLS
– Exposure offset gauge
– Intelligent Focus Tracking
– Live focus peaking assistant
– 4x magnifier loupe with panning function
– Minimum focus distance display
– Live RGB and RGB luminance histograms
– Highlight & shadow alert display
– Horizon level with available pitch tracking and flat options
– Rule of Thirds, Golden Ratio, Quadrant, and Square grids
– Siri Shortcuts and App Shortcuts
– Detailed camera specifications display with PDF export
MAX IMAGE PROCESSING
– Deep Fusion and Smart HDR support for iPhone 11 and later.
– Ensures maximum image quality with better noise reduction, image stabilization, and additional processing for all other iPhones and iPads
ZERO-PROCESS RAW
– Capture standard RAW files with no extra processing
PHOTO LIBRARY
– Summarized and full EXIF metadata display
– Location data display with compass and elevation
– RGB and RGB luminance histogram displays
– Access to all photo albums and folders
WIDGETS
– Home Screen: Golden Hour, EXIF, and Cameras
– Lock Screen: Cameras and Golden Hour
– Control Center: Focus, exposure, and white balance
APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
– Shutter button control
– Sunrise, sunset, and Golden Hour display with sun position indicator
ERGONOMICS
– True one-handed control on all iPhones
– An uncompromising approach to user experience in landscape orientation
ACCESSIBILITY
– Dynamic Type support 
– Bold Text support
– Increase Contrast support
TECHNOLOGY
Camera M is powered exclusively by native APIs and frameworks. There are absolutely no dependencies on any outside sources. This makes it responsive and efficient — from its small download size to its quick app launch times.
We hope you enjoy taking amazing photos with Camera M!
Website: www.camera-m.com
User manual: www.camera-m.com/manual
Get in touch: contact@camera-m.com
Follow us: @CameraMApp
#CameraM
* These features are available on supported devices only.
* Depth capture for selfies requires an iPhone or an iPad with a TrueDepth camera system.
* Apple ProRAW capture requires iPhone 12 Pro or later.
* For more information on device and feature compatibility: www.camera-m.com/compatibility

bluejetty:00137263:ios.description:
Birthday Reminder helps you never forget a birthday again. Get birthday reminders and alerts for all your contacts, so every birthday gets the attention it deserves.
Key Features:
- Birthday calendar and countdown for all your contacts
- Unlimited birthday reminders and alerts
- Import birthdays from contacts or add them manually
- Offline birthday app: no internet required
- No account, no registration
- Anniversary and birthday tracker
Receive Birthday Alerts in Advance:
Set up multiple birthday reminders for each contact and receive birthday alerts exactly when you need them. Choose from a range of options: get notified on the birthday itself, one day before, three days before, one week before, or even two weeks in advance, or combine as many as you want. Every reminder is delivered as a local birthday notification, straight to your device, so you never miss a special day.
Manage Your Birthday Contacts:
Add and manage contacts directly inside the app, no contacts permission needed. Your birthday list lives entirely within Birthday Reminder, completely independent from your device's address book.
Want to use your existing contacts? Import birthdays from your contacts in just a tap. And if you import again, there's no need to worry about duplicates, the import is smart: it only updates contacts that were previously imported, never creating duplicates. Your data stays clean no matter how many times you sync.
Private Birthday Reminder:
Birthday Reminder is a fully offline birthday app: your data never leaves your device. No account, no registration, no cloud. Your contacts and reminders are stored locally, private and secure, always under your control. And even if you choose to import birthdays from your contacts, that information never leaves your device either. Everything stays local, always.

bluejetty:00118677:android.description:

• Register/ Sign Up
• Check Cent Point balance
• Redeem them to get clothes, utilities, jewellery, kitchenware, electronics & more for free

Always use your Central Bank of India Credit/Debit Card whether it’s for shopping or making payments. Earn and accumulate Debit Card Cent Points on every swipe/purchase. To earn upto 5X Cent Points, shop at partner stores. Locate them on app.
How to redeem Cent Points
You can redeem your Cent Points to get products and services for free on this app. The product catalogue includes clothes, accessories, kitchen appliances, home care & décor, jewellery, perfumes, utilities, mobile/DTH recharge, movie tickets & more.

Welcome to Blossom Sorting: Flower Games, the relaxing flower sort puzzle that lets you match flowers, create beautiful bouquets, and enjoy a blooming garden adventure.
If you love flower games, sorting games, and relaxing puzzles, Blossom Sorting is the perfect escape. Sort colorful flowers, organize petals by type, and complete stunning bouquets as you progress through hundreds of satisfying levels.
SORT BEAUTIFUL FLOWERS
Arrange and organize flowers in this addictive flower sort puzzle. Plan your moves carefully, clear the board, and discover new blossoms along the way.
CREATE STUNNING BOUQUETS
Match flowers and combine blooms to complete gorgeous bouquets. Every completed bouquet brings a rewarding and satisfying feeling.
RELAX WITH EVERY LEVEL
Enjoy a calming experience with vibrant flower designs, smooth gameplay, and relaxing visuals. Whether you have a few minutes or a long break, Blossom Sorting offers the perfect way to unwind.
CHALLENGE YOUR PUZZLE SKILLS
Easy to learn but challenging to master. As you advance, you'll encounter more flower types, tricky layouts, and exciting sorting challenges that test your strategy.
DISCOVER NEW FLOWERS
Unlock beautiful blossoms, colorful petals, and unique flower collections. Build your bouquet collection and watch your garden bloom.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE BLOSSOM SORTING
• Fun and satisfying flower sort gameplay
• Create beautiful bouquets
• Relaxing flower puzzle challenges
• Hundreds of engaging levels
• Bright and colorful flower designs
• Smooth and easy controls
• Perfect for casual puzzle fans
• Play anytime, anywhere
Whether you're looking for relaxing flower games, a challenging sorting game, or a satisfying flower puzzle, Blossom Sorting: Flower Games delivers a delightful experience for every player.
Download Blossom Sorting today and start your flower sort adventure. Match flowers, create bouquets, and enjoy one of the most relaxing flower games available.

WHAT IS MOVEMBER?
Movember is the only charity tackling men’s health on a global scale, year round. We’re tackling some of the biggest health issues faced by men: mental health and suicide prevention, prostate cancer and testicular cancer. We have one goal: to stop men dying too young.
In the month formerly known as November, Mo Bros and Mo Sisters across the world raise much-needed funds for men’s health. You can:
Grow a moustache
Whatever you grow will save a bro. Trucker, regent, connoisseur or wisp - no matter the style of Mo you rock this Movember, your face will raise funds and awareness for men’s health.
Move for Movember
Commit to running or walking 60km over the month, at your own pace. That’s 60km for the 60 men we lose to suicide each hour, every hour across the world.
Host a Mo-ment
Rally a crew and do something fun and easy. Hosting is all about having a good time for a good cause.
Mo Your Own Way
Create your own challenge - it can be anything. A gruelling test of physical endurance or something else entirely.
For a Mo on the go, this app has all the tools you need this Movember.

bluejetty:00044810:ios.summary:
OTR Diagnostics — Trusted by 10,000+ Truck Owners

bluejetty:00044810:ios.description:
OTR Diagnostics — Trusted by 10,000+ Truck Owners
Dealing with regen problems, nonstop alerts, fault codes, and unexpected derates on your heavy duty truck? You are not alone. More than 10,000 truck owners and fleets trust OTR Diagnostics to take control, cut downtime, and avoid expensive dealer visits.
Powered by OTR Assist + OTR LINK 2
This is more than a scan tool. OTR Assist is your AI partner, breaking down fault codes in plain language and helping you troubleshoot and decide if you can keep driving or need service now. Paired with OTR LINK 2, our proprietary Bluetooth adapter, you get faster connection speeds, more accurate fault code data, and more live data parameters than ever before. It is 5X better than previous hardware. Ask us how to get a FREE upgrade today.
Commands That Keep You Moving
With bi-directional commands built right into OTR Diagnostics, you are no longer stuck waiting on a shop to do what you can handle yourself.
Reset active and inactive fault codes
Reset the entire aftertreatment system
Reset derates that slow you down
Reset soot levels after a DPF service
Run forced DPF or SCR regens right from the cab
These commands put you back in control, saving you time, money, and downtime.
Fault Code Insights
Go beyond a flashing dash light. OTR Diagnostics helps you understand fault codes with the same level of detail as dealer software, but in plain language you can actually use.
Decode your dash lights
Uncover the root causes of issues
Track how often a problem occurs
Know which repairs or parts are needed
Live Data Monitoring
Want to know if your regen is working? Want to monitor exhaust temps, soot levels, or DEF? OTR Diagnostics lets you see your truck’s vitals in real time so you can spot issues before they stop you.
Common live data parameters include:
DPF fluid level
DPF soot level
EGR valve position
Aftertreatment exhaust temps
Boost pressure
Accelerator pedal position
Engine fuel delivery pressure
Available live data may vary depending on the engine model your device is connected to.
Explore Your History
Recurring problems? OTR Diagnostics logs every fault code and command so you can see when issues happened, when they were cleared, and how long regens lasted.
Proven. Tested. Backed by Support
We run OTR Diagnostics, OTR Assist, and OTR LINK 2 on our own fleet of test trucks including late model Paccar MX engines to make sure everything works before it reaches you. That is why more than 10,000 drivers already trust OTR Diagnostics.
Made in Michigan. Built for You
We engineer, assemble, and ship right from our shop in Macomb, MI. If you are nearby, stop in and see us.
Coverage
We support a wide range of heavy duty engines:
Cummins: CM871, CM2150, CM2250, CM2350 (2008–2024)
Detroit Diesel: DD60, MBE, DD13, DD15, DD16 (2008–2024)
Paccar: MX11, MX13 (2011–2024), PX7, PX9 (2008–2024)
Volvo: D11, D13, D13TC, D16 (2014–2024)
Mack: MP7, MP8, MP8HE, MP10 (2014–2024)
For the full list of compatible models, call or text us at 586-799-4375.
Need Help or Have Questions?
Call or text us anytime at 586-799-4375 or email support@otrperformance.com.

bluejetty:00165962:ios.description:
Welcome to Goods Match: Sort & Design! Dive into a fun and relaxing matching challenge where you can collect items, complete levels, and unlock rewards to decorate beautiful scenes. In this exciting 2D game, your goal is to match items, gather exclusive decorations, and unleash your creativity to design stunning environments. Perfect for both casual players and puzzle enthusiasts, Goods Match: Sort & Design offers endless fun and creative customization without the pressure of a timer!
Game Features:
- Over 1000 beautifully crafted levels waiting for you to explore!
- A wide variety of items, including snacks, drinks, and candies to keep things fresh and exciting.
- Collect unique decorations as you progress through levels and use them to personalize and design your scenes.
- Simple and intuitive gameplay that’s perfect for players of all ages.
- No time limit! Enjoy the game at your own pace without the pressure of a clock.
- Generous rewards and boosters to help you easily overcome challenges.
- Relaxing and engaging—perfect for playing anytime, anywhere.
- Powerful boosters and helpful hints to assist with tricky levels.
- Immersive and dynamic scene changes to make your experience more enjoyable.
How to Play:
- Tap and match identical items by dragging them to the shopping cart. 3 of the same items will be cleared.
- Complete the objectives at your own pace and progress through different levels.
- Unlock skill cards and use boosters to help with difficult levels.
- Collect exclusive items to design and decorate your scenes as you wish.
- Each level offers unique challenges, and completing them rewards you with special prizes.
Ready to unleash your creativity? Download Goods Match: Sort & Design now and enjoy the perfect mix of matching fun and endless customization!

bluejetty:00023702:ios.description:
Frank is an GPT-4o powered search & chat AI bot, a multimodal audio, vision, & text helper that you can write or talk to. He is fast, friendly and easy to talk to.
Built on groundbreaking GPT-4o multimodal AI technology, Frank understands your natural language and provides accurate and relevant answers, whether you use text or voice to ask your question. He can generate any image or text based on your prompts and find any information. 
Simple and blazingly fast: Frank is quick to help you with any question or content, and interacts with you along the way to refine or edit his responses to make it perfect. Available in over 100 languages worldwide, Frank works wherever you are in the world! 
Talk with Frank AI chat using voice or text - he understands your query and provides responses instantly. He can answer in both text and voice.
FRANK AI ASSISTANT FEATURES:
【 SEARCH & BROWSE 】
Want to find the best sushi restaurant close to you, get the latest stock price for Netflix, or quote sources for your research paper? Frank is now able to get you up-to-date information on anything. Use Frank to search and find information without any ads, or tracking - with instant, accurate answers. 
【 FRANK AI KEYBOARD EXTENSION 】
Frank Keyboard is a cutting-edge ChatGPT-powered standalone keyboard that gives you the full power of Frank AI in all your apps - write LinkedIn posts or Tweets in seconds, send emails or generate images right from your keyboard. 
• Custom keyboard prompts 
• Personalise your own Frank AIkeyboard menu 
【 PROMPT COMMUNITY 】
An open prompt community for AI enthusiasts and prompt engineers where you can upvote and explore your new favourite prompts, find the top prompts of the day, try out new prompts, and import them instantly to your Frank Keyboard. 
 • Upvoting prompts 
• Categories 
• Top prompt of the day 
• Live prompt testing 
• Instant import to your Frank Keyboard 
• Save and add prompts to your Frank account
Not happy with the response or content you were given? Ask Frank to change, rewrite, or recreate any response and he will do so instantly. 
Do not enter personal information. May generate offensive or dangerous content. Frank is not liable for content generated.
Frank AI Assistant - Terms of Use: https://www.franks.ai/terms
Frank AI Assistant - Privacy Policy: https://www.franks.ai/privacy
Questions, ideas? We would love to hear what you think and we could even integrate some of your ideas on Frank. Please write to us at team@franks.ai
Thanks for having Frank on your phone!

【界面清新】
多乐团队专门打造的升级拖拉机游戏，为手机、平板特意适配，带给您优质的视觉体验。拖拉机特效展示，80分具体牌展示，一目了然！

bluejetty:00148425:ios.description:
Sermon Scribe: Your all-in-one faith companion.
Whether you're attending a Sunday service, diving into personal Bible study, or spending quiet time in prayer—Sermon Scribe is built to help you stay present, reflect deeply, and grow spiritually.
Capture Every Word, Remember Every Insight
With one tap, record sermons or devotionals and get accurate speech-to-text transcriptions. Take notes in real-time, highlight Scripture references, and revisit key teachings with AI-generated outlines, summaries, and reflection questions.
Understand the Bible Like Never Before
Sermon Scribe's Bible tab lets you explore any book of the Bible with clarity. Access concise overviews, chapter-by-chapter breakdowns, and deep insights into key verses, themes, and characters—making Scripture easier to grasp and apply.
Grow Your Faith Daily
- Daily Devotionals to keep you grounded
- Bible study tools to enhance your understanding
- Journaling for thoughts, reflections, and spiritual growth
- Bible chat to explore your questions with thoughtful, Bible-rooted responses
Organize & Reflect with Ease
Everything you record or write is searchable and synced to the cloud, so your sermons, notes, and reflections are always at your fingertips.
Whether you're in church, in a small group, or alone with your Bible, Sermon Scribe helps you preserve your spiritual moments, revisit them anytime, and deepen your walk with God.
We hope you enjoy this app and that it helps you grow in your faith. We are always looking for feedback to improve your experience, so please do not hesitate to reach out.

Privacy: https://jamappworks.xyz/privacy

bluejetty:00174992:ios.description:
TrialPad is the award-winning trial presentation app for iPad, iPhone, iPhone Duo, and Mac, all included with one LIT SUITE subscription. Organize your evidence, then present documents, photos, video, and audio wirelessly in the courtroom or a remote setting, from whichever device you have with you.
Call out and highlight key passages, compare documents side by side, play and edit video clips, add exhibit stickers, and search every word of your case. TrialPad integrates with your Windows workflow, is powerful, easy to use, and a fraction of the cost of traditional or cloud-based programs, all while being secure, private, mobile, and efficient.
TrialPad was named “The Best Trial Presentation App” with an A+ TechnoScore by LitigationWorld. Since 2010, LIT SOFTWARE has set the bar for developing the best in litigation apps, garnering awards for innovation and ease of use. Our apps have been featured by Apple, and are loved by lawyers.
**** LIT SUITE REVIEWS ****
“The short review. Wow.”
“TrialPad offers a full trial presentation system in a simple-to-use package at a fraction of the cost.”
“These are incredibly sophisticated and useful apps that are in many ways more powerful than PC software costing hundreds of dollars more.”
“For anybody doing any amount of trial work...TrialPad is a must have application.”
“TrialPad is the perfect case organizer and presenter.”
“TrialPad is one of the most complete and high tech presentation systems designed for lawyers and it is available right on your iPad [and Mac].”
“TrialPad...is the industry leader.”
**** Core Features - iPad, iPhone, iPhone Duo, and Mac ****
• Full electronic courtroom presentation, no cloud connection needed
• Present via HDMI to a TV or projector, or wirelessly using an Apple TV
• Create callouts you can resize with a pinch, recolor, and use to dim the rest of the page
• Highlight, annotate, redact, and zoom in, or circle key areas with the Laser Trail tool
• Split View shows two documents, two videos, or a video next to a document
• Add auto-incrementing exhibit stickers and mark documents as admitted
• Run your examination from presenter notes, with timestamps that jump to that moment in a video
• Play, loop, and edit video clips, change playback speed, and capture still frames
• Bookmark document pages and video timestamps
• Create Key Docs from important pages or video segments, and draw on whiteboards
• Search file names or full text across a document, a folder, or the whole case
• Organize evidence into witness or issue folders, and swipe to mark Admitted, add a sticker, or export
• Create reports of your evidence, presenter notes, or a time-stamped presentation log
• Use War Room Mode to share your case with co-counsel and clients

bluejetty:00126498:ios.summary:

Featured in the New York T
bluejetty:00126498:ios.description:
Catalog your belongings and valuables in minutes: scan a barcode and Nest Egg fills in the name, photo and details. Unlimited items, one-time purchase, no subscription, no account. Your data stays on your device.
Featured in the New York Times, Denver Post, Boston Globe, ABC and CNBC. More than 7 million unique items scanned and counting.
HOW PEOPLE USE NEST EGG
• Home insurance: document belongings, receipts and serial numbers before you ever need to file a claim
• Estate planning: keep records of assets across homes, rental properties, RVs and boats
• Moving: list what goes in every box and check your mover's coverage
• Collections: catalog books, music, Lego, wine and more
• Pantry: track food, perishables and medicine with expiry alerts
• Hobbies: keep parts and supplies organized
• Wardrobe: catalog clothing, shoes and accessories
KEY FEATURES
• BARCODE SCANNING
Scan a barcode and we fill in the name, description, photo and more from millions of products.
• CATEGORIES AND LOCATIONS
Organize by category and sub-category, or by room, location and sub-location. Move many items at once with batch edit.
• QR LABELS
Print QR labels for boxes, shelves and containers. Scan a label to see what's inside.
• PHOTOS AND ATTACHMENTS
Up to ten photos per item. Keep receipts, manuals and instructions with each item.
• DETAILED RECORDS
Record purchase details, manufacturer, model and serial numbers, cost and notes.
• WARRANTY AND EXPIRY ALERTS
Get reminded before warranties expire, and cut pantry waste with expiration alerts.
• ONLINE PRICE CHECK
See current prices online with links to merchants. Reordering is easy.
• LENDING AND BORROWING
Track what you've lent and borrowed, and get alerted when it's due back.
• TAGS
Tag items with built-in and custom colors and hierarchies, to build outfits or mark food as organic, kosher or paleo.
• BACKUP AND TRANSFER
Back up to iCloud or Dropbox, and copy your inventory to another iPhone or iPad.
• SHARE, PRINT AND EXPORT
Print with AirPrint, or email items to your insurance agent, family or friends. Import from spreadsheets with CSV, export to CSV for Excel or Numbers, or to HTML with photos.
• 32 LANGUAGES
Including Chinese, French, German and Spanish.
• FAST, FRIENDLY SUPPORT
Reach us from inside the app with questions or feedback. We reply quickly.
NEED AUTOMATIC SYNC?
You can copy your inventory to another iPhone or iPad. Each copy is separate, and changes don't sync automatically. For automatic sync across all your devices, or to share with family or a team, use Nest Egg Cloud (subscription).
Some features described are available as in-app purchases.
